Job Summary

The Delivery Manager – Customer Experience (CX) provides leadership and operational oversight for Professional Services delivery within an assigned region. This role partners with Sales, Solution Architects, and Services teams to ensure efficient delivery execution, strong client outcomes, and achievement of financial and operational goals.

What you will do

  • Apply understanding of the business and contribute to departmental objectives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve organizational and delivery goals.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with technology partners, CDW account managers, regional managers, architects, and engineers to drive services success.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Solution Architects, Services teams, and leadership to maximize services financial performance.
  • Manage team performance, including professional and technical development, through coaching and training aligned to current and future client demands while balancing utilization and profitability.
  • Ensure team members understand roles and follow best practices in service delivery across solutions and geographies.
  • Act as escalation point for issues related to team performance or client satisfaction.
  • Build and maintain a Trusted Partner Network to augment engineering capacity and capabilities.
  • Participate in client engagements including sales calls, service estimates, and strategic planning with executive-level stakeholders.

What we expect of you

  • Bachelor’s degree required and 7 years of experience delivering large scale, enterprise-class technical solutions including planning, development, implementation, and support OR, 11 years of work experience required delivering large scale, enterprise-class technical solutions including planning, development, implementation, and support, including 1+ year of managerial experience.
  • Excellent written, presentation, and verbal communication skills with experience presenting technology recommendations from a business perspective.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage across levels, functions, cultures, and geographies while building strong relationships.
  • Proven ability to resolve client, project, and personnel challenges effectively.
  • Ability to operate calmly and effectively in situations involving change, ambiguity, and risk.
  • Strong prioritization and multitasking skills in fast-paced environments.
  • Experience developing long-range project plans and schedules for complex initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to apply lessons learned and adapt to new technologies.
  • Relevant ecosystem experience may include Cisco, Microsoft CX products, Citrix, Zoom, RingCentral, and Dialpad.
  • The role is expected to be billable about 15%,, focused on strategic-project oversight, customer design or strategy reviews, and similar activities rather than hands-on configuration work.
  • Valid U.S. driver’s license.
  • Ability and willingness to travel as needed to CDW or client locations.

Pay range: $121,450 - $170,010 depending on experience and skill set

Annual bonus target of 25% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Benefits overview:

Salary ranges may be subject to geographic differentials


CDW is committed to being an AI-fluent organization

As a leader, you will champion and be accountable for our vision of becoming an AI-fluent organization. We expect leaders to model curiosity, encourage responsible AI adoption, and foster a culture of continuous learning. You don’t need deep technical expertise, but you should be comfortable exploring how AI can enhance strategy, decision-making, and team performance. Your role includes guiding others in building confidence and capability with AI tools and practices, while promoting openness to experimentation and shared learning.

Additionally, CDW is committed to fostering an equitable, transparent, and respectful hiring process for all applicants. During our application process, our goal is to understand your experience, strengths, skills, and qualifications. As an AI forward company, we see AI not just as a tool, but as a catalyst for new ways of thinking, creating, and communicating. We encourage candidates to embrace an AI mindset, one that’s curious, adaptive, and ready to explore what’s possible. We welcome thoughtful use of AI to expand your perspective and elevate how you share your story, while ensuring your application remains rooted in your own background, judgment, and voice.

About Us

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. What makes CDW different isn’t just what we do—it’s how we do it. At CDW we act as one—building trust, speaking candidly, and working together to achieve more. We play to win—focusing on what matters most and delivering for our customers. And we think forward—staying curious, moving fast, and continuously learning. We believe meaningful work happens when people feel supported, heard, and empowered to contribute. That’s why we think of ourselves as coworkers, not just employees—working together to solve complex challenges and deliver real impact for our customers and communities.

As a full‑stack, full‑lifecycle technology partner, CDW brings deep expertise, strong relationships, and broad industry knowledge to help turn ideas into outcomes. When you join CDW, you become part of a collaborative environment where your work matters, your growth is supported, and your contributions help shape what’s next.

Together, we deliver the full promise of what technology can do. Together, we Make Amazing Happen.

CDW is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other basis prohibited by state and local law.

raw.excerpt: DescriptionMEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States.
raw.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

﻿Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Position Summary:

Review, draft, negotiate and track a variety of legal agreements including confidentiality agreements, master confidentiality agreements, clinical study agreements and amendments. Works closely with Clinical Operations study teams and plays a key role to ensure deliverables are in alignment with defined study timelines. The Senior Contracts Manager will serve as a subject matter expert within the department and company regarding site contract management.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Establish process and procedures for overall site contract management in the organization.
  • Review, draft and negotiate a variety of agreements including master services agreements, site contracts, consulting agreements, vendor agreements, confidentiality agreements, and other client contracts.
  • Escalate and resolve complex issues with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Negotiate site budget.
  • Provide guidance to business teams regarding operational implications of contract terms.
  • Ensure adherence to company policies, procedures and contracting standards.
  • Update relevant study team members regarding the status of contract negotiations and execution.
  • Establish, track, report and manage site contract metrics.
  • Coordinate execution of agreements and track agreement expirations and other obligations
  • Support the maintenance of contract files and databases, including contract archiving.
  • Assist in designing and implementing policies and procedures to affect the timely execution of contracts.
  • Recognize where processes can be improved and take corrective action.
  • Mentor and/or Ambassador for new SCMs and Precision for Medicine staff
  • Other tasks, as assigned.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Graduate, postgraduate, 4-year college degree
  • Equivalent experience ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Relevant experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating site Clinical Trial Agreements, vendor contracts and site Budget negotiations, but no less than 7 years’ experience.
  • Experienced leading interactions with US/European/APAC or other regions institutions
  • Experienced leading interactions with Study Teams and Sponsor

Preferred:

  • Bachelors in law, scientific fields, business administration or equivalent degree
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills and attention to detail
  • Experienced on setting up Contracting Plans - Guides for CTA & Budget negotiations.
  • Experienced dealing with Kick-Off Meetings (KOM) and Bid Defense Meetings (BDM)
  • Successful handling relationship study team and/or with CRAs/Start-up Associate/(S)BSCA to meet study timelines.

Skills:

Competencies

  • Possesses strong organizational/written communication skills and the ability to multi-task and prioritize in a fast-paced environment.
  • Executes time-sensitive matters while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Exhibits high self-motivation and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, an understanding of the service culture and positive interactions with customers and teammates, including good interpersonal skills.
  • Displays sound business judgment and a proactive, independent work style.
  • Is proficient in MS Office software programs and computer applications.
  • Handles sensitive issues with discretion.
  • Works well independently and cooperatively with others to achieve common goals in a virtual environment.
  • Develops, maintains, and strengthens relationships with others inside or outside of the organization who can provide information, assistance, and support

raw.description:
Sr CRA Romania (home based)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete via review of site source documents and medical records. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • Understands project scope, budgets, and timelines for own and others’ activities in the clinical team; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates, and may, with supervision, lead, global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • May provide training or mentorship to more junior level CRAs. May perform training and sign off visits for junior CRA staff, as assigned.
  • May be mentored and assigned clinical operations lead tasks under supervision of an experienced Clinical Operations Lead (COL), or operational line manager. For Real World Late Phase (RWLP), the Sr. CRA I will use the business card title of Sr. Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close out
    Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs
    Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    As required, collaborate and build relationships with Sponsor and other affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff
    Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager
    Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations
    Identify operational efficiencies and process improvements
    Develop country level informed consent forms
    Collaborate with RWLP Regulatory team to ensure updated regulatory information is applied and shared
    Participate in bid defense meetings

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Basic level of critical thinking skills expected.

raw.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Summary


We are seeking a quality or industrial engineering professional with hands-on experience in metal fabrication, welding inspection, metal stamping, and laser cutting. This role will evaluate supplier manufacturing capabilities, establish quality requirements, and drive process improvements to ensure fabricated metal parts and assemblies meet engineering specifications and customer expectations.


Key Responsibilities


  • Assess and qualify suppliers for metal fabrication processes, including welding, stamping, laser cutting, forming, and assembly.
  • Conduct supplier process audits to evaluate manufacturing controls, equipment capabilities, inspection methods, and quality systems.
  • Review engineering drawings, geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T), material specifications, and customer requirements to identify critical dimensions, features, and functions.
  • Inspect welded assemblies for dimensional accuracy, workmanship, weld discontinuities, and conformance to applicable drawings and acceptance criteria.
  • Evaluate stamping processes for dimensional consistency, tooling condition, burr control, cracking, springback, and surface defects.
  • Assess laser cutting processes for cut accuracy, edge quality, dross, distortion, and repeatability.
  • Develop and review inspection plans, control plans, process flow diagrams, and process failure mode and effects analyses (PFMEAs).
  • Support new product introduction, first article inspections, and Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) submissions.
  • Verify material composition, mechanical properties, traceability, and supporting material certifications.
  • Evaluate paint, coating, plating, and surface finish requirements, including appearance and thickness criteria.
  • Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions using methods such as 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.
  • Partner with sourcing, engineering, manufacturing, and suppliers to improve quality, process capability, yield, and delivery performance.
  • Track supplier performance and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions and development plans.

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • At least three years of relevant quality, manufacturing, industrial engineering, or supplier quality experience in metal fabrication.
  • Practical experience with welding inspection, metal stamping, and laser cutting.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, GD&T, weld symbols, and technical specifications.
  • Experience using dimensional inspection equipment, such as calipers, micrometers, height gauges, and coordinate measuring machines (CMMs).
  • Working knowledge of quality management systems, statistical process control (SPC), measurement system analysis (MSA), and process capability analysis.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical documentation skills.
  • Ability to work across functions and directly with suppliers to resolve manufacturing and quality issues.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Certified Welding Inspector (CWI), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Six Sigma certification, or equivalent credentials.
  • Experience with MIG, TIG, resistance, or robotic welding processes.
  • Familiarity with applicable AWS welding codes and nondestructive testing methods.
  • Experience with large metal enclosures, cabinets, racks, chassis, or other complex fabricated assemblies.
  • Experience leading supplier qualification, supplier development, and manufacturing readiness reviews.
  • Familiarity with Lean manufacturing, tooling and fixture validation, and design for manufacturability.

Travel Requirements


Ability to travel to supplier and manufacturing locations as business needs require.

About Wealth Enhancement


Wealth Enhancement is an independent wealth management firm with an endless passion for enriching the lives of our clients. We continually seek to perfect our craft of personalized financial planning with our team-based Roundtable and UniFi processes that go far beyond the standard approach. We proudly provide unique financial plans and investment management services to over 90,000 households from our over 175 offices - and growing - nationwide.


Since 1997, Wealth Enhancement has tirelessly raised the standard of wealth management with specialized knowledge and more attentive service that helps every client craft their future. For more information, please visit .


We have an exciting opportunity for a Advisor Marketing Specialist! The Advisor Marketing Specialist is a highly collaborative partner to a portfolio of advisor teams. This role is deeply embedded in each team's business goals, practice and voice and is responsible for creating, executing, and optimizing marketing strategies that drive measurable growth. As the closest marketing connection to their assigned advisor teams, the Specialist brings creativity, insight, and proactive guidance to life across email, social, events, and campaigns. This position is ideal for a relationship-first, results-oriented marketer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is excited by the opportunity to help shape team-level marketing execution and client experience across Wealth Enhancement.

This is a Remote position.

In the spirit of pay transparency, we are excited to share the base salary range for this position is $68,000 to $80,000, exclusive of bonuses and benefits. We encourage you to apply and provide us with your compensation expectations when you do. We're big on open conversations, so, let's have one.

Primary Job Functions

Strategic Support for Advisor Teams

  • Act as the day-to-day marketing lead for 8-10 advisor teams, becoming an expert in each team’s goals, voice, services, and growth opportunities.
  • Conduct proactive campaign planning sessions with advisor teams to uncover needs, provide recommendations, and ensure marketing initiatives align to team-level business goals.
  • Partner closely with Advisor Marketing Consultants to ensure each team’s plan ladders up to regional growth priorities.
  • A key aspect of the role is supporting a handful of teams executing on their marketing goals and initiatives with a big focus on event coordination.
  • Align advisor team marketing plan with corporate marketing offerings and key growth drivers and initiatives using our Advisor Marketing Platform for events, email and social strategies from our content library and advisor crafted content
  • Navigate Salesforce: pull reports, analyze dashboards, present client data, create campaigns and report out on results and final budgets (we can teach you!)

Campaign Execution & Innovation

  • Lead campaign planning and execution using tools like FMG Suite, Canva, Wistia, Wrike, and Salesforce.
  • Coordinate collateral development, content customization, email/social/web campaigns, event support, and vendor communications as needed.
  • Collaborate with the Creative, Brand, Web, and Compliance teams to ensure timely execution and approval of marketing assets.
  • Track results and share post-campaign insights and optimizations with teams and marketing leaders.
  • Leverage AI tools to increase content speed, surface new ideas, and streamline recurring marketing processes.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Foster strong relationships with financial advisors, the advisor marketing team and identifying and highlighting success stories and best practices within the advisor community. Help to document and create processes around successful new initiatives.
  • Serve as a key central knowledge hub for each assigned team’s marketing strategy and execution.
  • Keep internal stakeholders (e.g., Advisor Marketing Consultant, Advisor Marketing leaders) informed of key campaigns, blockers, and advisor feedback.
  • Ensure work is visible and documented, allowing consultant team members to stay out of day-to-day execution while maintaining confidence in outcomes.
  • Regularly educate and train advisors and their staff on your marketing recommendations, marketing collateral, and tools available to support all areas of their client and prospect lifecycle.
  • Research and stay informed on ideas within and outside our industry to make recommendations and bring new ideas to your advisor teams.
  • Take ownership of key advisor enablement projects as needed to help continually enhance our offerings and capabilities.

Organic Growth team collaboration

  • Participate in team-wide meetings, creative brainstorms and campaign showcases.
  • Contribute to the development of new tools, templates, or campaign frameworks.
  • Identify opportunities to scale successful ideas across advisor teams.
  • Serve as a collaborative partner within the team, pitching in on things that wouldn’t normally be on your to-do list as needed.

Education/Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree in Marketing, Communications or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of marketing or sales enablement experience required.
  • Financial services marketing experience is beneficial, but not required.
  • Strong project management, communication, and relationship-building skills.
  • Good working knowledge of Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
  • Able to function in Wistia, Wrike, Canva and FMG Suite a plus!
  • Technical aptitude: Ability to learn new applications, technologies and AI quickly. Proficiency in working with CRM systems required, Salesforce a plus.
  • Ability to manage multiple team relationships and priorities concurrently.
  • Excellent writing, visual storytelling, and content development skills.
  • Travel 2-7 times per year to support team initiatives and events.
  • Empathy: Ability to put yourself in an advisor’s shoes and understand the dynamics of their practice.
  • Results-oriented: Tenacious about meeting and exceeding goals.
  • Analytical: Able to make business decisions based on data
  • Excellent communication skills and exceptional customer service mindset.
  • Able to strategically apply marketing expertise and creativity to develop effective marketing solutions.
  • Attention to detail is critical
  • Persuasive polished and able to establish credibility quickly.
  • Graciously accepts and provides constructive criticism.
  • Listens well, asks great questions.
  • Curiosity is a must! Stay up to date on marketing trends.

AI Literacy:

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively use AI tools and technologies in daily work tasks.
  • Requirements include understanding how to craft effective prompts, evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy and appropriateness, and integrate AI tools to enhance productivity while maintaining quality standards.
  • Comfort with learning new AI applications and understanding their appropriate use cases and limitations.
  • As AI technology evolves, continued learning and adaptation to new AI tools and methodologies will be expected.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

Who Thrives Here?

We hire sprinters, not coasters—people who:

  • Choose growth over comfort
  • Lead through challenges
  • Are energized by high expectations

It’s not for everyone, and that’s intentional. If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

As a Backend Engineer in the Data Feeds Team, You Will be Responsible for:

Whether it's structured data flowing like a well-oiled stream or unstructured data that needs taming, you've got to make sure these pipelines are top-notch for seamless processing.

  • Data Governance Enforcer: Enforce the best practices in data governance, security, and compliance. You're the gatekeeper of sensitive information, and you've got to keep it safe at all costs.

This is a fully-remote opportunity based in India. Standard work hours are from 8 am to 5 pm IST.

You Are Likely To Succeed If you have or you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline from a top-tier (Tier 1/2) institution
  • 4+ years of hands-on software development experience
  • Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals with core data structures and advanced algorithms
  • Excellent in one of the following languages: Python / Golang / Java (Python is the most preferred)

Proficiency with messaging platforms (Kafka, RMQ, SQS) and relational/NoSQL datastores (MySQL, Postgres, MongoDB, Cassandra, ScyllaDB, HBase, Redis, Aerospike, etc.).

  • Experience in architecture and developing large-scale distributed systems.
  • Familiarity with microservice architecture, API gateway patterns, and service observability (logging, tracing, metrics).
  • Proven track record building and operating systems with strict latency and reliability requirements in 24/7 environments, including:
    • High-performance, high-uptime (99.99%+) systems
    • Self-recoverable architectures
    • Container/VM orchestration platforms
    • Bonus: RPC frameworks (gRPC/Protobuf, Thrift)
  • Strong architectural expertise with modern backend stacks (Go, Python, Java, Node.js) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure, Kubernetes/Docker)
  • Excellent logic analysis capabilities, able to abstract and split business logic reasonably.
  • Strong ownership, self-motivation, and the ability to deliver independently while also collaborating effectively.
  • Ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts and org-wide strategies to engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives.

Nice to have (Optional)

  • Knowledge of security best practices, authentication/authorization, and performance tuning for high-traffic systems.
  • Knowledge of AI agent/harness, focus on how to use AI to improve work efficiency or restructure work patterns
  • Experience with DevOps practices

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life and we mean it. We offer vacation time, parental leave, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a Junior Social Media Video Editor who speaks the language of the internet and can turn raw footage into viral gold.

Why This Role Matters

The "For You Page," the scroll, and the hook are your playground. As a Junior Social Media Video Editor, you aren't just cutting video; you are translating brand messages into native social culture. You will be responsible for taking raw influencer content and studio footage and turning it into snappy, engaging, and high-converting assets for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

Your work determines if a user stops scrolling or keeps moving. If you are obsessed with pacing, trends, and creating content that feels authentic to the platform, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Edit Native Short-Form Content

    • Assemble and edit fast-paced, engaging videos specifically for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

    • Master the art of the "hook"—editing the first 3 seconds to grab attention instantly using visual disruption, text overlays, and sound.

    • Implement trending audio, native text styles, and platform-specific stickers to make ads feel organic.

  2. Remix & Iterate

    • Take successful ad concepts and create fresh iterations by swapping hooks, changing music, or re-ordering footage to combat creative fatigue.

    • Turn long-form content (YouTube videos, podcasts) into bite-sized, viral social clips.

  3. Polish & Enhance

    • Apply dynamic captions (Alex Hormozi style, karaoke style, etc.) that increase watch time and retention.

    • Perform basic color correction and audio mixing to ensure mobile-viewing quality.

    • Add basic motion graphics and transitions to keep the energy high.

  4. Stay Trend-Obsessed

    • Monitor the TikTok Creative Center and Reels trends daily.

    • Proactively pitch new editing styles, audio trends, or visual memes that we can apply to our client brands.

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience editing specifically for social media (personal brand, agency, or freelance).

    • You live on the FYP. You understand current memes, pacing trends, and what makes a video go viral.

  2. Technically Agile

    • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required).

    • Familiarity with After Effects (for motion text) and CapCut (for specific trending effects) is a major plus.

    • You understand aspect ratios, safe zones, and export settings for all social platforms.

  3. Fast & Creative

    • You can turn around an edit in hours, not days. You thrive on the speed of social media.

    • You have a good sense of rhythm and timing—your cuts land perfectly on the beat.

  4. Detail-Oriented

    • You double-check spelling in captions and ensure audio levels are balanced for phone speakers.

    • You are organized with your file management and project structures.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can clearly articulate why you made a creative choice and collaborate effectively with Art Directors remotely.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative direction of major brands and grow into a Senior Editor or Creative Strategist role.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one viral edit at a time.

Job Description Summary

As the Sr Program Manager - Software Solutions & Business Process, you will lead global, cross-functional Supply Chain and manufacturing transformation for software, digital, and hybrid healthcare offerings. You will connect product strategy and New Product Introduction (NPI) to planning, manufacturing readiness, order management, fulfillment, installation, billing, service, and lifecycle execution.

This is a business-led operating model and process role. You will define how work gets done across regions and functions, align physical product and digital fulfillment flows, and partner with technology teams as an enabler of scalable ERP and digital capabilities. Priorities include Support Digital Core, Big Rock Software Subscription, Hybrid Countries Orders, and Digital iNVENTORY. Candidates with backgrounds in Supply Chain, manufacturing operations, NPI, industrial engineering, or operations excellence are strongly encouraged to apply.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

• Lead strategic, cross-functional programs across Supply Chain, manufacturing, commercial operations, product, and digital fulfillment, managing scope, milestones, dependencies, risks, resources, governance, decisions, and implementation from definition through stabilization.

• Own end-to-end value-stream and operating-model design from NPI and design transfer through demand and supply planning, manufacturing readiness, order management, fulfillment, installation, billing, service, and lifecycle support.

• Define the Supply Chain model for software, digital, and hybrid offerings, connecting physical product flows with digital entitlements, licenses, subscriptions, inventory, master data, and customer delivery requirements.

• Lead NPI and design-transfer readiness for software and subscription offerings, ensuring clear requirements, operational controls, manufacturing and fulfillment readiness, quality and regulatory alignment, documentation, training, and sustainable handoff to operations.

• Drive Support Digital Core initiatives that strengthen the foundational processes, data, systems, controls, and ownership model required to support digital and software offerings at scale.

• Lead the Big Rock Software Subscription program, coordinating Supply Chain, commercial, finance, product, fulfillment, service, and regional readiness required to enable and scale subscription-based offerings.

• Drive Hybrid Countries Orders initiatives, defining scalable processes for markets requiring coordinated execution across software, digital, service, and physical products.

• Lead Digital Inventory capabilities and process transformation, improving visibility, governance, accuracy, and lifecycle management of digital inventory, entitlements, assets, and related operational data.

• Establish current-state, interim-state, and future-state processes, decision rights, roles and responsibilities, controls, handoffs, training, and adoption plans across global value streams.

raw.description:
Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges. As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs. We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


The Problem

Platform Architecture is our most overloaded cross-cutting team. Priorities are pushed down onto them from every direction. They're also the final gate in the PR approval chain (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture) — not the only reviewers, but the ones who carry the heaviest review load and have the most influence over how that process is designed — which makes them a bottleneck with limited ability to control their own inbound work.


Infrastructure has a related but distinct problem. They just stood up a formal SDLC and are early in adopting ADO, and teams with dependencies on them often reach out at the last minute rather than planning ahead — disrupting their flow of work the same way competing top-down asks disrupt Platform Architecture's. They also need to get better at communicating outward: proactively flagging when scrum and product teams need to test architectural changes or enhancements, rather than that falling through the cracks after the fact.


Both teams need their capacity protected from poorly-timed, uncoordinated demands, and both need a partner who can build the two-way communication habits — inbound planning lead time and outbound impact visibility — that neither currently has.


We also want dedicated Agile coaching capacity across the broader team eventually — someone who can dig into how each team runs planning, standups, and retros, and help our strategic Agile plan translate into practice, not just theory. That's not this role's starting focus: given the depth of what's already being asked for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, we don't want to set this person up to juggle too much on day one. We see broader coaching as a natural growth path for this role once the Platform Architecture and Infrastructure work is stable, and only if/when they have the capacity for it.


The Role

Reports to the Head of Agile or Head of AI Enabled Delivery with a dotted line to the other. Serves as the embedded Scrum Master for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, and acts as mentor/lead to the other Scrum Masters across the organization to drive consistent execution of our Agile strategy. No direct reports.


Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities (Day One)

  • Prioritization gatekeeping: Push back on stakeholders, convene cross-team prioritization sessions, and protect Platform Architecture and Infrastructure capacity from competing top-down asks, maintaining clear cross-portfolio dependency maps so trade-offs are visible to stakeholders.
  • Cross-team visibility & coaching: Coach Platform Architecture and Infrastructure to proactively communicate their work, roadmap, and potential downstream impact to dependent scrum and product teams; facilitate a recurring cross-team forum until this becomes routine practice, and use it to support prioritization decisions.
  • Capacity protection for bottleneck relief: Influence and partner with Platform Architecture leadership to reduce the volume of competing top-down asks landing directly on their team, freeing their capacity to redesign the release-approval process they anchor (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture). This role does not own that approval process itself — it protects the time Platform Architecture needs to fix it.
  • Ceremony-level coaching: Run and coach ceremonies for both teams, tailoring facilitation and training to each team's specific needs and maturity rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Strategic accountability: Report directly to the Heads of Agile on team health, blockers, and adherence to the strategic plan.
  • Compliance & documentation: Ensure delivery routines for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure align with applicable security, risk, and governance requirements across Baldwin partner organizations; support accurate delivery documentation and audit/accreditation readiness where required.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • SM mentorship: Provide informal lead guidance to the Scrum Masters on other teams, ensuring our strategic Agile plan is executed consistently across the org.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an embedded Scrum Master or Agile Coach supporting highly technical, cross-cutting engineering or infrastructure teams.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder-alignment skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across business units and portfolios.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (ADO); familiarity with DevSecOps, multi-cloud, or CI/CD delivery environments a plus.
  • Experience with cross-portfolio dependency mapping, OKRs, and delivery/quality metrics reporting.
  • Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM/Advanced SM, or equivalent) preferred.

Success Metrics (6–12 Months)

  • Platform Architecture reports measurably more protected capacity (e.g., reduced ad hoc/competing asks), enabling them to own redesign of their release-approval process.
  • Recurring cross-stakeholder prioritization cadence established and adopted.
  • Recurring roadmap/impact forum between Platform Architecture, Infrastructure, and dependent teams established and running independently of this role.
  • Visible execution of the Heads of Agile's strategic plan across team ceremonies.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • Tailored coaching plans rolled out for Scrum Masters.
  • Informal coaching practices shared with Scrum Masters on other teams, if bandwidth allows once core scope is stable.

About OSW Group

OSW Group is a fast growing global ecosystem of businesses united by a shared vision to accelerate the world's transition to smarter, more sustainable energy and technology solutions. Our portfolio includes One Stop Warehouse (OSW), GreenSketch, GreenDeal, Manta and Sunmine, combining expertise across renewable energy, AI-powered software, energy finance and digital infrastructure to drive innovation on a global scale.

With operations across Australia, Singapore, China, Europe, the United States and Mexico—and continuing to expand into new markets—we're creating opportunities for ambitious people to build meaningful, international careers. While each of our businesses has its own unique focus, we're connected by a collaborative culture, entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for challenging what's possible.

When you join OSW Group, you're joining more than a company—you're becoming part of a global team that's shaping the future of clean energy and technology. We invest in our people, encourage fresh ideas, celebrate success and provide the opportunity to grow alongside a business that's only just getting started.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; REE license
  • At least 5 years of experience in the Solar PV industry, preferably with experience in pre-sales and technical sales.
  • Strong knowledge and experience in PV system design, sizing, analysis, and technical evaluation.
  • Proficient in preparing technical proposals, system designs, BOMs, energy yield analysis, and project costing.
  • Good understanding of On-Grid, Hybrid, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
  • Strong leadership, communication, presentation, and team management skills. -Ability to lead technical teams and provide technical guidance to sales and project teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate customer requirements into practical and technically sound solar solutions.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Leadership: Lead the technical team in the Philippines and guide the sales and project teams on technical matters.

  • Assign and review the work of the technical team, and set priorities for design and support tasks.
  • Act as the final technical reviewer of designs and proposals before they are sent to customers.

Pre-Sales and Solution Design: Assess customer needs and design On-Grid, Hybrid and BESS solutions for residential and C&I projects.

  • Conduct site surveys, load analysis and electricity bill reviews to determine the right system size.
  • Join sales meetings and customer presentations to explain the proposed solution.

Technical Proposals and Costing: Prepare technical proposals, BOMs, energy yield analysis and project costing using the OSW product range.

  • Prepare single-line diagrams, panel layouts and equipment specifications.
  • Work with the sales and accounting team to align pricing, margins and payment terms.

Standards and Compliance: Ensure designs and products meet local codes and regulations, and support permit and net-metering applications.

  • Keep up to date with changes to the PEC, DOE and ERC rules and distribution utility requirements.
  • Prepare the technical documents needed for permits and net-metering applications.

After-Sales and Technical Escalations: Handle technical escalations, troubleshooting and warranty claims.

  • Diagnose system faults remotely or on site, and coordinate repairs with partners and installers.
  • Liaise with manufacturers on warranty claims and follow them through to closure.

Product Evaluation and Market Development: Evaluate new products and support OSW’s growth in the Philippines.

  • Test and assess new products, and share feedback with the OSW product team.
  • Monitor competitor products, pricing and market trends in the Philippines.

Training and Capability Building: Train the sales team, partners and customers, and build the local team’s technical skills.

  • Conduct product and installation training for partners, installers and the sales team.
  • Prepare training materials, installation guides and FAQs.

Processes, Records and Systems: Maintain technical processes and records, including the CRM, in line with OSW standards.

  • Keep design files, datasheets and project documents organised and easy to access.
  • Update the CRM with technical inputs on leads, opportunities and support cases.

Collaboration and Reporting: Work with the Country Manager and OSW teams, and report on technical matters and project status.

  • Submit regular reports on technical activities, project status and open issues to the Country Manager.
  • Coordinate with OSW regional and head office teams on product and technical matters.

Other Duties: Perform other related duties as may be assigned by the Country Manager.

Description

TripleTen is a leading online coding bootcamp that offers to learn coding and data analysis skills for tech industry jobs in less than a year in the US, Latin America, and Brazil.

Our research-based learning method is focused on ensuring that after completing our program, every student, regardless of their initial abilities, will find employment in tech industry with 100% money-back guarantee and 87% employment rate among our 6K+ graduates.

We are looking for a Senior User Acquisition Manager to launch and scale paid acquisition for our new online master’s degree programs offered in partnership with US universities. You will own acquisition from the first ad impression through to enrollment, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads, particularly YouTube, is a strong plus.

What you will do

  • Launch paid acquisition from scratch for our new online master’s degree programs offered in partnership with US universities.
  • Own acquisition strategy, budgets, and hands-on campaign execution, with Meta Ads as your primary channel. Experience with Google Ads and YouTube will allow you to test and develop these channels as well.
  • Build, test, and scale acquisition funnels for a high-ticket B2C product, from the first ad impression through qualification, consultations, and enrollment.
  • Optimize for qualified prospects and customer acquisition cost, using CRM data, sales call transcripts, and conversion rates across the funnel to guide decisions.
  • Develop and rapidly test hypotheses around audiences, messaging, offers, creative formats, and landing pages. Scale what works and stop what doesn’t.
  • Turn audience research and competitor insights into actionable creative briefs. Work with the team and external partners to produce and iterate on ads and landing pages.
  • Set up advertising accounts, pixels, conversion events, and campaign tracking, with support from analytics and engineering teams where needed.
  • Work closely with Sales to improve lead quality and build a qualified waitlist ahead of the opening of paid enrollment.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with recent hands-on experience managing both Meta Ads and Google Ads, including audience acquisition through YouTube.
  • Experience in acquisition-first or paid-marketing-first companies, where paid acquisition is a core driver of revenue.
  • Proven success acquiring customers for high-ticket B2C products through multi-step funnels involving qualification, consultations, and sales conversations. Experience with products priced at $10,000+ is strongly preferred.
  • Experience personally managing monthly advertising budgets of $50,000–$100,000 or more, with measurable business results.
  • A track record of launching acquisition from scratch: setting up accounts and tracking, testing initial hypotheses, finding effective combinations of audiences, offers, and creatives, and scaling them.
  • Strong hands-on Meta Ads expertise, including campaign structure, audience testing, pixel and conversion setup, creative experimentation, and budget optimization.
  • Hands-on Google Ads expertise beyond Search, particularly YouTube and video-led acquisition for products that require consideration and demand generation.
  • Full-funnel analytical skills: you work with CAC, ROMI, lead-to-call and call-to-sale conversion rates, and use CRM and BI data to assess performance beyond cost per lead.
  • Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, and conversion tracking. You can define conversion events and validate tracking, collaborating with analysts and engineers when needed.
  • Experience testing offers, ad copy, creatives, and landing pages, and writing clear briefs for designers, content producers, and external partners.
  • Confidence working independently in a new product environment, with limited historical data and no established acquisition playbook.
  • AI tools are already part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Full professional English.
  • Based within CET ±3 hours, with at least 2 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

What we can offer you

  • Competitive compensation: 4500-5000 USD Gross per month.
  • Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
  • A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
  • All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

JOB PURPOSE

The Solutions Engineer is responsible for assessing, developing and supporting the implementation of logistics solutions that improve current and prospective clients’ business models. The individual will possess strong evaluation skills as you review current state, using appropriate tools/diagrams. Detailed data analysis will complement the process to ensure an ideal future state is designed. As an integral part of the Transportation Insight sales process, the Solutions Engineer will be a hands-on leader.


This role is responsible for supporting the deal cycle with an emphasis on strategic thought, business acumen, creative problem-solving, flexibility, and sound judgment. The Solutions Engineer will collaborate with key cross-functional stakeholders, senior-level team members and prospective clients to design a solution that meets client-stated needs/requirements, can be operated by the organization, and that is profitable.

The individual in this role brings demonstrated skills in consultative selling, supply chain management, TMS system implementation, project management and is able to apply these skills effectively across functional departments.  They are able to price complex multi-mode service solutions and provide key inputs for the production, demonstration and presentation of documents to prospective clients. 

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ability to effectively communicate the value and differentiators of Transportation Insight as a logistics partner, as well as our core competencies of services across all modes
  • Gather client requirements and understand the key drivers for delivering value-based supply chain improvements.
  • Assess a validated prospects’ current supply chain program by documenting current state.
  • Coordinate the assessment process for assigned validated prospects.  Hold the internal organization accountable for meeting assigned timelines.
  • Understand the client's systems/applications used in current state, overall objectives and requirements to propose the best solution for their needs.
  • Work with a cross-functional delivery team to develop a solutions strategy and operational framework.
  • Participate in the solution design process by facilitating prospect strategy meetings and coordinating internal resources.
  • Document the future solution to help with the production of presentations and other documentation as needed
  • Help create pricing strategies for Transportation Insight service offerings that are both competitive and attractive to prospective clients.
  • Assist sales personnel, as needed, in demonstrating technology platforms that lead to closure of new business.
  • Effectively communicate with prospects and clients at the necessary pace, utilizing phone, web and on site as appropriate.
  • Collect information on client's unfulfilled needs and potential service improvements and report with recommendations to Solutions leadership
  • Assess from continuous improvement standpoint the standard approach for the transitioning of clients from the sales organization to implementation/account management teams.
  • Support ongoing improvement efforts by documenting best practices.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • BS degree in business or related field.  MBA is preferred and required if Bachelor’s degree is not in business or related field.
  • Experienced logistics professional with 5+ (five) years of experience in Supply Chain management related fields.
  • Minimum 4 (four) years of complex, consultative, solutions experience is required.
  • Direct consulting experience of transportation, logistics, and/ or TMS at the C-Suite decision-making level

SUPPORTING SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Proven success in consistently driving revenue-generating solutions with tangible results.
  • Advanced experience working with Microsoft Office Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Visio).
  • LEAN / Six Sigma Certification or Experience a plus.
  • Detailed oriented, self-starter with a strong work ethic.
  • Displaying leadership at the contributor level
  • Continuous learner & diligence in development of individual growth goals
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at any given time and be able to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Strong collaborator in working with internal operations teams in solution development stages
  • Possess excellent organizational skills with the flexibility to adapt to change under stress and within tight deadlines.
  • Effective problem solver, able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, gather and analyze information skillfully, & develop alternative solutions when necessary.
  • Strong technical skills, including project planning, presentation, and general business applications.
  • Exceptional communication skills (both written and oral)
  • Ability to operate under minimal supervision and time constraints.

**MAY PERFORM OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED**


Location Eligibility

This role is open to candidates based in the following U.S. states:
Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Standard office environment, usually indoors away from the elements with moderate noise. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PHYSICALEFFORT

Maintain a stationary position for extended periods; move about the office, operate computers and files, as needed; and frequently communicate with others. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. Occasionally, the employee is required to lift boxes up to 20 pounds. 

SCHEDULING

This is a full-time benefits-eligible position, working Monday through Friday; 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. An employee in this position must be available to work occasionally on weekends and evenings, during peak periods

raw.description:
Description

About Us

﻿

Appdome is a fast-growing SaaS company specializing in innovative security, defense, anti-fraud and anti-bot solutions for mobile applications. We provide enterprise customers with cutting-edge AI-driven technology with a no-code solution and platform for building, releasing, monitoring, and managing Appdome-protected mobile applications. We are seeking an Enablement Engineer to support our customers in APAC.

In this role, you will focus on customer retention and growth by building trusted relationships, understanding customers’ security objectives, and driving successful outcomes.

The Enablement Engineer (EE) is a technical advocate for Appdome in pre-sales, trials, onboarding, and upsell engagements. This role partners with Sales and Service Delivery to demonstrate Appdome’s value, remove technical barriers, and enable prospects, partners, and customers to succeed with Appdome across their lifecycle.

In this role you will introduce Appdome to prospects and partners through compelling presentations and product demonstrations. Scope and qualify technical requirements for trials, proof of value (POVs), and customer onboarding. Lead POVs and technical evaluations, define success criteria, and guide customers toward successful outcomes. Drive adoption and expansion through onboarding workshops, training, and introductions to new offerings. Advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Service Delivery teams.

Enablement includes all pre-sales and upsell enablement, POV leadership, onboarding, training, and partner enablement, as well as active engagement with customers on new offerings.

Responsibilities:

﻿

As a Domain Expert:

﻿

  • Deliver Appdome platform demos and technical presentations.
  • Train partners and sales teams on positioning and technical usage.
  • Maintain updated CDA templates, RFP materials, and enablement assets.
  • Represent Appdome at partner events, webinars, and industry sessions.
  • Use Appdome product and new features with a critical eye, raise bugs, provide feedback, and suggest improvements to ensure product quality.

﻿Scoping & Pre-Sales Engagement:

﻿

  • Document prospect requirements in Hubspot with full technical context.
  • Draft scopes, validate with leadership, and ensure completeness for POVs.
  • Manage enablement engineering data entries, ensuring fields are updated in CRM.

Proof-of-Value (POV) Leadership:

﻿

  • Conduct POV preparation meetings, aligning on requirements and expectations.
  • Register POVs in Totango, manage trial teams, and coordinate with SDEs for technical setup.
  • Run POV workshops and trial wrap sessions.
  • Maintain close contact with prospects during trials, escalating technical issues to SDE as needed.

Sales & Upsell Support:

﻿

  • Support Sales Rep in verifying quote sheet scope when required.
  • Participate in pricing and commercial discussions where scope influences strategy.
  • Defend Appdome’s value during customer proposal meetings.
  • Lead enablement for new product offerings and upsell trials.

Onboarding & Go-Lives:

﻿

  • Lead kickoff calls, onboarding workshops, and training sessions.
  • Manage Totango entries for onboarding progress.
  • Collaborate with SDEs during go-lives, leading high-stakes or complex implementations and supporting standard ones.

Promote Enablement Function:

﻿

  • Develop training decks, onboarding content, and enablement sessions.
  • Provide ongoing partner and reseller enablement.
  • Serve as trusted technical point of contact for prospects and customers adopting new Appdome features.

Handoff Model with Service Delivery:

﻿

  • Trials: EE leads trial definition, scope, workshops, and prospect engagement. SDE manages technical team setup and ticket handling.
  • Onboarding: EE leads kickoff and workshops. SDE assumes long-term technical account management from that point.
  • Go-Lives: EE plays an active role in selective named accounts, SDE leads streamlined go-lives. SDETL provides escalation support.

Requirements

Core Technical & Domain Requirements

﻿

  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, including client-server communication, APIs, and SDK integration.
  • Hands-on experience with application security concepts such as encryption, authentication, certificate pinning, runtime protection, and threat models.

raw.description:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.

We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.

Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.

Why Verda

  • Cash and equity compensation along with various fringe benefits.

  • Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth.

  • 30+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.

  • A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

Practicalities

  • Work mode: Remote (EU)

  • Level: Mid / Senior

  • Employment type: Full time and permanent

About the role

GPUs only deliver value once they're wired into a cluster that researchers can actually train on. As our HPC Engineer, you'll own the baremetal and virtualized clusters behind our AI cloud - from the InfiniBand fabric and shared filesystems up through the workload orchestration layer. You'll be the person who keeps large-scale GPU clusters healthy, performant, and ready for the next workload.

Your responsibilities

  • Administer baremetal GPU/HPC clusters end to end, from provisioning through day-two operations

  • Administer virtualized clusters, including the hypervisor and GPU virtualization stack underneath them

  • Design, deploy, and tune InfiniBand fabrics, including topology planning, subnet management, and performance validation

  • Deploy and operate shared/parallel filesystems supporting training and inference workloads, balancing performance, capacity, and reliability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full fabric stack: fibers, transceivers, NICs, switches, drivers, and firmware

  • Partner with remote-hands and data center teams to diagnose hardware faults and execute physical-layer fixes and cluster expansions

  • Operate and tune Slurm (or equivalent) workload scheduling deployments used by customers and internal teams

  • Keep issue tracking, IPAM, and DCIM records accurate as clusters are built, changed, and decommissioned

  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for cluster-level issues

  • Collaborate with platform, network, and storage teams to integrate new clusters into the broader AI cloud

Your key competencies

  • Solid Linux skills, with specialization in memory management, PCIE topologies and virtualization being a bonus

  • Deep Infiniband knowledge, including fabric design, subnet management, and performance tuning

  • Solid experience with IB clustering, troubleshooting/debugging, understanding the ecosystem of fibers+transceivers+NICs+switches and all the things that could possibly fail in them

  • Experience about shared filesystems (e.g. Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, WekaFS, or similar)

  • Ability to work with remote hands teams to diagnose and resolve hardware issues remotely

  • Knowledge about NCCL, CUDA, DOCA and the Nvidia stack

  • Knowledge about Slurm and/or other workload scheduling solutions, bonus points for Slinky/slurm-bridge

  • Understanding the importance of keeping issue tracking/IPAM/DCIM up to date

  • Comfort operating production clusters where uptime and performance directly affect customer workloads

  • Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash, Ansible) for repeatable cluster operations

Nice to have

  • RoCEv2 knowledge (and/or Spectrum-X)

  • Understanding of agentic guardrails, especially when applied to administration of complex systems

  • Ability to think beyond what is needed right now vs. some given trajectory or roadmap

  • Experience with GPU health-checking and diagnostics tooling (e.g. DCGM, field diagnostics)

  • Experience with baremetal provisioning/orchestration tooling (e.g. MAAS, Foreman, custom PXE/iPXE pipelines)

  • Familiarity with GPU-aware virtualization or containerization (Kubernetes device plugins, KVM/QEMU with GPU passthrough, SR-IOV)

  • Exposure to observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) for cluster-level monitoring

What's next

We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.

Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don't accept applications sent by email.
