Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Salesforce Solutions Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $150,000–$190,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Salesforce Solutions Architect to design and govern enterprise Salesforce implementations across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and Industry Clouds. The role drives the technical strategy of complex, multi-org Salesforce environments, sets standards for security, integration, and customization, and partners with business stakeholders and engineering teams to deliver scalable, maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate has architected Salesforce at enterprise scale, holds strong opinions on declarative versus programmatic trade-offs, and brings deep platform mastery combined with practical architectural judgment.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of Salesforce experience, with significant time in architecture or technical leadership roles.
  • Deep expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components, and Flow.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce data model, sharing model, and platform limits.
  • Hands-on experience with complex Salesforce integrations.
  • Experience designing security models at enterprise scale.
  • Experience with Salesforce DX and modern DevOps tooling.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Salesforce Certified Application Architect or System Architect credentials.
  • Track record of leading large Salesforce programs end-to-end.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) credential.
  • Experience with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform.
  • Familiarity with Industry Clouds such as Financial Services Cloud or Health Cloud.
  • Exposure to Einstein AI / Agentforce features.
  • Experience with multi-org consolidation or M&A integrations.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to . Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

raw.description:
Department: Sales

Team: MWC Doha, Sales

Location: Doha/Dubai

Position type: 12 month rolling contract, Full-Time


What the hiring manager says


“MWC Doha launched to great fanfare and much acclaim in November 2025. We are now expanding our team to build on this success. We are looking for an exceptional sales professional who is articulate, driven and a credible salesperson. You will be selling and managing some strategic and important key accounts but will continue to drive outstanding performance from our dedicated MWC Doha Sales team.


You need to have bucket loads of diplomacy, enthusiasm, positivity, and dynamism to match and enhance the energy of the overall team. This is a challenging and fast paced role and requires someone who is used to multi-tasking, organised and a great communicator used to dealing with clients from the MENA region”


About the Team


This role would be part of a 50+ person sales team responsible for the commercial growth of GSMA Limited. The team sells across the flagship events; MWC Barcelona, Shanghai, Kigali as well as our M360 series and 4YFN events, Media, Intelligence and Industry Services platforms. We are truly global team with sales reps in Europe, Asia, China and the Americas with a collaborative, supportive and vibrant atmosphere. This specific role will be driving the revenue growth of MWC Doha.


About the Role


Duties will include, but are not limited to, the following:


  • Specifically tasked with managing and growing revenues for MWC Doha through sponsorship, exhibit, hospitality, digital and venue advertising sales
  • Managing inbound sponsorship and exhibition requests for both startups and larger entities
  • Assist in onboarding new clients to ensure they obtain the maximum value from their event participation
  • Identifying opportunities to cross-sell and upsell sponsorship and exhibition space and added value services to clients
  • Generating new business sales from both outbound leads (prospecting via Sales Navigator, attending local events etc) as well as inbound or marketing-generated sales leads
  • Providing weekly updates to the sales pipeline, tracking of metrics underpinning the sales funnel and sharing customer feedback on product performance/quality
  • Providing reports on demand in response to new business opportunities
  • Troubleshooting any client issue in a proactive manner liaising with marketing, operations, customer service and finance where necessary
  • The role will involve travel primarily in the MENA region to attend third party events for lead generation purposes

About You


  • You will have a passion for events, excel in sales, and able to collaborate across departments
  • You will have worked in the MENA region and have established local contacts
  • You are used to delivering a high quality service, hitting and exceeding sales targets, and fostering excellent relationships both internal and external
  • Knowledge of the connectivity and telco landscape would be an advantage but not a requirement
  • A hunter style skill set and motivated by winning new business or forging new partnerships is paramount
  • Able to create and write complex proposals fully harnessing the breadth of an opportunity
  • An autonomous approach to working and a self-starter attitude
  • Strong communication, interpersonal and presentation skills
  • This role requires travel so you need to see that as an opportunity and relish the global nature of the role

About Your Skills


Communication, Delivery, Teamwork, Influence, Stakeholder Management and Commercial Awareness are key core skills for this role. More information about these skills will be provided with the GSMA interview guide during interview process.


Contract type

Department Contractor

Worker type

Contingent Worker

What We Offer

Working at the GSMA offers you unparalleled access to the mobile industry. We offer a chance to truly shape the direction of mobile, whatever your role. By joining the GSMA, you will be exposed to a fast-paced rapidly evolving environment, working on global solutions, genuinely fascinating and industry-changing projects and a stimulating and dynamic environment designed to enable you to flourish.

In addition to architect-designed offices and competitive compensation, our benefits include fantastic learning & development opportunities, generous holiday allowances, four additional days off for professional development and many others.

To learn more about the GSMA, visit our career site, our LinkedIn page and our Twitter page.

Being You at the GSMA

We care deeply about diversity, equity and inclusivity and aspire to be the best at it. Your well-being and work/life balance is important, so flexi-time and remote working is available to all staff. We're keen to ensure everyone is equal, represented and connected so we particularly encourage applications from all demographics. The sucess of the GSMA year on year will continue to be contributed by people from all walks of life.

GSMA Values

Our values not only drive our culture – they shape how we work and interact inside and outside our global organisation.

Passionately driven

We approach everything we do with unparalleled capability, tenacity and commitment, knowing that the challenging scale, pace and complexity of our work is what leads to its world-changing impact.

Insightful leaders

We continually develop and engage our expertise, insight and creativity so that we’re always ready to respond to the changing landscape with authority, agility and nuance.

Stronger together

We lean on each other so the industry can lean on us, embracing our diversity by actively seeking out perspectives and skill sets beyond our own, fuelling each other’s successes and constantly asking how we can help.

Underpinning our values is our collective mindset to show up purposefully as good human beings every day, in every situation. When we’re at our best – we are collaborative, considerate and compassionate to others, and we create a safe space for one another to thrive, assuming positive intent in our colleagues. And if we aren’t at our best and the pressure is on – we feel free to be ourselves but still remain curious, lean into the tough stuff and we are always respectful to others and accountable for the part we play.

raw.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the InfoSec team
The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.

About the role
We are building the next generation of enterprise Identity and Access Management at Affirm. This role combines hands-on IAM operations, automation, and production software engineering to make identity services more reliable, scalable, and easier to operate.

You will help run core access lifecycle processes, troubleshoot production issues, and automate repetitive work. You will also build and maintain backend services, APIs, and integrations that connect identity platforms with internal systems.

Software engineering is a must-have. You will work primarily with SailPoint and enterprise identity integrations, with CIAM-adjacent Auth0 work where enterprise systems intersect with customer identity. This is a strong opportunity for an engineer who wants to develop deep IAM expertise without stepping away from hands-on coding.

What you’ll do

  • Run and improve IAM operations, including access lifecycle work, requests, certifications, and issue resolution

  • Automate repetitive processes with scripts, services, and workflow improvements

  • Build and maintain production backend software, APIs, tests, and integrations

  • Connect SailPoint and workforce identity events with internal systems

  • Build a paved path that enables Affirm employees to create modern internal tools with Auth0

  • Partner with Security, IT, and Engineering on secure, auditable changes

  • Maintain runbooks, operational metrics, and escalation support

Example problems you may work on:

  • Fixing a provisioning workflow and adding monitoring or retries

  • Reconciling access between source systems and SailPoint

  • Building an API integration for identity lifecycle events

  • Creating reusable Auth0 patterns, tooling, and documentation for internal applications

What we look for

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience or equivalent internship/co-op experience with strong projects

  • Ability to write, test, and operate production-quality backend code in Python or a similar language

  • Strong foundations in APIs, debugging, logging, error handling, and distributed systems

  • Experience with GitHub, CI/CD, testing, and code review

  • Comfort owning operational work and troubleshooting production issues

  • Familiarity with cloud environments; AWS preferred

  • Strong written communication and documentation skills

    Nice to Have

    • Exposure to IAM, IGA, SSO, SAML, OIDC, SCIM, RBAC, or identity governance

    • Experience with SailPoint, Auth0, Okta, OneLogin, or similar platforms

    • Experience with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools

    • Familiarity with audit or compliance environments

Base Pay Grade - L
Equity Grade - Canada 5

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $133,000 - $183,000 $CAD.

This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

At RTX, the world's largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.


The following position is to join our RTX Enterprise Services team:


RTX is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Documentum Technical Specialist to help design, plan, and implement an enterprise Documentum solution. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Documentum architecture and configuration and will play a key role in the delivery of a scalable and efficient enterprise content management (ECM) solution. This position requires strong technical, analytical, and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful outcomes.


What You Will Do

  • Lead the solution design and architecture of the enterprise Documentum solution, ensuring alignment with business requirements and industry best practices.
  • Conduct requirements gathering sessions with stakeholders to define document management needs and recommend optimal solutions.
  • Develop technical roadmaps and implementation plans for the Documentum environment.
  • Configure and deploy Documentum components, including Content Server, D2, xCP, Webtop, and other tools in the ecosystem.
  • Integrate Documentum with other enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, etc.) using appropriate APIs and middleware.
  • Ensure scalability, performance optimization, and secure access controls within the ECM solution.
  • Design and develop custom workflows, templates, and applications using Documentum tools and technologies.
  • Implement custom Documentum solutions using Java, DQL, DFS/REST APIs, or other applicable frameworks.
  • Collaborate with developers to create and maintain custom Documentum modules and components.
  • Provide technical expertise for troubleshooting, performance tuning, and issue resolution within the Documentum environment.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation, including process flows, and technical specifications.
  • Monitor system health and perform upgrades, patches, and configuration updates as needed.

Qualifications You Must have

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field with 10+ years of hands-on experience with Documentum products, including Content Server, D2, xCP, Webtop, or related components.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise content management principles and best practices.
  • Familiarity with database management systems (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server) and application servers (e.g., WebLogic, JBoss).
  • Experience with system integration, including knowledge of APIs, middleware, and enterprise systems with strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail with excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
  • Knowledge of records management, compliance, and regulatory requirements in ECM solutions.

What We Offer

Whether you’re just starting out on your career journey or are an experienced professional, we offer a robust total rewards package with compensation; healthcare, wellness, retirement and work/life benefits; career development and recognition programs. Some of the benefits we offer include parental (including paternal) leave, flexible work schedules, achievement awards, educational assistance and child/adult backup care.


Learn More & Apply Now!
Location: This position is remote.

Please consider the following role type definition as you apply for this role:
Remote: This position is currently designated as remote. Employees who are working in Remote roles will work primarily offsite (from home).

As part of our commitment to maintaining a secure hiring process, candidates may be asked to attend select steps of the interview process in-person at one of our office locations, regardless of whether the role is designated as on-site, hybrid or remote.

The salary range for this role is 132,400 USD - 251,600 USD. The salary range provided is a good faith estimate representative of all experience levels. Responsibilities:

  • Support business developers in implementing Compass Corporate components within their processes.

  • Provide 3rd-level technical support and investigate complex technical issues.
  • Perform migration, development, testing, maintenance and documentation activities.
  • Analyze incidents, develop fixes and contribute to platform reliability improvements.
  • Implement automation, performance optimization and technical remediation activities.
  • Prepare deployment artefacts and support production integration activities.
  • Participate in PI planning, sprint activities, technical refinement sessions and stakeholder demonstrations.
  • Contribute to technical governance, coordination meetings and decision tracking.

Specific knowledge, skills and expertise:

Frontend development

  • Proficiency in Angular, including modern concepts like Signals.
  • Good knowledge of building complex, modular client-side applications using modern. frameworks, Web Components, micro frontends and state management patterns.

· Understanding key design principles.

Backend development

  • Experience with leveraging AI agent technologies during development but also integrated with applications (MCP, Skills, AmazonQ/Kiro, Spec Driven development, context engineering).

Job Summary

The Director, Change Management - PMO is responsible for developing and leading enterprise change management strategies that support successful adoption of organizational transformation initiatives. This role establishes change management methodologies, tools, and standards and partners with executive leaders, project teams, Human Resources, Communications, and operational stakeholders to assess organizational impacts, prepare employees and leaders for change, and strengthen adoption and sustainability. The Director builds organizational change capability and ensures change strategies are integrated into enterprise transformation efforts.

Essential Functions

  • Develops and implements an enterprise change management strategy, methodology, tools, and governance framework.
  • Leads change management planning and execution for complex, enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.
  • Conducts organizational impact, readiness, and stakeholder assessments to identify change risks and adoption needs.
  • Develops integrated change strategies addressing stakeholder engagement, leadership alignment, communications, training, resistance management, and adoption.
  • Partners with executive sponsors and senior leaders to establish change leadership expectations and reinforce accountability for adoption.
  • Collaborates with project, transformation, Human Resources, Communications, Learning and Development, and operational teams to integrate change management into initiative planning and execution.
  • Establishes change readiness, adoption, engagement, and sustainability measures and monitors performance throughout implementation.
  • Identifies resistance and adoption barriers and develops strategies to address organizational and stakeholder concerns.
  • Builds change management capability by developing tools, resources, education, and coaching for leaders and project teams.
  • Leads change networks, champions, or other stakeholder engagement structures supporting major organizational initiatives.
  • Provides strategic guidance regarding the cumulative impact of organizational changes and supports coordination across concurrent initiatives.
  • Evaluates change management effectiveness and incorporates lessons learned into future transformation efforts.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Maintains regular and reliable attendance.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.
  • This is a remote opportunity with 15% travel (primarily to the Nashville, TN area)

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Organizational Development, Human Resources, Business Administration, Communications, Psychology, or a related field required
  • 8-10 years of experience in change management, organizational development, transformation, consulting, or a related field required
  • 5-7 years of experience leading complex organizational change initiatives required

Preferences:

  • Certified Change Management Professional highly preferred
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including the management, mentorship, and professional development of direct reports highly preferred
  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide transformation in a large, complex organization highly preferred
  • Healthcare industry experience preferred
  • Master's Degree preferred

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Comprehensive knowledge of organizational change management principles, methodologies, and adoption strategies.
  • Strong understanding of stakeholder engagement, organizational readiness, communications, training, and resistance management.
  • Ability to develop enterprise change strategies and translate transformation objectives into actionable change plans.
  • Strong consulting, facilitation, coaching, and influencing skills with the ability to engage leaders at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to assess organizational impacts and identify barriers to adoption and sustainability.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to develop and interpret change readiness and adoption measures.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex change initiatives in a highly matrixed environment.

raw.description:
Are you a U.S.-licensed psychologist passionate about leveraging technology to provide accessible, high-quality mental health care? We are a premier telehealth platform dedicated to connecting skilled psychologists with individuals, couples, and families seeking professional support. We are seeking compassionate and autonomous professionals to join our expanding network.

Our platform is designed for practitioners who value independence and flexibility. We handle the client acquisition, so you can dedicate your energy to what you do best: fostering healing and growth. Build your ideal private practice from anywhere in the U.S., on your own terms.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide High-Quality Teletherapy: Conduct evidence-based psychological services for individuals, couples, or families via a secure, HIPAA-compliant video platform, consistent with your scope of licensure and clinical expertise.
  • Maintain Compliant Clinical Records: Ensure all clinical documentation is accurate, comprehensive, and completed in a timely manner, adhering to HIPAA standards and the regulations of your licensing state(s).
  • Uphold Ethical & Legal Standards: Strictly adhere to the APA's Ethical Principles of Psychologists and Code of Conduct, all applicable state and federal laws, and best practices for telehealth confidentiality and security.
  • Manage Client Relationships: Foster a professional therapeutic environment by clearly communicating your practice policies, session fees, and scheduling directly with your clients.
  • Direct Financial Management: Independently establish your session rates, and manage all aspects of billing and payment directly with your clientele.

Requirements:

  • Education: A Doctoral degree (Ph.D. or Psy.D.) in Clinical, Counseling, or School Psychology from a program accredited by the American Psychological Association (APA).
  • Licensure: A current, unrestricted license to practice psychology independently in at least one state within the U.S. You are responsible for maintaining compliance with all inter-state telehealth laws and regulations.
  • Experience: A minimum of two years of post-licensure experience delivering psychotherapy and/or psychological assessments.
  • Telehealth Proficiency: Demonstrated competence in using secure telehealth technologies (e.g., SimplePractice, Doxy.me, Zoom for Healthcare) and experience with Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems.
  • Professional Liability: Must maintain an active professional liability (malpractice) insurance policy with coverage appropriate for your practice.
  • Independent Contractor Readiness: Must be prepared to operate as an independent contractor, managing your own schedule, taxes, and business-related expenses.

Required Skills:

  • Exceptional clinical, diagnostic, and case conceptualization skills.
  • Superior interpersonal and communication skills, with an emphasis on building therapeutic rapport remotely.
  • Deep empathy, cultural humility, and unwavering professionalism.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • A strong commitment to continuous professional growth and ethical practice.

What We Offer:

  • Complete Autonomy: You are in full control. Set your own schedule, determine your caseload, and work the hours that fit your life (from 5 to 30+ hours per week).
  • Financial Control: Set your own session fees based on your expertise and market. Clients pay you directly, ensuring you retain 100% of your earnings. We take no commission.
  • Steady Stream of Referrals: Gain access to a diverse pool of clients actively seeking therapy. Our marketing efforts connect you with clients who are a good fit for your specialties, at no cost to you.
  • Work From Anywhere: Enjoy the freedom to work from your home or office, as long as you are located in a state where you are licensed to practice.
  • Focus on Clinical Excellence: We reduce your administrative burden by managing client outreach and platform technology, allowing you to concentrate on providing outstanding clinical care.
  • Free & Transparent Partnership: There are no sign-up costs, membership fees, or hidden charges. Our goal is to support your practice, not profit from it.

How to Join Our Network:

  1. Submit Your Application: Complete our online application form and create your professional profile, highlighting your qualifications, specialties, and therapeutic approach.
  2. Credential Verification: Upload your verification documents, including your doctoral degree, state license(s), and proof of liability insurance, for review by our credentialing team.
  3. Onboarding: Once verified, you will be invited to an onboarding session to familiarize yourself with the platform and best practices.
  4. Start Connecting: Set your availability and begin receiving client requests. You will manage all communications, scheduling, and payments directly.

If you are a driven, licensed psychologist ready to embrace the future of mental healthcare and build a thriving remote practice, we encourage you to apply and join our community of dedicated professionals.

Salary: $50 – $100 / hour

raw.description:
Computer World Services, Corp. (CWS) seeks a Virtualization / Automation Engineer to operate, maintain, automate, and improve the virtualization and Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) platforms supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program, including VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX, Site Recovery Manager (SRM), and associated Infrastructure as Code capabilities.

The role focuses on the hypervisor and SDDC platform layers across production, development, test, COOP, disaster-recovery, and hybrid-hosting environments; guest operating systems, applications, databases, and cloud workloads remain with their respective teams. The engineer also supports the transition of applicable services to centralized DISA-hosting platforms through discovery, migration support, validation, and stabilization.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Configure, administer, and maintain virtualization clusters, including vSphere HA, DRS, resource pools, hosts, datastores, and distributed switches, and manage ESXi and vCenter patching, upgrades, and certificates.
    • Monitor platform capacity, availability, performance, and compliance, and recommend scaling, balancing, or remediation actions.
    • Configure and support vSAN clusters, storage policies, and fault domains, and troubleshoot vSAN performance, resynchronization, and policy-compliance issues.
    • Configure and support NSX segments, transport zones, gateways, routing, and distributed security controls, coordinating changes with network and cybersecurity teams.
    • Administer SRM protection groups and recovery plans, execute and document failover and failback tests, and support quarterly COOP exercises and continuity events.
    • Develop and maintain infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, PowerCLI, or APIs, with version control, peer review, testing, rollback, secrets protection, and drift detection.
    • Coordinate with workload owners on resource requirements, placement, templates, and snapshots, preserving the division between platform and workload ownership.
    • Provide advanced engineering support for cross-platform incidents, isolate platform faults during outages, and collect evidence for root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
    • Maintain platform configuration backups, apply DISA STIGs and security baselines, and support RMF evidence, vulnerability remediation, and vendor-advisory reviews.
    • Support technology refreshes and modernization; contribute to capacity, lifecycle, and modernization assessments.
    • Support DISA-hosting transitions through discovery, dependency documentation, readiness assessment, test and rollback plans, cutover, and post-migration stabilization.
    • Maintain architecture diagrams, as-built documentation, SOPs, and recovery procedures, and provide platform metrics and modernization status for program reporting.

Education & Experience

    Required:

    • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the labor category.
    • Minimum of six (6) years of relevant experience in virtualization, systems engineering, data-center infrastructure, platform engineering, or infrastructure automation.
    • Hands-on experience with VMware vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter and with vSAN, NSX, SRM, or comparable software-defined storage, network-virtualization, and disaster-recovery technologies.
    • Experience developing or maintaining infrastructure-automation solutions and troubleshooting issues across compute, storage, network, virtualization, and automation layers.
    • Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, capacity management, and lifecycle practices.
    • Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

      • Preferred:

      • Formal Terraform and Ansible training.
      • Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation or VMware Aria, and PowerCLI, PowerShell, Python, or REST APIs.
      • Experience supporting federal or DoD virtualization environments and migrations to DISA enterprise-hosting platforms.
      • Experience with DISA STIGs, RMF controls, vulnerability remediation, and configuration compliance.
      • Experience developing Infrastructure as Code within CI/CD and Git workflows with automated testing and code scanning.

Certifications

    • Required: None.
    • Preferred: VMware Certified Professional, HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate, Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation, ITIL 4 Foundation, or relevant cloud, security, storage, or network certification.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret clearance or higher is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    Work Environment / Travel:

    • Remote position; Chicago, IL–area candidates preferred.
    • Occasional on-site support, after-hours maintenance, disaster-recovery exercises, incident response, and travel may be required.

      • Administrative Notes:

      Period of Performance: March 1, 2027 – February 28, 2033

      Contract Start Date: March 1, 2027

raw.description:
Resumen

Buscamos un Ingeniero de Migración de Infraestructura, apasionado por acompañar a clientes de misión crítica en la evolución de sus cargas de trabajo hacia entornos Cloud Native. Te integrarás a nuestro equipo de Servicios Profesionales para liderar la transición de máquinas virtuales (VMware) hacia plataformas basadas en KVM. Valoramos perfiles rigurosos, con sólidas bases de administración Linux y diagnóstico en producción, pensamiento analítico y una búsqueda constante de las mejores estrategias para resolver problemas complejos de infraestructura y asegurar migración de alta disponibilidad sin downtime.

El rol requiere la capacidad de desenvolverse en entornos internacionales y multiculturales, así como el interés genuino por formar parte de una organización con una cultura técnica exigente, orientada a la excelencia arquitectónica y a la adopción de nuevas tecnologías.

La posición implica trabajar estrechamente con equipos técnicos de empresas líderes en los mercados chileno y peruano, participando activamente en la migración de cargas de trabajo desde entornos tradicionales de virtualización hacia plataformas Cloud modernas basadas en Kubernetes.

Si buscas desarrollar tu carrera en Cloud y proyectarte hacia un rol de Arquitecto de Soluciones, esta es una oportunidad concreta para acelerar tu crecimiento profesional, enfrentando desafíos reales y de alto impacto.

Modalidad remota, con base en las ciudades Santiago (Chile) o Lima (Perú), para poder asistir a reuniones presenciales con clientes según sus necesidades.

Responsabilidades

  • Trabajar estrechamente con los clientes, comprendiendo en profundidad las arquitecturas de sistemas de misión crítica actualmente desplegadas sobre VMware, y elaborando documentación de arquitectura clara y precisa.

  • Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de migración de las aplicaciones hacia nuevos entornos Cloud, considerando criterios de afinidad y anti-afinidad de máquinas virtuales, dependencias técnicas y requisitos operacionales. Esto incluye la ejecución de ensayos progresivos de migración utilizando la plataforma Whitestack Chrysara.

  • Liderar la ejecución de las migraciones de aplicaciones previamente validadas hacia los nuevos entornos, coordinando y operando dentro de ventanas de mantenimiento, asegurando continuidad operacional y mínimos riesgos.

  • Ejecutar procesos de validación automática de cargas de trabajo, analizando los resultados para confirmar el rollout o activar mecanismos de rollback automático, según corresponda.

  • Realizar troubleshooting avanzado de incidentes reportados durante el despliegue o la operación inicial de las aplicaciones, cuando estos estén relacionados con la infraestructura Cloud.

  • Diseñar y ejecutar pruebas de escenarios específicos requeridos por cada aplicación, tanto en ambientes pre productivos como mediante la adecuación de entornos en laboratorios propios.

  • Documentar, mantener y actualizar de forma continua la información de infraestructura y arquitectura Cloud asociada a cada aplicación migrada.

  • Proveer retroalimentación técnica a los equipos internos, proponiendo mejoras y optimizaciones que incrementen la eficiencia, repetibilidad y confiabilidad de los procesos de despliegue y migración de aplicaciones.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiencia

  • 3 años de experiencia en administración intermedia de Linux, administrando sistemas en entornos productivos.

  • 2 años de experiencia en plataformas de virtualización, tales como VMware ESXi, KVM o tecnologías equivalentes.

  • Experiencia participando en discusiones técnicas con clientes, explicando decisiones arquitectónicas y operativas de forma clara y fundamentada.

  • Experiencia en la documentación de información técnica, incluyendo arquitecturas, procedimientos y planes de operación.

  • Formación

    • Título profesional en Ingeniería Informática, Ingeniería de Sistemas, Ingeniería Electrónica, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o carreras afines.

  • Conocimientos específicos (en orden de prioridad)

    • Administración Linux Intermedio (60%)

      • Buenos conocimientos de sistemas operativos, procesos y concurrencia, filesystems.

      • Importante haber hecho troubleshootings reales del filesystem o de la red (mtr, ip, ss, lsof, tcpdump, df, lsblk, iostat, strace)

      • Experiencia en scribir scripts de mantenimiento o automatización (Bash), recuperar password root, diagnósticos de carga básica, etc.

    • Virtualización Básico (20%)

      • Virtualización basada en KVM, XEN o similar.

    • Networking Básico (10%)

      • Fundamentos de Networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, routing básico).

      • Poder entender y solucionar problemas sencillos

    • Storage Enterprise (10%)

      • Conocimientos en plataformas a nível básico almacenamiento empresarial.

        • Experiencia con montajes block (SAN como Pure Storage, Huawei Dorado), files (NAS como Dell PowerScale, Netapp FAS), objects (S3, Ceph)

        • Entender los protocolos que se usan para cada tipo.

Requisitos deseables

  • Certificaciones en linux o tecnologías Cloud (K8S, Rancher, Ceph)

  • Conocimiento básico en Infraestructura como código

    • Saber ejecutar despliegues con Ansible y/o Terraform

    • Aplicar flujo de CICD para despliegues

Requisitos profesionales

  • Autonomía (para lograr los mejores resultados)

  • Rigurosidad y adherencia a estándares de clase mundial.

  • Curiosidad y apertura al aprendizaje de nuevas tecnologías

  • Pensamiento analítico y resolución de problemas complejos:

  • Trabajo en equipo y colaboración.

  • Flexibilidad operativa: Disponibilidad para participar en ventanas de mantenimiento, interviniendo sistemas críticos fuera del horario laboral cuando sea necesario.

Sobre nosotros

Whitestackes una empresa líder en Latinoamérica especializada en soluciones en la nube e infraestructura digital híper-escalable. Trabajamos con tecnología de código abierto y los más altos estándares de la industria para impulsar la transformación digital en toda la región. Somos un Great Place to Work, donde la innovación, la colaboración y el desarrollo personal son parte de nuestra esencia.

¿Por qué unirte a Whitestack?

🌎 Proyección internacional: Participa en iniciativas globales y viaja para colaborar con equipos en distintos países.
⚖️ Equilibrio real: Diseñamos políticas que se ajustan a tu estilo de vida y te permiten trabajar con autonomía y propósito.
📈 Crecimiento claro: Te ofrecemos una línea de carrera sólida en liderazgo y tecnología.
Salud primero: Seguro médico privado para ti y tu familia.
📚 Aprendizaje sin límites: Acceso a cursos, libros, materiales y reembolso de certificaciones.
🌐 Idiomas para el mundo: Cursos de idiomas para que tu crecimiento no tenga fronteras.
💻 Tecnología en tus manos: Renovamos tu equipo cada 3 años... ¡y es tuyo al finalizar el período!
🏆 Reconocimiento al esfuerzo: Bonos por rendimiento y éxito en proyectos.
🎉 Tiempo para ti: 15 días de vacaciones mínimo, un día libre por tu cumpleaños y descansos extra antes de Fiestas Patrias, Navidad y Año Nuevo.
🤝 Conexión y diversión: Presupuesto para actividades recreativas e integración.
💡 Cultura de innovación: Tus ideas importan. Promovemos la participación estratégica desde cualquier rol.

Descripción del puesto

En The Whiteam Consulting buscamos un/a Consultor/a ServiceNow CMDB & Discovery con al menos2 años de experiencia en la administración y evolución de plataformas ServiceNow. La persona seleccionada participará en iniciativas relacionadas con la gestión de la CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, automatización de procesos e integraciones, contribuyendo a la mejora y optimización de los servicios de TI en entornos corporativos.

Responsabilidades

  • Gestión de usuarios, grupos, roles, ACL, SLA, reglas de asignación...

  • Implementación de catálogos de servicios personalizados para gestionar todo tipo de solicitudes: incidentes, solicitudes de cambio, defectos...

  • Personalización de instancias mediante scripts propios (JavaScript / API de SN): reglas de negocio, inclusiones de scripts, scripts de cliente, acciones de interfaz de usuario.

  • Integraciones de correo electrónico.

  • Desarrollo de integraciones con SN mediante REST.

  • Desarrollo de módulos propios (creación de tablas, índices, menús y toda la lógica asociada, como flujos de trabajo, ACL, scripts...).

  • Diseño e implementación de flujos de trabajo personalizados para solicitudes de cambio, mejoras...

  • Mantenimiento general de la instancia, como la aplicación de correcciones mediante conjuntos de actualizaciones, la actualización a nuevas versiones o la clonación de instancias.

  • Generación de informes.

  • Implementación y gestión de servidores MID para Discovery.

  • Creación de Schedules, Comportamientos, Clusters, Clasificadores...

  • Mantenimiento de la CMDB (Estado de la CMDB). · Integración de SN Discovery con soluciones.

Requisitos

  • Capacidad para comprender, modificar y crear JavaScript orientado a objetos, scripting Unix Shell y Windows scripting y PowerShell del lado del servidor.

  • Conocimiento de redes de CCNA incluirá protocolos de enrutamiento, transmisión TCP / UDP, diagnóstico de tránsito IP, subredes e implementar solución de problemas avanzada, incluida la capacidad de recopilar y analizar datos a nivel de paquete IP.

  • Conocimiento de administración de servidores en todas las plataformas de sistemas operativos, incluida la comprensión de las estructuras de dominio, los niveles de permisos de usuario, los objetos de política de grupo y la ejecución de políticas SUDO.

  • Comprensión de las aplicaciones de negocio y su funcionalidad en el modelo ITIL.

  • Amplio conocimiento general de la topología de la infraestructura de TI, incluidas las configuraciones típicas de aplicaciones, servidores y redes.

  • Comprensión del modelo ServiceNow CSDM.

  • Liderazgo de equipos de trabajo

  • Comunicación fluida

Requisitos técnicos

  • Capacidad para comprender, modificar y desarrollar JavaScript orientado a objetos.

  • Conocimientos en la gestión y configuración del modulo CMDB de ServiceNow y con DiscoveryyService Mapping, ITSM, ITOM, ACL, Service Catalog, SECOPS, entre otros.

  • Experiencia con las principales APIs Glide de ServiceNow.

  • Desarrollo y mantenimiento de Script Includes en ServiceNow.

  • Implementación y gestión de Business Rules en ServiceNow.

  • Valorable experiencia en scripting del lado servidor con Unix Shell.

  • Valorable experiencia en PowerShell y Batch Script en entornos Windows.

  • Conocimientos de administración de servidores en entornos Linux y Windows.

  • Conocimiento de estructuras de dominio y gestión de permisos de usuario en Linux.

  • Experiencia con Group Policy Objects (GPOs) y ejecución de políticas SUDO.

  • Administración básica de Active Directory.

  • Conocimientos de LDAP.

  • Administración de servicios en Windows: arranque, parada y configuración de modos de inicio.

Formación y certificaciones requeridas

  • Certificación ServiceNow: System Administration

  • Certificación ServiceNow: Discovery

  • Certificación ServiceNow: Service Mapping.

  • Curso ServiceNow Fundamentals.

  • Curso ServiceNow Discovery Fundamentals.

  • Cursos CMDB & CSDM Fundamentals.

  • Certificación ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA).

Deseables

  • Certificación CIS-DF

  • Certificación CIS-ITSM

  • Certificación CAD

Compañía

Formar parte de THEWHITEAM es colaborar con una empresa formada por profesionales con una dilatada experiencia en consultoría tecnológica.

Creemos firmemente que las empresas y clientes marcan el camino a seguir en el sector, pero éste lo construyen las personas. Consideramos de vital importancia que nuestra organización se fundamente en nuestro mejor activo y marca de valor añadido que es nuestro equipo humano.

Beneficios

Por otra parte, te dejo también un pequeño resumen de políticas de la compañía para que nos vayas conociendo un poco mejor:

• Tenemos 23 días de vacaciones al año

raw.description:
Updated/Reviewed 04.17.26

Interviewer

Job Industry: Charity / Social Services / Non- Profit Organization

Position Name: Volunteer Interviewer for Dog Rescue - Volunteer (Unpaid)

Job Location: Spokane, Washington, United States

Job Type: Part Time

Office Setting: Fully Remote

Remote: Yes

Compensation: Volunteer

Hours Per Week: 5 (flexible)

Role Mission

Path of Hope relies on volunteers heavily to achieve our mission. Due to the nature of volunteering, we have a high turnover of candidates. Your role is to support the continuous flow of qualified volunteers to fill open roles in the Rescue. You will interview candidates and assess whether they can integrate into the Rescue and effectively complete the role and duties as assigned.

What Winning Looks Like

Key Results Area #1 - Roles

  • Familiar with organization structure of the Rescue

  • Familiar with job descriptions and seeks to understand the purpose of each role in order to offer alternative roles, when it's determined that skills would be better suited to a different role

Key Results Area #2 - Self Motivated Work Ethic

  • Keep and update your personal schedule

  • Adherence to interview schedules with minimal rescheduling

  • Daily check ins with remote platform and leader

Key Results Area #2 - Interview Process

  • Conduct 30-minute phone interviews effectively, ensuring all key questions are covered while maintaining a professional and engaging experience for candidates.

  • Assess the suitability of candidates for specific volunteer roles based on their skills, availability, and alignment with the Rescue's Core Values and the role's Key Results Areas

  • Detailed interview notes and recommendations for each candidate.

  • Timely follow-up with team leads for role placement within 24 hours of the interview.

Needed Skills

  • Must love dogs and people. We can't save dogs without talented people.

  • Active listening with conversational style. Ability to listen for context clues on what type of role would be a good fit.

  • Self motivated without needing a leader to keep you on task

  • Manage your schedule and keep up to date. Daily check ins via remote chat

Unique Company Culture and Mission

Our Mission

At Path of Hope Rescue we save pregnant dogs and puppies from high kill shelters in the Southern United States.

Our Spokane, Washington based Rescue strives to decrease the euthanasia rate of high risk dogs in the southern United States by transporting pregnant dogs and puppies to the Pacific Northwest to find adoptive homes. We do not have a kennel or building location and are 100% foster based. We currently have two paid employees and rely heavily on volunteers and fosters as we work to build out our paid staff roles.

Our Vision.
Eliminating euthanasia of dogs in the South by decreasing the amount of dogs breeding unchecked and becoming the number one 'dog destination' in Spokane by capitalizing on Spokane's love of Rescue Dogs.

Core Values:

Transparency - sharing the good with the bad

Community - dog loving people who treat each other well

Integrity - doing what you say will do

Golden Rule - treating others how you would want to be treated

Our Company Culture

We are freedom loving American Patriots who love dogs, love freedom and love Jesus.

No NGO status here, we don't take a single penny from the government. We are 100% funded by small donors and our adoption program, with a few small private grants here and there. We built this organization from the ground up in 2018 with $87.

We are built tough and believe that hard work pays off. We're about rolling up our sleeves and taking responsibility for our own actions. We don't do drama. There are no victims here and the system isn't out to get you, the only thing standing in your way is you and your attitude. We reward merit, not DEI or pronouns. We don't bend to the cultural rot out there.

At the core of who we are, we love dogs. At PHR you will find people who recognize your dog before they recognize you. Where it's normal for your dog to have his own Instagram and people who expect to be invited to your dog's birthday party. We are focused on building a strong, positive community, one dog and one person at a time.

We know dogs are family and should be treated that way. And we are driven by a shared passion to make sure every dog who isn't being loved, finds their way to a family. We care for each other and have created a community of people who love making a difference in this world.

Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered online mental healthcare clinic operating in the United States. For over six years, we've been developing our telemedicine platform to make mental healthcare more accessible, efficient, and scalable.

Our Marketing team helps connect patients with mental healthcare through paid and organic acquisition. Working within our cross-functional Demand and Supply group, we focus on growing demand efficiently while balancing marketing performance with provider availability across US states.

We're looking for a second Marketing Data Analyst to help improve marketing measurement, analyze acquisition performance, and identify growth opportunities.

This is a data-driven role combining marketing analytics, hands-on web analytics, and a strong business mindset. You'll work with data from multiple sources, improve tracking and attribution, investigate conversion bottlenecks, and translate analytical insights into actionable recommendations.

Initially, you'll help strengthen our web analytics and data quality. Over time, your focus will expand toward deeper marketing analysis, experimentation, and optimizing acquisition investments.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze the performance of paid and organic marketing channels and individual campaigns.
  • Own and improve web analytics tracking, including event tracking, conversion tracking, and data collection across marketing channels.
  • Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Data Layer to ensure accurate and reliable marketing data.
  • Monitor marketing attribution, investigate data discrepancies, and resolve measurement gaps in collaboration with engineering teams.
  • Support the implementation and optimization of server-side tracking, considering healthcare data privacy and compliance requirements.
  • Forecast marketing efficiency and help optimize paid marketing spend across channels, campaigns, and markets, considering provider availability and capacity.
  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor acquisition performance, conversion funnels, CAC, ROAS, and LTV.
  • Plan, launch, monitor, and analyze A/B experiments, identifying opportunities to improve conversion and marketing efficiency.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in Data Analytics, with strong and recent hands-on experience in Marketing Analytics, Web Analytics, or Growth Analytics.
  • Proven experience in B2C web marketing analytics, including website acquisition, conversion funnels, and marketing performance optimization.
  • Experience working with the US market, preferably in established international product companies.
  • Strong experience analyzing paid acquisition channels, particularly Google Ads, Meta Ads, or similar performance marketing platforms.
  • Deep understanding of marketing metrics and unit economics, including CAC, CPA, ROAS, ROI, LTV, conversion rates, and acquisition efficiency.
  • Hands-on experience with web analytics and tracking, including GA4, GTM, Data Layer, event tracking, and conversion tracking.
  • Solid understanding of marketing attribution, client-side and server-side tracking, cookies, consent management, and privacy-related measurement challenges.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills for independent data analysis, with an understanding of ETL processes.
  • Experience with event-based analytics platforms such as PostHog, GA4, Mixpanel, or similar tools, and BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
  • Strong knowledge of statistics, probability, A/B testing, and hypothesis validation.
  • Strong analytical and business mindset: ability to independently identify performance bottlenecks, investigate root causes, and translate data into actionable recommendations.
  • Ability to independently own analytical projects and confidently communicate findings to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Fluent Russian and advanced English (C1 preferred, strong B2+ acceptable) for regular collaboration with English-speaking colleagues.
  • Proficiency in using LLMs in daily work, with the ability to critically evaluate their output.
  • Ability to work CET/CEST overlapping hours under a long-term B2B contract using personal equipment.

Would Be a Plus:

  • Previous hands-on experience in Performance Marketing, Growth Marketing, or User Acquisition.
  • Experience with healthcare, HealthTech, fintech, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience with supply-demand analytics, capacity planning, or marketplace analytics.
  • Hands-on experience with privacy-conscious tracking, server-side GTM, conversion APIs, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with SEO analytics and organic acquisition performance.
  • Experience with Airflow or dbt.

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 3 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.

Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

﻿MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Agility's commercially deployed humanoids operate alongside teams in warehouses, manufacturing facilities, and distribution centers—tackling physically demanding and repetitive tasks while enabling workers to focus on higher-value work. With industry-leading safety standards and years of proven deployment data, we're pioneering a new era of automation that enhances human potential.

About the Work:

As Agility scales, our marketing organization requires operational discipline, rigorous execution, and seamless cross-functional alignment to bring our GTM vision to life. As Senior Manager, Marketing Programs, you will design and drive the operating engine for the marketing team.

Acting as a strategic arm to our marketing leadership team, you will translate high-level company and marketing goals into clear operational plans, cross-functional program cadences, and measurable business outcomes. In this role, you will manage a high-performing team, oversee the marketing budget and OKR tracking, scale our operational processes, and partner directly with leadership to keep the entire function moving with speed, alignment, and accountability.

What You’ll Do

  • Strategic Planning and Execution: Partner closely with the VP of Marketing to keep the department aligned on top strategic priorities, support creation of planning artifacts, stakeholder presentations, and coordinate department reporting.
  • Design & Run the Marketing Operating Cadence: Own the quarterly and annual planning process, OKR tracking, budget allocation, and operational reviews.
  • Team Leadership and Development: Direct and guide the work of marketing team members, establish priorities and performance expectations, provide coaching and feedback, and support talent development and performance management.
  • Orchestrate Complex, Cross-Functional Programs: Lead and program-manage major cross-functional initiatives that engage multiple marketing functions (e.g., flagship events, multi-touch product launches, integrated GTM campaigns) from planning to execution and post-program evaluation.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Marketing, Sales, Product, and other business leaders to align program priorities, messaging, timelines, and resources with company and go-to-market objectives.
  • Scale Marketing Operations & Infrastructure: Continually optimize operating processes, documentation, SLAs, and intake systems to improve execution velocity and consistency across a scaling team.
  • Resource and Budget Management: Oversee program resources, budgets, and external partners, prioritizing investments and balancing competing needs to achieve business objectives.
  • Performance Measurement: Establish program goals and performance metrics, evaluate results, and communicate outcomes, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Marketing Operations and Continuous Improvement: Establish scalable processes, operating practices, and reporting mechanisms that improve coordination, execution, and consistency across marketing programs.
  • Stakeholder and Executive Communication: Communicate program strategy, progress, and results to stakeholders, influencing priorities and decisions through sound judgment and data-informed recommendations.

What Success Looks Like

  • Operational Excellence: A predictable, transparent planning and execution rhythm where programs launch on time, on budget, and hit target metrics.
  • Seamless Alignment: Clear line-of-sight across program priorities, timelines, and deliverables, eliminating siloes and last-minute fire drills.
  • Optimized Resource Allocation: Maximized ROI on budget, vendor, and team capacity through rigorous planning, performance tracking, and proactive agency management.
  • Scalable Infrastructure: Well-documented, repeatable playbooks and modern workflows that allow the team to scale output.

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in marketing, integrated marketing programs, demand generation, or a related discipline, preferably in a B2B technology or high-growth environment.
  • Experience leading and developing teams, including setting priorities, providing performance feedback, and supporting employee development.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs spanning multiple marketing disciplines or areas of expertise.

  • Ability to establish program objectives and performance metrics, interpret results, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Strong project and operational management skills, with the ability to balance strategic priorities and execution across multiple initiatives.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, make decisions, and lead through ambiguity in a fast-paced environment.

The Agility Fit

  • Trust: You listen as much as you talk and take responsibility for collective success.
  • Adaptability: You’re smart with resources, focus on outcomes, and can pivot effectively as our industry evolves.

About First Due

First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end-to-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

Job Title: Enterprise Implementation Manager

Location: Remote - US Only
Country: United States
Department: Professional Services
Reports To: Sr Director, Enterprise Professional Services
Position Type: Full-Time
Salary: $100,000

Job Summary:

The Implementation Manager, Enterprise owns end-to-end delivery of First Due's Enterprise implementation programs, the largest and most complex engagements in the US customer base. These are multi-module, multi-phase deployments for large fire and EMS agencies, involving computer-aided dispatch integrations, significant historical data migration from legacy records management systems, and layered stakeholder environments spanning command staff, information technology, the dispatch center, EMS, fire prevention, training, labor representation, and municipal government.

This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. The Implementation Manager coordinates a delivery team of Implementation Consultants and Technical Services resources, owns the program plan and the customer relationship, and is accountable for delivery quality, timeline integrity, and scope control across an assigned portfolio. The role is expected to run programs on formal project management discipline and to use AI tooling to remove routine work from delivery so that judgment, domain expertise, and executive presence carry the majority of the incumbent's time.

Key Responsibilities:

Program delivery and governance

  • Own delivery of an assigned portfolio of Enterprise programs from sales transition through configuration, integration, data migration, training, go-live, and Customer Success transition.
  • Build and maintain program plans in Rocketlane, including critical path, workstream dependencies, module-level exit criteria, level-of-effort actuals, and risk and decision records.
  • Sequence go-live events around agency operational readiness, and recover at-risk or stalled programs with a documented path to resolution or closure.
  • Publish weekly program status covering schedule health against plan, open risks with named owners and dates, and decisions required.
  • Own change control, and validate the sales transition ahead of kickoff so that scope, contract commitments, and go-live expectations are confirmed before the program starts.

Stakeholder and executive engagement

  • Lead engagements involving large, multi-department stakeholder groups, commonly including the fire chief and command staff, information technology and cybersecurity, the dispatch center, EMS and medical direction, the training division, the fire prevention bureau, labor representation, and municipal government.
  • Lead change adoption for constituencies that experience the platform differently, including shift-based personnel, represented workforces on scheduling and time capture, and volunteer or combination staffing models.

AI-enabled delivery

  • Use First Due's AI tooling to remove routine delivery work, including status drafting, meeting summarization and action item capture, first-pass plan generation, and risk synthesis across concurrent workstreams.
  • Apply AI-assisted analysis to program preparation, including legacy data assessment, first-pass migration field mapping, and agency-specific discovery sets, and act on Rocketlane forecasting signals to catch schedule slippage before a milestone is missed.
  • Own the accuracy of any AI-assisted output that reaches an agency, and handle customer data within First Due's data handling standards.

Commercial ownership and product partnership

  • Deliver against contracted services scope, hours, and fees, and bring a recommended commercial position to segment leadership when overrun risk appears.
  • Draft and negotiate change orders in partnership with segment leadership, Sales, and the agency, including effort justification and revised schedule impact.
  • Review statements of work and solicitation responses for delivery feasibility before commitment
  • Surface field-driven enhancement requests to segment leadership and the Product organization, with reproducible detail and business impact.

Qualifications:

  • Seven or more years of customer-facing implementation, professional services, or program management experience in a SaaS environment, including ownership of multi-workstream programs with phased deployment across more than one department on the customer side.
  • Strong public safety industry knowledge, with emphasis on fire service operations and EMS, including how agencies are organized, funded, and governed.
  • Proven ability to lead large, multi-department stakeholder groups, including executive sponsors, technical staff, and represented or shift-based workforces.
  • Formal project management discipline, including baselined scheduling, critical path management, risk and issue tracking, documented change control, and structured status reporting.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tooling within a delivery or program management workflow, with the judgment to know where output is reliable and where human validation is required.
  • Experience translating agency operational and regulatory requirements into software delivery scope.
  • Excellent executive-level written and verbal communication, including the ability to deliver unwelcome information to senior customer stakeholders without damaging the relationship.
  • Experience with Rocketlane or a comparable professional services delivery platform.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products, including Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, Word, and Excel).
  • Ability to travel to customer sites, team events, and company offsites, up to 25 percent.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • PMP, or equivalent professional project or program management certification.
  • Experience delivering programs to public sector or government customers, including procurement, security review, and compliance processes.
  • Experience delivering within a formal program management or delivery governance function at a SaaS organization.
  • Change management certification or formal change adoption methodology experience.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce, including account data hygiene and project handoff from sales.
  • Direct hands-on experience with Rocketlane.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
