raw.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager

Remote (minimum 4-hour overlap with US Eastern hours) | Marketing | Reports to: Director, Revenue Marketing

Time Doctor is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the marketing-led customer journey from the moment an account starts paying. You will decide who hears what, when, based on which behaviour, and toward which commercial outcome. Your job is to turn customer behaviour and usage signals into adoption, retention, expansion and reactivation revenue, and to run that engine AI-first, building agents and agentic workflows that do real work.

Who we are

Time Doctor is a workforce analytics platform that gives distributed teams the visibility they need to improve trust and performance. We serve remote, hybrid and outsourced organisations worldwide, with particular strength in BPO, healthcare and tech services. We are bootstrapped, profitable and fully remote, with team members across 30+ countries. We built a durable business on customer revenue rather than venture capital, and we are now focused on growing it.

The role

You will own the lifecycle marketing program for our paying customers: the 30/60/90 onboarding plays, ongoing customer communications, customer segmentation, and the expansion and retention plays that grow and keep the base. You design the journeys, brief the work, QA it and measure it, and you own the revenue outcome.

Three things define this seat.

  • The number. Your primary measure is the qualified expansion and cross-sell opportunities Lifecycle generates and surfaces. Expansion revenue, net revenue retention and at-risk recovery sit right behind it, shared with CS, Sales and Product.

  • The lane. You own orchestration and outcomes across the customer base, not every surface you touch. PMM owns the message, GTM Ops builds the scoring and routing, and Growth and CS co-define the signals with you. You make it all work together.

  • The operating model. This is an AI-first role, and AI fluency is the job. The bar is that you can stand up an agent that does real work, not describe one. Accelerating Time Doctor's AI-first operating model is an explicit expectation of the seat.

This is a systems role. You build repeatable, automated journeys rather than one-off campaigns, and you keep human ownership of segmentation logic, offer design, guardrails, final QA and the commercial call.

Who you are

  • You treat a revenue number as yours, and you design every journey toward adoption, retention or expansion.

  • You have high agency. When a journey underperforms, you find out why and fix it.

  • You are commercially minded. You turn customer signals into revenue.

  • You are analytical and cohort-fluent. You read behaviour and act on where customers stall or grow.

  • You think in systems. You would rather build a repeatable, automated flow than run another one-off campaign.

  • You work cleanly across Growth, CS, PMM and GTM Ops without needing to own their surfaces, and you turn ambiguous boundaries into working agreements.

  • You build with AI. Agents and agentic workflows are how you get work done.

What you will own

  • Onboarding and adoption. The marketing-led 30/60/90 program that gets new paying customers to first value, plus ongoing adoption of key capabilities and education, including driving traffic to TD Academy and running education webinars end to end. You own the day-0 handoff: the trigger and the data that enrol a new customer in the right journey.

  • Segmentation and journey orchestration. Segmenting paying customers on profile, product usage, engagement, lifecycle stage, adoption state, expansion propensity and churn risk, then designing, building and QA-ing the journeys and triggers on top, so the right cohort gets the right play at the right moment.

  • Expansion and cross-sell. Plays that grow existing accounts through seats, add-ons and cross-sell. You co-define expansion signals with Growth and CS, turn them into segments and plays, and route qualified opportunities to Sales and CS, with GTM Ops implementing detection and actions.

  • Retention and win-back. Proactive plays against at-risk cohorts, air cover for CS retention efforts, re-engagement of dormant accounts, and win-back of churned accounts where it is commercially worthwhile.

  • Renewal-moment marketing. Value-recap and air-cover campaigns timed to the renewal window, reinforcing realised value ahead of the CS conversation.

  • Customer communications. Audience, segmentation, timing and orchestration for the customer newsletter, customer webinars, feature and release comms, and lifecycle-triggered in-app announcements. PMM owns the message. You own distribution.

  • Advocacy and review sites. Identifying advocates and triggering review, referral, testimonial and reference asks at the right lifecycle moment, including activating the promoters CS surfaces through NPS. You fully own review-site management and take the case studies Content and PMM produce to market.

  • Lifecycle analytics and experimentation. Performance across every journey, from onboarding completion and time-to-value through to expansion, retention, renewal support and win-back. You find where customers stall, drop off, expand or disengage, and you keep improving the programs.

  • AI in the workflow. Agentic workflows for segmentation, usage and account signal interpretation, journey and trigger build and testing, customer comms drafting and variants, propensity and churn scoring drafts, cohort analysis and drop-off detection. You decide what runs autonomously, what needs human judgement, and how each workflow gets operationalised with GTM Ops.

This role may not suit you if

  • You measure yourself on sends, opens and campaign volume rather than on revenue adopted, kept and grown.

  • You prefer launching one-off campaigns to building journeys that run on their own.

  • AI for you means prompt libraries and screenshots. We need someone who has built agents that do real work.

  • Your experience is mostly top-of-funnel. This role starts the moment an account becomes a paying customer.

  • You need to own every surface you touch. PMM owns the message and GTM Ops builds the scoring and routing, and this seat depends on working well with both.

  • You cannot commit to at least four hours a day of overlap with US Eastern business hours.

What a realistic week looks like

A cohort review showing where last month's new customers stalled before day 30, and a fix to the onboarding journey that ships the same week. A working session with CS on an at-risk cohort and the play you will run against it. Two expansion opportunities your signals surfaced, qualified and routed to Sales. An agent you built to draft and QA journey variants, tightened after its first run. A value-recap campaign going out to accounts entering their renewal window. Live collaboration during US Eastern hours, async for the rest of the day.

Requirements

Your experience

  • 5 to 7 years in lifecycle, CRM, customer or retention marketing at a B2B SaaS company.

  • A track record of designing and running behaviour-triggered customer journeys, with adoption, retention or expansion outcomes you owned. You know your numbers and can walk us through them.

  • Comfortable working from product-usage and account data to define segments, propensity and churn logic. You can specify the scoring and routing, even though GTM Ops builds it.

  • Fluent in a marketing automation or lifecycle stack such as HubSpot, and in cohort analysis.

  • Experience running expansion, cross-sell or renewal-support programs, and coordinating opportunity handoff with CS and Sales.

  • A clear understanding of where lifecycle ends and Growth and CS begin, and the ability to work cleanly across those lines.

  • Hands-on experience building agents or agentic workflows that do real work. You can show us what you built and what it does.

  • Remote, with a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern (ET) business hours.

Nice to have

  • Product-led SaaS experience.

  • More than four hours of daily overlap with US Eastern business hours.

  • Background in workforce analytics, time tracking, HR tech or productivity software.

  • Experience marketing to BPO, outsourcing, healthcare or tech services customers.

The team you are joining

You will report to our Director, Revenue Marketing. You will work closely with Growth and CS on expansion and churn signals, with PMM and Content on messaging and proof assets, with GTM Ops on scoring, routing and journey implementation, and with Sales and CS on the opportunities you hand forward.

How we will measure success

  • Qualified expansion and cross-sell opportunities you generate and surface. This is the headline measure and the one you control most directly.

  • Expansion revenue, net revenue retention contribution and at-risk recovery, which CS, Sales and Product also influence.

  • Onboarding completion, time-to-value and product adoption depth among paying customers, as the leading indicators.

  • Advocacy volume across reviews, referrals and references, renewal-support coverage, and revenue recovered through win-back.

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30. Map the post-conversion journey and where customers stall. Audit the current 30/60/90 onboarding and customer comms. Document the conversion handoff: the trigger and the data that must travel with a new customer. Agree the first expansion and churn signals with Growth and CS, and baseline adoption, retention and expansion.

  • Days 31 to 60. Launch or repair the 30/60/90 onboarding. Stand up the first expansion play and one renewal-moment campaign. Set up cohort reporting, introduce AI-assisted segmentation and comms, and get review-site management and one advocacy trigger (NPS promoters from CS) live.

  • Days 61 to 90. Scale the expansion and retention plays that are working. Run a win-back pilot. Establish expansion-opportunity routing to Sales and CS with GTM Ops, then present the adoption, retention and expansion baseline alongside a lifecycle roadmap.

Why this role

  • You own a real revenue number, from the moment a customer converts.

  • You get a clear lane. Growth, CS, PMM and GTM Ops are your partners, and your focus is orchestration and outcomes.

  • You work AI-first from day one, at a company where accelerating an AI-first operating model is an explicit expectation.

  • We are profitable and bootstrapped. Your budget comes from customers, not from a burn rate.

  • Fully remote and flexible, working with talented people in 30+ countries.

Our hiring approach

Because this is an AI-first role, our process asks you to prove it. Expect a working session where you show agents or agentic workflows you have built, then stand up or walk through one live, applied to a real customer-lifecycle problem. Prompt libraries and screenshots are not enough. We want to see how you architect, orchestrate and operationalise the work.

This is a full-time, 100% remote role. We are an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability.

We hire globally, and this particular role requires a minimum four-hour daily overlap with US Eastern business hours. Our Talent Attraction team will walk you through the details during your first conversation.

Learn more about us at

Your role and impact:

In your role at WhiteTech, you'll be at the heart of our mission to revolutionize payments worldwide. Your expertise will be critical in analysing data, processes, and code to identify, resolve or prevent issues and drive product improvements. You will contribute to developing a secure, well-tested and high-performing product, setting new standards in the fintech industry.

  • This role is about improving our products and solving problems, so we're looking for someone with excellent troubleshooting skills, curiosity for innovations and unconventional solutions.

What makes you stand out:

  • Deep understanding of Symfony. Proficient in designing and implementing RESTful APIs using Symfony. Proficient in Doctrine ORM.

  • Understanding the inner workings of Kubernetes, Docker and its components such as Docker Engine, Docker Hub, Docker Swarm.

Understanding the importance of application context and developing Bounded Contexts to separate domain models.

Ability to design and structure integration tests for large and complex systems with a large number of interacting components. Knowledge of the process of setting up test environments and managing dependencies for effective integration tests.
  • Advanced knowledge of the process of development and deployment of systems built on the basis of Event Sourcing. Ability to design the architecture of the application using Event Sourcing, taking into account the requirements for the required capacity and scalability.
  • Advanced knowledge of microservices design and deployment processes, including configuration management, monitoring, and logging.
  • Advanced knowledge of Jenkins functionality, including advanced configuration capabilities such as parameterization, plugins, additional tools.

raw.excerpt: wie du die welt von morgen prägen kannst • Wissen modellieren: Du sprichst mit Fachexpert:innen aus unterschiedlichen Abteilungen, verstehst deren Domänenwissen und übersetzt es in formale, semantische Modelle.
raw.description:
wie du die welt von morgen prägen kannst

  • Wissen modellieren: Du sprichst mit Fachexpert:innen aus unterschiedlichen Abteilungen, verstehst deren Domänenwissen und übersetzt es in formale, semantische Modelle.
  • Brücken bauen: Du agierst als zentraler Übersetzer zwischen den Fachbereichen und und unserem Engineering Team. Du stellst sicher, dass das Wissensmodell sowohl die fachliche Realität abbildet als auch technisch exzellent umsetzbar ist.
  • Konzepte gestalten: Du entwirfst und moderierst Workshops, um gemeinsam mit Stakeholdern ein einheitliches Verständnis (eine "Shared Language") für zentrale Geschäftskonzepte zu entwickeln und zu etablieren.
  • Datenquellen integrieren: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Engineering Team zusammen, um die Anbindung von Datenbanken, APIs und anderen Quellen an den Knowledge Graphen konzeptionell zu begleiten.
  • Ontologien entwickeln und pflegen: Mit Standards wie OWL/RDF erstellst du nicht nur das Modell, sondern definierst auch die logischen Regeln und Constraints, die die Qualität und Konsistenz unseres Knowledge Graphen sicherstellen.

was dich auszeichnet

  • Leidenschaft für Struktur und Logik: Du denkst abstrakt und liebst es, komplexe Zusammenhänge in klare, formale Strukturen zu überführen. Deine Fähigkeit, vom Konkreten zum Abstrakten zu gelangen, zeichnet dich aus.
  • Erfahrung in der Modellierung: Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Modellierung, z. B. mit UML oder idealerweise bereits mit semantischen Technologien (RDF, OWL).
  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du kannst komplexe technische und logische Modelle so erklären, dass sie sowohl für Fachexperten als auch für Entwickler verständlich und überzeugend sind. Du hörst exzellent zu und stellst die richtigen Fragen.
  • Technisches Grundverständnis: Du weißt, wie Daten in Systemen fließen. Begriffe wie APIs, Datenbanken und Datenpipelines sind dir nicht fremd. Erste Erfahrungen mit Graph-Technologien (z. B. SPARQL, Cypher) sind ein großes Plus, aber kein Muss.
  • Neugier und Gestaltungswille: Du hast den Antrieb, nicht nur bestehende Systeme zu verwalten, sondern eine neue Art der Wissensorganisation für KI von Grund auf mitzugestalten und voranzutreiben.

dich erwartet ein team, das

  • Vertrauen lebt. Wir glauben daran, dass du selbst am besten weißt, wie, wann und wo du produktiv bist. Ob Homeoffice, Co-Working-Space oder zeitweise im europäischen Ausland - du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag nach deinen Bedürfnissen. Wenn wir uns treffen, sind unsere Events echte Highlights, die uns als Team noch enger zusammenbringen.
  • Neugier fördert. Lernen hört bei uns nie auf. Wir unterstützen dich dabei, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln - mit Zeit, Budget und einem Umfeld, das Austausch und Weiterdenken fördert. Neugier ist für uns kein "Nice-to-have", sondern ein zentraler Wert.
  • Co-Creation inspiriert. Bei digetiers gestaltest du nicht nur deine eigene Rolle, sondern auch unser Unternehmen aktiv mit. Ob in Projekten, Prozessen oder unserer Kultur - deine Ideen zählen. Wir glauben an mutige Mitgestaltung statt starrer Strukturen.
  • Mit Leidenschaft professionell arbeitet. Wir lachen gerne - und liefern trotzdem auf höchstem Niveau. Spaß und Leistungsbereitschaft schließen sich bei uns nicht aus, sondern beflügeln sich gegenseitig.
  • Als Musketiere zusammenhält. Einer für alle, alle für einen - bei digetiers ist das nicht nur Ursprung unseres Namens, sondern gelebte Realität. Wir gewinnen als Team und halten uns gegenseitig den Rücken frei.

Cambium Learning® Group is an award-winning educational technology solutions leader dedicated to helping all students reach their potential through individualized and differentiated instruction. Using a research-based, personalized approach, Cambium Learning Group delivers SaaS resources and instructional products that engage students and support teachers in fun, positive, safe and scalable environments. These solutions are provided through Learning A-Z® (online differentiated instruction for elementary school reading, writing and science), ExploreLearning® (online interactive math and science simulations, a math fact fluency solution, and a K–2 science solution), Voyager Sopris Learning® (blended solutions that accelerate struggling learners to achieve in literacy and math and professional development for teachers), and VKidz Learning (online comprehensive homeschool education and programs for literacy and science). We believe that every student has unlimited potential, that teachers matter, and that data, instruction, and practice are the keys to success in the classroom and beyond.

Job Overview

Cambium Assessment is a leading provider of online assessments that shape the educational outcomes for millions of students. We are hiring a Senior Psychometrician for our team and we are looking for people who are passionate about innovating and inspiring others to reach their potential. The Senior Psychometrician will provide oversight of the technical quality of educational assessment activities.

Job Responsibilities

  • Heads technical operational and research projects dealing with early childhood and early literacy assessments.
  • Plans, coordinates, and performs statistical review for basic and complex projects.
  • Provides guidance and oversight to project staff on technical aspects of their work.
  • Works autonomously on most phases of statistical and/or psychometric examination and provides guidance to less experienced psychometricians.
  • Represents organization's position on technical issues to clients, and external boards and panels.
  • Accountable for statistical design such as Variance Estimations (weighting), Sample Design, Statistical Modeling, and Psychometrics.
  • Ensures quality control of deliverables.
  • Designs, develops and documents technical and operational procedures and statistical guidelines.
  • Applies advanced knowledge of statistical procedures, Psychometric methods and their applications and statistical programming (e.g., R).

Job Requirements

  • Ph.D. in Statistics, Education Measurement, Psychometrics, Psychological Measurement, or related field with an emphasis on quantitative research or Psychometrics.
  • Advanced training in Psychometric research and Statistics including Item Response Theory, Scaling and Equating, Computer Adaptive Testing, Sample Design and Longitudinal Data Analysis.
  • At least 4 years of professional experience, including with assessment systems, Sampling Theory and Item Response Theory.
  • Ability to work effectively as a member of a team in a consulting environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

raw.description:
ABOUT RENEW CAPITAL

At Renew Capital, we see opportunities in Africa where others, too often, only notice the problems. We invest, rather than provide handouts, by finding promising businesses, connecting them to a global network of investors and growing them into world-class companies. We do this because we believe that many growing businesses, together, create the engine that lifts entire nations out of poverty. Our ambition is to become the best middle market investment firm in Africa. We’re looking to hire those who embody our values and get excited about our vision for a prosperous Africa with growing businesses, thriving nations and a legacy of investment. Our organizational values are intelligence, integrity, beauty and grit.

Since establishing the Renew Capital presence in Africa in 2012, we have been pioneering an innovative blended-finance model that partners with the development community and focuses on investing in high-growth small and medium enterprises (SMEs). This blended-finance model allows us to invest in smaller deals that are often overlooked by larger investors but are too big for microfinance. We then help these companies build disciplined, gender-smart and climate-smart management systems and teams and grow them into market leading companies. As a result of our investment work to date, Renew Capital has mobilized millions of dollars into businesses in Africa, and built a large network of investors, the Renew Capital Angels.

We are inviting passionate and qualified candidates to apply to join our team assenior consultant, private sector development projectsin Africa.In candidates, we look for professionals with a trailblazing attribute who align with our organizational values. We welcome challenges and face them head-on each and every day! What we do is not easy, but it is rewarding and forces us to grow and innovate. As such, we hire individuals who are committed to their work, take pride in what they do and are relentless in advancing projects forward in a systematic manner. The people that flourish at Renew Capital are mission-driven; they see the big picture and the long-term result of their work, and they sincerely wish to make a lasting economic impact on the continent of Africa. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a senior consultant, private sector development project lead, you will lead a cross-cultural team of analysts, consultants, investment professionals, lawyers, and other business professionals to execute a multi-year program that aims to dramatically improve the SME investment ecosystem in Africa. As lead, you will ensure the project is implemented to Renew Capital’s standards, adhering to the contract, and delivering results. The lead will be accountable for project outcomes and be evaluated on the quality of their deliverables and their ability to accomplish project targets on time and within the project budget.

Successful candidates will have a strong background in business and/or investment work, and/or management consulting. Successful candidates will be comfortable working in frontier markets, learning and working with foreign cultures, adaptive and emotionally intelligent, patient and an excellent communicator. Successful candidates will also be strong trainers, exceptional writers, and capable of handling data analysis and a variety of business and finance work. S/he will receive comprehensive onboarding and critical support from Renew Capital’s leadership team and will be involved in a high-impact role creating significant social and financial impact on the continent.

Responsibilities:

  • Overseeing and driving the execution of a key development project by achieving results and meticulously delivering on all project milestones
  • Developing and leading a team of project analysts
  • Continuously improving and managing a collaborative company-wide M&E and reporting system that effectively captures the social impact of the firm, particularly in the area of gender equality
  • Helping to develop and facilitate Renew Capital’s core gender-smart programs by training SMEs both virtually and in-person
  • Liaising with Renew Capital’s asset management team to design and test interventions that fulfill project requirements and ultimately result in SMEs attracting growth capital from a variety of funding sources
  • Providing coaching and technical assistance to a consortium of entrepreneurs looking to scale their companies and persist through various cultural and economical hurdles
  • Preparing and reviewing project reports for clients that demonstrate Renew Capital’s social impact results in a compelling and beautiful manner
  • Managing communications with clients and running internal and external project meetings
  • Creating, improving and driving the organization’s adoption of Renew Capital’s consulting project tools, systems and processes
  • Reporting to and collaborating with Renew Capital’s executive management team on a regular basis to continuously improve SOPs and efficiency in delivering project results

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in business administration, finance or development is preferred
  • 5+ years of management consulting and/or finance experience. Consulting experience in both the private sector and with an international development firm focused on gender equality is a plus
  • Experience managing grant-based projects
  • Proficiency in writing reports in English
  • Strong project management skills – certification in project management is a plus
  • Exposure to the finance or private equity world
  • Excellent Excel and PowerPoint ability

Location and Travel Opportunities:

This position requires the candidate to be based in Africa. You may be asked to occasionally travel to Renew Capital’s field offices across the continent.

About Renew Capital:

We invite you to learn more about Renew Capital by visiting our website:.

Renew Capital is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran or disability status, or any other basis prohibited by law. Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

Bybit EU is looking for the Head for Commercial / Business Developmentto lead our European commercial strategy, market expansion and revenue growth across regulated digital asset and financial services.
Reporting directly to the EU Group CEO, you will lead the European commercial organisation, including Country Managers and their respective in-country Business Development, KOL, VIP Relationship Management and Community teams. raw.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

Grüns is scaling fast, and our supply chain has to move faster than the demand. As our Supply Chain Specialist, you'll be the execution engine behind it: owning purchase orders from creation to receipt, keeping inventory and inbound data airtight, and catching risk before it ever reaches a customer. You'll work side by side with our Director of Supply Chain and directly with our suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role, and the work you do will protect product availability as we grow.

This role is part of our remote HQ! We have a fully remote, high-trust work environment - and also come together on a biannual basis for amazing off-sites where we can connect IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Own day-to-day purchase order execution, moving every PO through production, shipment, receipt, and exception resolution without dropped follow-up
  • Run the operating cadence with suppliers, co-manufacturers, and 3PLs, so every confirmation, delay, decision, and committed date has one clear owner: you
  • Maintain the source of truth for available, inbound, and at-risk inventory, so the team always knows what we have, what's coming, and what's in trouble
  • Spot shortages, production delays, material constraints, freight risk, and inventory imbalances early, and escalate with a recommended action, not just a flag
  • Build Claude-powered workflows that turn raw PO, inventory, production, and freight data into exception lists, supplier communications, meeting recaps, and decision-ready summaries
  • Standardize reporting, documentation, and recurring workflows (and write the SOPs) so the team can handle higher volume with fewer manual errors

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has 1-3 years in supply chain, operations, procurement, production planning, logistics, or inventory management, working close to the physical flow of product rather than only reporting on it
  • Has worked in or around a fast-paced CPG, food/beverage, supplements, wellness, beauty, or other physical-product business (strongly preferred)
  • Has coordinated directly with external suppliers, manufacturers, or logistics partners, whether in a full-time role or internship, and held them to deadlines across multiple workstreams at once
  • Has hands-on experience with an ERP, inventory, or order management system (NetSuite-style) and can pull and organize clean source data without help
  • Uses Claude or other AI tools daily for real operational work: writes strong prompts, builds reusable workflows, and validates outputs against source data before acting on them
  • Can point to real examples of catching a problem early and driving it to resolution

Approach to the role:

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, without losing sight of what matters most to the business
  • Proactive: follows up before the deadline, not after something is already late
  • Comfortable in ambiguity, and builds structure where processes are still taking shape
  • Takes extreme ownership: closes loops and communicates risk early
  • Collaborative and low-ego, while still holding internal teams and external partners accountable
  • Treats AI as a force multiplier on the work, never a substitute for judgment

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we're committed to providing a competitive total compensation package—grounded in market data that considers our size, stage, industry, and location. For this role, the base salary range is between $80,000 – $85,000 plus bonus depending on experience.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

raw.description:
As a pioneer remote-first tech company with a product that inspires people globally, we attract a huge number of applicants to our organisation. We have created a hiring process that is totally unique empowering our business based Hiring Leadership team to lead talent selection. Our Talent Science team ensures that our processes are effective and that the business is able to make the best decisions to select exceptional talent. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a team that is changing the way an organisation hires.

Our Talent Science team has a mission to ensure that we follow objective, scientifically rigorous and efficient processes to select the very best new colleagues regardless of location, culture or background. We work closely with our key stakeholders to ensure that decisions are being made in the right way and that our hiring model supports the selection of world class talent, regardless of location, culture or background.

As a Talent Scientist, you will work closely with these Hiring Leads to drive initiatives, automation and best practice whilst offering an expert viewpoint on talent assessments. This is not a recruiter position; it's about the science of talent and performance, raising awareness and insights across the business so that they are able to select the best talent available from our global talent pool.

We have a number of mid-senior level openings in our team seeking the following:

  • Passion and drive to embed scientific approaches that deliver impact on how an organisation selects talent.
  • Strong behavioural interviewing techniques (competency based and psychometric assessments).
  • Excellent analytical problem solving ability to identify trends and patterns using SQL, statistical analysis or Python, BI tooling, etc.
  • An exceptional academic background including a Bachelors or Masters degree in a Psychology based subject.
  • A high level of personal organisation to work remotely and be effective.

Location: This is a remote position based in the EMEA region

What your day will look like

As a Talent Scientist you will:

  • Drive talent analytics to provide our business with real-time insight, partnering with the business to help them move through their hiring processes efficiently.
  • Conduct in-depth behavioural talent interviews providing considerable insights into motivations and behaviours.
  • Build key relationships with global stakeholders to ensure we deliver against our hiring agenda, closely monitoring hiring activities, driving results and ensuring that there is consistency in our operational processes.
  • Drive data driven insights, making sure our decision making process is robust and supportive to inform our decisions.
  • Consider our employer brand and how our interactions with a candidate impacts their experience.
  • Review and streamline hiring processes and tools to drive continuous improvement.
  • Work with external third parties and platforms to ensure we maximise our return on investment.
  • Bring a passion for diversity and inclusion, ensuring we remove unconscious bias from our hiring process and ensuring our sourcing strategy underpins this.

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic background from high school and university, with a Bachelors or Masters degree in a Psychology based subject.
  • Experience of hiring talent in the technology or consulting industry.
  • A highly data drive mindset with the ability to create measurable outcomes.
  • Passionate about how an organisation selects talent using scientific approaches with viewpoint on how to predict and measure hiring outcomes.
  • Strong analytical problem solving ability to identify trends and patterns using SQL, with Python and/or advanced statistical analysis preferable.
  • Exposure/appreciation of psychometric assessments, including interpretation.
  • Experience of conducting behavioural, competency based interviews with the ability to train stakeholders and advise on how to get the best out of an interview.
  • A high level of personal organisation and self drive to work remotely and be effective.
  • Willingness to travel to company events 2-4 times a year, for up to two weeks each.

Other skills you may bring

  • Experience in sourcing and headhunting with the ability to teach our senior leadership team how to hunt for industry leaders.
  • Experience in statistical significance testing and experience in Bayesian inference and/or predictive analytics and ML.
  • Exposure to the following tools: LinkedIn Talent Insights, Greenhouse, DISC profiling, Superset.
  • Psychometric validity and reliability metrics.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

raw.description:
GF Family Planning Survey Initiative — Manuscript Fellowship
Surgo Health is building the Behavioral Intelligence layer for healthcare — revealing why people behave as they do, predicting what they will do next, and helping organizations make the decisions that change outcomes.
A Public Benefit Corporation grounded in two decades of global health experience, Surgo generates foundational behavioral data that reveals the unseen why and builds the AI products that powers decision-grade insights at population scale — equipping healthcare organizations, funders, and public agencies to act on what actually shapes health outcomes: people's beliefs, motivations, and barriers.
From predicting who will enroll and remain in a clinical trial, to understanding what drives treatment decisions, to designing more effective health programs, Surgo brings the missing human layer into decisions traditionally made with clinical data alone.

Backed by 40+ peer-reviewed publications and trusted by partners including the Gates Foundation, J&J, Takeda, Pivotal Ventures, and the Clinton Health Access Initiative, Surgo is building a future where healthcare organizations don't just understand human behavior, but anticipate it — making healthcare more personal, precise, and effective for everyone.

Role Summary


We are inviting applications for a Research Fellow to join Surgo Health’s Gates Foundation (GF)-funded Family Planning initiative, a multi-country study spanning Senegal, Côte d’Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, and Lagos states), and Pakistan (Sindh).
This fellowship is centered on manuscript production. Fellows will collaborate closely with Surgo's research team to advance a priority research question – building on analysis and framing already underway – through to a submission-ready manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal.

What you’ll achieve:

What You’ll Achieve

  • Develop and lead a manuscript around an agreed priority research question, building on existing analyses and data and conducting additional analyses as needed
  • Produce a submission-ready, publication-quality manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal
  • Translate complex survey and causal-modeling findings into insights relevant to global health policy and program design
  • Contribute to Surgo Health’s growing portfolio of family planning research and thought leadership in low- and middle-income country (LMIC) contexts

Research Focus Areas

Priority Papers


You will lead on completing the analysis that has already been started. With this, you will write the manuscript, with guidance and support from the research leads throughout.
  1. Couples-linked segmentation in Northern Nigeria (Kano and Kaduna): How do women's and their partners' own attitudes toward family planning align or diverge, and what does this mean for programs designed to shift partner-related norms? This work links directly to an active program partnership focused on norm-shifting interventions in the region.
  2. Rethinking how we measure FP intention (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Pakistan/Sindh): Standard measures of contraceptive intention – a binary yes/no, or a 12-month time horizon – may obscure meaningful variation in fertility desire, intent strength, near-term planning, and confidence. This paper aims to describe how we have developed and tested a more multidimensional approach to measuring intent across three countries.
  3. Patterns of change in FP attitudes and behaviors over time in FP journeys (Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria [Kano and Kaduna], Pakistan [Sindh]): Using panel data collected roughly a year to two after baseline, this paper aims to characterize which women's contraceptive trajectories are "sticky", and tests which baseline predictors of conversion, intent development, and discontinuation generalize across countries versus which are context-specific.

Additional Areas of Interest

If none of the priority papers above are the right fit, the following list is intended to spark ideas rather than define the boundaries. If you have an interesting idea that isn't included here, please feel free to propose it.
  • Determinants of contraceptive intention, uptake, and method choice in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano, Kaduna, Lagos), and Pakistan (Sindh)
  • Causal inference approaches to family planning behavior (e.g., Bayesian networks, causal forests, propensity score matching, doubly robust/DoubleML methods, G-computation)
  • Segmentation-informed analysis using belief- and behavior-based segments to explain heterogeneous contraceptive outcomes
  • Comparative, cross-country analysis of family planning drivers and structural barriers
  • Subgroup and geographic vulnerability (e.g., state-level variation, rural/urban differences, adolescent and youth subpopulations)
  • Contraceptive discontinuation and continuation dynamics
  • Comparative methodology, including analysis that contextualizes findings alongside established survey instruments (e.g., DHS, PMA)

Data Available to Fellows


Fellows will work with de-identified data from Surgo's Gates Foundation-funded multi-country Family Planning study: a cross-sectional baseline survey plus a longitudinal follow-up conducted at a later point in time, across Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria, and Pakistan (Sindh).
Baseline: Women's FP Survey — Representative baseline surveys of women of reproductive age (15–49), covering fertility intentions, contraceptive use and method choice, household decision-making, perceptions and norms, health system access, and information exposure. Data was collected in 2024 to early 2025 depending on the geography. Sample sizes range from roughly 7,000 women in Senegal to around 10,000 in Côte d'Ivoire and Pakistan (Sindh), with Nigeria in between. In Nigeria, the baseline covers three states — Lagos, Kano, and Kaduna.

Baseline subset: Male Partner Interviews — In a smaller subset of baseline households, the woman's male partner also completed a companion interview, capturing his perspective on decision-making, approval, and household dynamics — enabling dyadic/couple-level analysis. Partner interviews were conducted with roughly one in ten baseline households in most countries, somewhat higher in Nigeria.

Follow-up: Longitudinal Women's Survey — A subset of baseline women who consented to re-contact were re-interviewed roughly one to two years after baseline to track changes in intentions, behavior, and access over time. This enables analysis of intention-to-behavior gaps, method continuation/discontinuation, and segment transitions. Follow-up samples range from under 2,000 women in Senegal to several thousand in Côte d'Ivoire, Nigeria (Kano and Kaduna), and Pakistan (Sindh), split between women who were contraceptive users and non-users at baseline.

Fellows will receive final sample sizes, codebooks, and documentation upon onboarding.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and lead a research paper within agreed priority areas, either building on existing analyses and insights from the GF-funded multi-country family planning studies or developing a new research question using the available data, with additional analyses as needed.
  • Synthesize and translate existing findings and/or generate new analyses to deepen understanding of the mechanisms, risk factors, and protective factors shaping family planning behaviors and outcomes.
  • If applicable, utilize rigorous quantitative and/or causal inference methods appropriate to the research question
  • Draft and revise a manuscript for submission to a peer-reviewed journal, incorporating feedback from Surgo’s research team
  • Collaborate with Surgo’s research scientists for methodological guidance and framing

Expected Outputs

  • One submission-ready manuscript for a peer-reviewed journal (primary deliverable)
  • Clean, documented analysis code and supporting analytic materials if appropriate

Program Structure & Support


Selected Fellows will receive:
  • Access to de-identified, multi-country family planning survey data under a data use agreement
  • Codebooks and methodological documentation
  • Regular check-ins with Surgo’s research team for methodological guidance and feedback on drafts
  • Methodological and analytic support
  • Guidance on funder framing and positioning
  • Co-authorship and publication support
  • Opportunity to present progress to the broader research team
Fellows will retain academic independence while benefiting from Surgo’s translational and methodological support.
Fellows are additionally supported through a structured cadence of meetings throughout the fellowship. Regular check-ins are designed to keep work on track and give fellows direct access to Surgo researchers and leadership:

Weekly check-ins with Surgo project lead(s): Fellows will meet twice per week with their respective Surgo project lead(s). These sessions are intended to support analytic progress, troubleshoot methodological questions, and provide feedback on developing outputs. Fellows are invited to join the Surgo FP analytics team meetings. This gives fellows visibility into the broader team context and an opportunity to share work in progress with colleagues across the initiative.
Leadership exposure (optional): Fellows will have two scheduled opportunities to present findings to Hannah Kemp, Chief Strategy Officer, Client Engagement and Mokshada Jain, Vice President of Global Health. These sessions are built into the fellowship calendar and are a chance to share developing work with senior leadership. Fellows who want additional exposure can also request up to two optional meetings with Vincent Huang, Senior Director of Data Science & AI, to discuss their analytic approach and findings. These sessions are available but entirely at the fellow's discretion.

Timeline

  • Project Duration: maximum 17 weeks (~4 months)
  • Earliest start date: Oct 15, 2026
Expected main deliverables include:
  • (Week 1-2): Confirmed scope of work (Week 1–2): For papers requiring new analysis, this is an analytic plan. For papers building primarily on existing analysis or an established framing (e.g., the intent measurement paper), this is instead a confirmed research question, agreed division of remaining work between the Fellow and lead(s), and a manuscript outline.
  • (Week 6 or earlier): Preliminary results or draft findings (midpoint review)
  • (Week 12 or earlier): Draft initial manuscript for internal reviews delivered
  • (Week 16-17 or earlier): Final submission-ready manuscript delivered
Authorship
Fellows are credited as co-first-author or first author depending on their contribution. All publications and external communications will follow the agreed authorship and review process. Surgo Health retains the right to review and approve all outputs prior to external submission or distribution.
Stipend
Stipend amount: $6000
Payment is milestone-based. The stipend is distributed in four equal installments, with 25% ($1,500) awarded upon the successful completion of each milestone.
Milestone | Conditions for payment

Milestone 1
| Scope of work confirmed (week 1-2): For papers requiring new analysis, this is an analytic plan. For papers building primarily on existing analysis or an established framing, this is instead a confirmed research question, agreed division of remaining work between the Fellow and lead(s), and a manuscript outline.Signed data use agreement on fileSatisfactory onboarding requirements (cybersecurity training, etc)

Milestone 2 | Preliminary results or draft findings shared at midpoint review meetingSurgo team confirms satisfactory progress

Milestone 3 | First draft manuscript

Milestone 4 | Two rounds of internal review revisions incorporated

Submission-ready manuscript delivered and accepted by Surgo team.

All deliverables complete by agreed deadline

About you:

About You

  • PhD candidate, postdoctoral researcher, or early-career researcher in a relevant field (e.g., public health, demography, economics, biostatistics, epidemiology, data science)
  • Strong experience in quantitative analysis, survey data, and/or causal inference methods
  • Demonstrated ability to produce rigorous, publication-quality research
  • Experienced in family planning, reproductive health in LMIC contexts is strongly preferred
  • Experience in behavioral science and program implementation context is a plus
  • Comfort working with large-scale, multi-country survey datasets
Location: Remote friendly
Travel: None required

How to Apply


Path A — Join a Priority Paper. Apply to collaborate on one of the three papers listed under Priority Papers Open for Collaboration. In place of a general statement of interest, submit a short written response (up to 1,000 words) addressing all three of the following:
  1. Understanding: In your own words, what is the core analytic challenge this paper is trying to solve, and why does it matter? (2–3 sentences)
  2. Approach: How would you approach the methodological question below for your chosen paper? Walk through your reasoning, including tradeoffs you'd weigh.
  • Couples-linked segmentation in Northern Nigeria: How would you approach measuring alignment or divergence in paired partner responses on family planning attitudes? What would guide your definition of "alignment," and how would you handle the non-independence between partners' responses?
  • Rethinking how we measure FP intention: How would you validate that a multidimensional measure of contraceptive intention (fertility desire, intent strength, near-term planning, confidence) actually captures distinct dimensions, rather than one underlying construct measured multiple ways?
  • Longitudinal typologies of FP journeys: How would you define and empirically identify "sticky" versus "fluid" contraceptive trajectories from panel data, and how would you convince yourself the resulting typology reflects real behavioral patterns rather than measurement noise?
  1. Framing & Evidence Needed: Based on what's described above, what angle or framing would you propose for this manuscript? What evidence or additional analysis would need to emerge from the data to support that framing — and what would change your mind if it didn't?
Path B — Propose Your Own Idea. Apply with your own research question, grounded in the Additional Areas of Interest listed above (or a closely related idea). Include a short concept note (up to 1,000 words) outlining your proposed question, analytic approach, and how it would draw on the available data.

All applicants should submit:
  • CV or resume
  • Path A: the written response described above (up to 1,000 words), indicating which priority paper you're applying to. This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application
  • Path B: the concept note described above (up to 1,000 words). This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application
  • One prior peer-reviewed publication (strongly preferred), as first author or a major contributing author. If that is unavailable, submit a scientific writing sample. This can be a Word document or PDF file attached to your application
  • Contact information for two references

Benefits

What You’ll Love About Surgo

  • Fantastic, fun and collaborative colleagues; opportunity to solve tough challenges in healthcare and global health
  • Ability to be entrepreneurial, with tremendous opportunities for growth
  • Public Benefit Corporation with an impact and equity mission

Our Hiring Philosophy

We hire for passion and core competencies.

We look for problem solvers and lateral thinkers.
We love it if you have done different things with your time.
If you think you are ideal for this position, write to us even if your experience doesn’t match all the requirements listed above.

Equal Opportunity and Diversity Policy

Surgo believes a diverse, inclusive staff makes a stronger team and more impactful organization, and we are committed to building and developing this team and environment. Qualified people of all races, ethnicities, cultures, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientation, gender identities and expressions, languages, social class, marital status, religions, veteran status, and disabilities are strongly encouraged to apply.

• Champion AI, automation, analytics, and procurement tools to drive faster decisions, reduce manual effort, and enhance visibility and digital fluencyDefine and implement process improvements that reduce cycle time, deliver efficiency gains, and ensure compliance with policies.


Success in This Role

The successful candidate will bring visibility and discipline to vendor spend across the entire Shield portfolio, build durable vendor partnerships that scale with our acquisition model, and deliver quantifiable savings while maintaining service quality for Shield and ShieldCo teams. Within the first year, they will have established a complete vendor inventory and renewal calendar, implemented a consistent procurement workflow, and executed consolidation wins across at least two major spend categories.

Shape the Future on Autopilot

At Autopilot, you won’t just design screens – you’ll design how fintech works. As a Product Designer, you’ll own product experiences end-to-end and help redefine what great UX means in a complex, data-driven industry.

We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce.

Why Join Us?

You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

You'll join a fast-moving team building modern, data-intensive web applications that help digital businesses operate more intelligently. This is a founding design role with strong emphasis on product logic, systems thinking, and end-to-end collaboration with engineers.

🛠️ What You'll Do

  • Translate complex financial logic and backend systems into intuitive user flows

  • Design dashboards, workflows, and visual systems for payments, orchestration, and automation

  • Build and maintain our scalable design system in Figma (aligned with React components)

  • Collaborate with engineers on real-world UX states — success, failure, pending, retry

  • Prototype and validate features with real data and user context

  • Participate in product discussions, shaping user journeys before pixels are drawn

  • Uphold usability and domain accuracy as the standard for design quality

🎯 What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience designing digital products with complex logic (fintech, B2B SaaS, or data-heavy systems preferred)

  • Strong product and systems thinking — you design for states and workflows, not just screens

  • Deep Figma expertise (Auto Layout, Variants, Tokens, Components)

  • Ability to translate backend logic, APIs, and data models into coherent user experiences

  • Excellent communication and documentation skills (Linear, Figma, Slack)

  • Comfortable working directly with engineers and iterating quickly without handoffs

🌟 Bonus Points

  • Experience in fintech, payments, or compliance-related products

  • Exposure to analytics or developer tooling

  • Understanding of design-to-code workflows (React component parity, tokens)

  • Strong interaction or motion design craft (Framer, ProtoPie, etc.)

Our Hiring Process

We focus on real-world collaboration, not design showreels. Here’s what to expect:

  1. Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume

    We’ll review based on the requirements above. If shortlisted, you’ll receive an email to schedule a 90-minute live design collaboration session once you’re comfortable with our pre-interview brief.

  2. 90-Minute Live Design Collaboration

    You’ll work with our product and engineering team on a small feature challenge — from user problem to Figma prototype.

    We’ll look at:

    • How you think through logic and flows

    • How you translate constraints into UX decisions

    • Your interaction, hierarchy, and state management

    • How you communicate trade-offs and rationale

    The session mirrors our actual workflow:

    • accessible

    • pragmatic

    • collaborative

  3. Design Review & Feedback

    After the session, we’ll walk through your design decisions together. You’ll get feedback from our CTO and team, and discuss potential improvements or extensions to your solution.

  4. Culture & Alignment Chat

    A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides.

raw.title: Data Platform Engineer (102-08SENG-01)
raw.excerpt: This role converts a large Azure Data Factory estate into Databricks workflows on AWS.
raw.description:
This role converts a large Azure Data Factory estate into Databricks workflows on AWS. The scope for year one: 2,094 ADF pipelines to migrate — built as reusable templates rather than one-by-one — 9,859 pipeline activities to translate (some map directly, others need rewriting as Lambda or Step Functions), 471 Spark dataflows to move onto Databricks on AWS, and 4 Databricks workspaces (Dev, QA, Pre-prod, Prod) to rehost, including notebook paths and Unity Catalog rewiring. This is a regulated environment, so reconciling migrated data against source systems is part of the definition of done, not an afterthought.

Requirements

What you will do

  • Convert Azure Data Factory pipelines into Databricks workflows on AWS, building reusable templates rather than migrating one at a time.

  • Rehost Databricks workspaces onto AWS and migrate ADLS Gen2 storage to S3.

  • Rewrite ADF Web Activities as Lambda functions or Step Functions tasks, and replace ADF-specific scaling with native Databricks mechanisms.

  • Build and tune PySpark transformations for production data volumes.

  • Replace Azure Synapse Serverless with Databricks SQL Warehouse.

  • Reconcile migrated data against source systems as part of the definition of done.

Required

  • Production experience with Databricks: workspaces, jobs and workflows. The central skill for this role.

  • Strong Spark and PySpark experience for real data volumes, including tuning.

  • Production-grade Python.

  • Experience building or migrating Azure Data Factory pipelines, with a solid understanding of the ADF activity model.

  • AWS data services: S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda and Step Functions.

  • Advanced SQL, including reading and reasoning about stored procedures.

  • Professional written and spoken English.

Nice to have

Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Synapse, Terraform, Airflow/MWAA, dbt, Kafka, Databricks certification, data modeling, Great Expectations, SAS/analytics platform integration, CRM data.

Engagement details

  • Full-time

  • 100% remote

  • Open to candidate from all LATAM

Highlights

Databricks, PySpark, Python, Azure Data Factory, AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, Step Functions), SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Azure Synapse, Terraform, Airflow/MWAA, dbt, Kafka

raw.description:
Analysierst du eine Zielgruppe, bevor du die erste Zeile schreibst und weißt danach genau, welche Einwände entlang des Funnels entstehen und wie du sie gezielt auflöst? Misst du den Erfolg eines Textes nicht daran, wie er klingt, sondern daran, was er auslöst? Setzt du KI nicht ein, weil es alle tun, sondern weil du damit in der Hälfte der Zeit bessere Ergebnisse lieferst?

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Bei EVOLVE Digital textest du Funnels, die verkaufen – vom ersten Ad-Hook bis zur Landingpage. Du arbeitest mit einem Performance-Team, das datenbasiert entscheidet und klar kommuniziert – mit einem gemeinsamen Ziel: maximale Conversion. KI ist hier kein Bonus, sondern Arbeitsgrundlage.

Dein neues Team

Bei EVOLVE Digital arbeitest du gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Performance- und E-Commerce-Spezialisten an spannenden E-Commerce Projekten mit direktem Einfluss auf deren Erfolg. Dabei sehen wir uns als Wachstumspartner, der Kundenprojekte ganzheitlich betrachtet und denkt.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein 20+ köpfiges Team, dass auf fachliche Tiefe und eine kollegiale Zusammenarbeit setzt.

Dabei schaffen wir ein Umfeld für Menschen, die gestalten wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und ihre Stärken gezielt weiterentwickeln möchten.

Deine Aufgaben im Überblick

  • Du textest Landingpages und Advertorial-Funnels, die nachweislich konvertieren – von der Headline bis zum finalen CTA.

  • Du entwickelst Ad-Copies für Creatives, die im Feed stoppen und im Funnel weiterführen.

  • Du schreibst Videoskripte, die Kaufmotive aktivieren und Einwände aushebeln, bevor sie entstehen.

  • Du analysierst Zielgruppen im D2C-Kontext, bevor du schreibst – und leitest daraus ab, welche Botschaft auf welcher Funnel-Stufe zieht.

  • Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv im Schreibprozess und entwickelst Prompts und Workflows, die das gesamte Team weiterverwenden kann.

  • Du iterierst Texte anhand von Performance-Daten und überführst Testergebnisse direkt in neue Versionen.

  • Du durchläufst Freigabeprozesse mit Kunden und intern effizient – mit dem Ziel, Überarbeitungsschleifen zu minimieren.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung im Direct Response Copywriting.

  • Du hast in einem D2C-Kontext gearbeitet – bei einer Performance-Marketing-Agentur oder einer D2C-Brand, kein reiner Content- oder Redaktionshintergrund.

  • Du verstehst, was auf einer Landingpage oder im Funnel passieren muss, damit jemand konvertiert und setzt das handwerklich um.

  • Du nutzt mehrere KI-Tools aktiv – ChatGPT, Claude und weitere – nicht nur zum Schreiben, sondern um wiederholbare Workflows zu entwickeln und weiterzugeben.

  • Du schreibst so, wie die Zielgruppe spricht – keine komplizierten Formulierungen, kein poetisches Copywriting, kein Selbstzweck.

  • Du willst wissen, was deine Texte bewirken und optimierst datenbasiert.

  • Du bringst Eigenantrieb mit, arbeitest strukturiert und entwickelst dich aktiv weiter.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • 100 % Remote-Arbeit

  • Attraktives Gehalt und 30 Tage Urlaub

  • Umfangreiches Benefitprogramm, einschließlich einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mitarbeiterbenefits, Jobrad und Firmenfitness über Wellpass

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit langfristiger, unbefristeter Zusammenarbeit

  • Kollegiale und wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und offener Feedbackkultur

  • Umfangreiche fachliche Fortbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Moderne Arbeitsgeräte, inklusive Laptop Deiner Wahl und hochwertigem Zubehör für das Homeoffice.

raw.description:
Location: 100% remote (within or outside the U.S.)

Classification: Full-time (30-40 hours/week)

Pay Range: $25.12 - $34.50/hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep and MiaPrep Online High School. Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Curriculum Developers work closely with other subject-matter experts, our production team, and an instructional coach to produce immersive, engaging, and academically rigorous learning materials that constitute the core of our curriculum. These materials include videos, assessments, and written learning activities. Curriculum Developers are experts in their fields who thrive when wearing many hats. Our team relies on highly motivated, collaborative, and student-driven individuals.

What you’ll do (responsibilities):

  • Spend a majority of your time designing and developing ELA educational content (video scripts, assessments, and written materials) for 6-12th grade students

  • Ensure content is pedagogically sound, engaging, age-appropriate, and accessible for students

  • Write clear and measurable lesson objectives, and align teaching materials to meet objectives

  • Use technology, such as Google Slides, Sheets, Docs, and screencasting software

  • Differentiate instruction to accommodate diverse student populations and needs

  • Continuously evaluate and refine content based on feedback and educational outcomes

  • Collaborate with peers on curriculum development

  • Give and receive feedback on lessons, course development, and processes

Check out a day in the life of a Miaplaza Curriculum Developer!

Requirements

You may be a good fit if you have (requirements):

  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time ELA classroom teaching experience at the 9-12th grade levels (excluding student teaching, tutoring, and supplemental education).

  • A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Education or in an ELA-related field

  • Familiarity with writing lesson objectives and creating objective-aligned lesson materials

  • Experience creating well-structured and effective lessons.

  • Ability to differentiate instruction to make learning accessible, engaging, and age-appropriate

  • Strong understanding of what makes a lesson engaging

  • Experience using technology to support instruction, including Google Slides, Sheets, and Docs

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, especially written

  • Growth mindset and motivated by constructive feedback

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage schedules, and meet deadlines

  • High motivation, a proactive attitude, and a tendency to seek opportunities for continuous improvement

  • High standards of integrity and transparency

  • Access to a computer/laptop (with camera) and a reliable high-speed internet connection

What makes you stand out (nice-to-haves):

  • You have an active teaching certification, and/or you have completed professional development or training in curriculum design and pedagogy

  • You have hands-on experience designing and writing curriculum, including writing scripts for completely asynchronous video lessons

  • You have experience teaching and designing lessons for SAT/ACT test prep, or AP courses such as AP English Language and Composition or AP Literature and Composition

  • You have experience analyzing and transforming data into actionable goals that have positively impacted your students

  • You have experience with screencasting software or online instruction

  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of skills that might not be listed here but may still be transferable to this role. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply.

Compensation & benefits:

  • This is an hourly position that requires a minimum of 30 hours a week for full-time status. The expected starting pay range is $25.12 - $34.50 per hour. When working 40 hours per week year-round, this equates to an approximate annual pay range of $52,249–$71,760.

  • Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.

  • Compensation is evaluated twice per year. Employee compensation is determined by lesson quality, efficiency, and performance.

  • Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, inclusive of specialty care options like fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, FSA, HSA, and more.

  • All employees are eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.

  • PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour for every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 139 hours per year, or about 17 eight-hour days on average.

  • Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

  • We invite your family and friends to join our journey! All employees receive free site memberships and discounted MOHS tuition for the children in their household, plus two additional memberships for other children in their lives.

What you’ll love about working at Miaplaza:

  • You’ll be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to innovative education solutions for children who learn in diverse ways.

  • Our 100% remote team can work from any productive location within or outside the U.S. (no travel required!)

  • We promote flexibility and encourage employees to shape their work environments and schedules around their lives!

  • You’ll collaborate with colleagues on challenging and rewarding projects, and connect through community and culture events.

  • Learn more by visiting our careers page!

Schedule:

  • Curriculum Developers are expected to have 30-40 hours of availability each week on a year-round basis. This range of hours is designed to offer flexibility in your schedule, and there is ample work available! We consider anything over 30 hours a week to be full-time, so you would be eligible for all of our benefits!

  • What your schedule looks like is up to you! Morning person? Night owl? Somewhere in between? As long as you are meeting your deadlines and are available for weekly meetings with your supervisor and peers (generally during US business hours), we support the hours that work best for you.

    THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY NOVEMBER 1ST, 2026.

Ready to apply?

Please start by submitting your application and resume. The hiring process varies by position but generally includes assessments, a phone call interview, an assignment, and a final video interview. Reflecting our commitment to our students, we prioritize accessibility and inclusivity within our hiring practices and team. Please contact HR if you need accommodation at any point during hiring or employment. Miaplaza is an E-Verify participating employer for individuals hired in the United States. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

raw.description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

About the Role

*Pls kindly note this role has no base salary, it's commission based

We are looking for a internationally minded Regional Business Development Specialist to drive the expansion of Bybit’s payments ecosystem across EU and emerging global corridors. This role will focus on community building, merchant acquisition, local payment partnerships, and strategic growth initiatives for Bybit Pay, Card, and Fiat channels.

The ideal candidate has deep experience in payments, fintech, or crypto, strong local market understanding, and a proven track record of driving regional growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support market expansion for Bybit Pay across EU, building and owning the full growth pipeline
  • Acquire and manage merchants, payment gateways, fintech partners, Web3 projects, community leaders, and other growth channels.
  • Drive the end-to-end BD cycle: market mapping, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, and partnership execution.
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Product, Card, Fiat Channels, Compliance, Payments Ops, Marketing) to activate and scale payment use cases.
  • Develop regional GTM strategies and identify high-potential payment corridors for crypto-to-fiat and fiat-to-crypto flows.
  • Support cross-border payment products, including settlement channels, payout solutions, and merchant integrations.
  • Provide market intelligence, partner feedback, and competitive analysis to optimize product direction.
  • Represent Bybit in industry events, conferences, and ecosystem partnerships.

Requirements:

  • 1+ years of experience in payments / fintech / PSP / acquiring / merchant growth / crypto BD.
  • Long-term overseas work or study experience (must-have).
  • Strong understanding of local payment rails, fiat/crypto conversion flows, card programs, and merchant needs.
  • Demonstrated success in driving regional growth or launching payment products in multiple markets.
  • Ability to work independently and thrive in fast-paced, high-ownership environments.
  • Native local language proficiency + strong English communication skills.
  • Network across fintech, Web3, PSPs, acquirers, or merchant ecosystems is highly preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements for payments and cross-border movement.
  • Background working in global remote teams.
  • Prior experience with crypto exchanges, payment gateways, or card programs.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

Our benefits include:

- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
