raw.title: B2B Growth & Demand Generation Intern
raw.excerpt: About SOUKMEDIASoukMedia is a global B2B demand generation agency that works with enterprise and mid-market SaaS companies to execute webinars, virtual events, content syndication campaigns, outbound programs, and ABM initiatives.
raw.description:
About SOUKMEDIA

SoukMedia is a global B2B demand generation agency that works with enterprise and mid-market SaaS companies to execute webinars, virtual events, content syndication campaigns, outbound programs, and ABM initiatives. We partner with some of the world’s leading technology brands to help them generate qualified pipeline through scalable marketing programs.

If you’ve ever wanted to understand how modern B2B marketing actually works behind the scenes, this internship gives you exactly that opportunity. This is not a “make PowerPoints and social media posts” internship — you’ll work directly on real client campaigns that generate revenue.

What You’ll Work On

As a B2B Growth & Demand Generation Intern, you’ll become part of our campaign delivery team and help execute large-scale outbound and demand generation programs. Your responsibilities may include:

  • Building and managing outbound campaigns (Email + LinkedIn)

  • Setting up and maintaining Smartlead and Instantly workspaces

  • Managing LinkedIn outreach campaigns through HeyReach

  • Building prospect lists using Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and other data platforms

  • Data enrichment and workflow automation using Clay and Bitscale

  • Campaign QA, testing, and troubleshooting

  • Domain, mailbox, and outbound infrastructure management

  • Webinar campaign operations and execution

  • Content syndication project coordination

  • Lead quality checks and CRM hygiene

  • Researching ICPs, target accounts, and buying personas

  • Supporting campaign reporting and performance tracking

  • Working with AI tools to improve workflows and automate repetitive tasks

Tools You’ll Learn

You’ll get hands-on experience with industry-leading GTM tools, including:

  • Smartlead

  • Instantly

  • HeyReach

  • Clay

  • Bitscale

  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator

  • GetSales

  • Claude Code

  • AI-powered automation tools

  • Email deliverability platforms, lead enrichment tools, and modern outbound infrastructure

If you’re interested in B2B SaaS, RevOps, Growth Marketing, or Sales Tech, this internship will expose you to the tools used by leading demand generation teams globally.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re not looking for someone with years of experience. We’re looking for someone who is:

  • Curious and enjoys figuring things out

  • Detail-oriented

  • Comfortable working with spreadsheets and data

  • Tech-savvy and quick to learn new software

  • Interested in AI, automation, SaaS, or B2B marketing

  • Reliable and takes ownership of work

  • Strong in written English

  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Bonus (Not Mandatory):

  • Familiarity with LinkedIn

  • Basic understanding of B2B marketing

  • Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, or other AI tools

  • Experience with Excel or Google Sheets

What You’ll Gain

By the end of the internship, you’ll have practical experience in:

  • Enterprise SaaS marketing

  • B2B demand generation

  • Outbound campaign execution

  • Lead generation systems

  • Marketing automation

  • AI-assisted workflows

  • Campaign operations

  • Webinar marketing

  • Content syndication

  • GTM technology stack used by modern SaaS companies

You’ll leave with real, hands-on experience that very few internships offer.

Internship Details

  • Duration: 3 Months

  • Remote work

  • Flexible, fast-paced startup environment

  • Work directly with founders and experienced growth marketers

  • Performance-based Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) for outstanding interns

Applications that demonstrate curiosity and willingness to learn will stand out more than prior experience.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
description: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase.

raw.title: Senior Application Security Engineer (all genders)
raw.excerpt: Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase.
raw.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for our first dedicated Application Security Engineer to build our AppSec practice from the ground up. This is a greenfield opportunity with a real attack surface: public partner-facing APIs, payment flows, and active bug bounties. You will own secure development, define what gets reviewed, implement security gates, build the "paved road" for ~150 engineers, and see the impact of your work in production within weeks.

What you will do:

  • Lead threat modeling and secure design reviews for high-risk changes, partner integrations, and payment flows.

  • Implement, tune, and enforce security gates in GitLab CI/CD (SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and DAST) while minimizing developer friction.

  • Act as the primary technical owner for triaging, reproducing, and prioritizing findings from bug bounties, partner pentests, and automated scanners.

  • Work hands-on with the DevOps team to implement GCP organizational policies, IAM least-privilege architectures, and Cloud Armor (WAF/rate limiting).

  • Establish a security-champions network across engineering squads and leverage automation/AI-assisted tooling to scale code reviews effectively.

Workplace:

We are a remote-first company with teams located around the Globe.

Also, the HQ office is in Berlin, where the team often meets.

Requirements

Who you are:

  • You bring 5+ years in AppSec (or 3+ years plus a strong software engineering/web-pentesting background), with a track record of true ownership.

  • You read and write production code (Python, Go, TypeScript, Ruby, etc.) and deeply understand web frameworks, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.

  • You have deep knowledge of web and API security, specifically authentication/authorization models (OAuth2, JWT), rate limiting, tenant isolation, IDOR, and XSS.

  • You have strong cloud security fundamentals (GCP preferred), specifically regarding public exposure, secrets hygiene, and WAF rules.

  • You prioritize by real-world risk, propose trade-offs rather than demanding perfection, and communicate complex risks plainly to engineers and leadership.

  • Bonus Points: You have experience securing high-volume, multi-tenant B2B APIs and utilizing AI tooling to accelerate triage and review.

What you can expect:

  • You will join a fast-paced travel tech company with a flat organizational structure.

  • You will have exciting opportunities, ownership, and responsibility and contribute directly to the success of the company.

  • You will join an international team of talented and driven people with a clear mission. Expect your colleagues to inspire, support and challenge you every day!

  • We have a flexible work policy with the option of working remotely and international opportunities arising as we continue to expand our global footprint – Our heart is in Berlin, but you’ll find us across the globe.

  • You will get a competitive salary.

Our hiring team for this role:
Your Talent Partner (TP) and point of contact is Lorena Rebenciuc, and the Hiring Manager (HM) is Ilya Isakov.

For any queries, contact your Talent Partner at .

Do you want to work on a product that is used by millions of people daily with a high load, availability and scalability, and most advanced technology? Come join us!

raw.description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

As a member of our AI model team, you will drive innovation in model serving and inference architectures for advanced AI systems. Your work will focus on optimizing model deployment and inference strategies to deliver highly responsive, efficient, and scalable performance across real-world applications. You will work on a wide spectrum of systems, ranging from resource-efficient models designed for limited hardware environments to complex, multi-modal architectures that integrate data such as text, images, and audio.

We expect you to have deep expertise in designing and optimizing model serving pipelines and inference frameworks as well as a strong background in advanced model architectures. You will adopt a hands-on, research-driven approach to develop, test, and implement novel serving strategies and inference algorithms. Your responsibilities include engineering robust inference pipelines, establishing comprehensive performance metrics, and identifying and resolving bottlenecks in production environments. The ultimate goal is to enable high-throughput, low-latency, low-memory footprint, and scalable AI performance that delivers tangible value in dynamic, real-world scenarios.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy state-of-the-art model serving architectures that deliver high throughput and low latency while optimizing memory usage. Ensure these pipelines run efficiently across diverse environments, including resource-constrained devices and edge platforms. Establish clear performance targets such as reduced latency, improved token response, and minimized memory footprint.

  • Build, run, and monitor controlled inference tests in both simulated and live production environments. Track key performance indicators such as response latency, throughput, memory consumption, and error rates, with special attention to metrics specific to resource-constrained devices. Document iterative results and compare outcomes against established benchmarks to validate performance across platforms.

  • Identify and prepare high-quality test datasets and simulation scenarios tailored to real-world deployment challenges, specifically those encountered on low-resource devices. Set measurable criteria to ensure that these resources effectively evaluate model performance, latency, and memory utilization under various operational conditions.

  • Analyze computational efficiency and diagnose bottlenecks in the serving pipeline by monitoring both processing and memory metrics. Address issues such as suboptimal batch processing, network delays, and high memory usage to optimize the serving infrastructure for scalability and reliability on resource-constrained systems.

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate optimized serving and inference frameworks into production pipelines designed for edge and on-device applications. Define clear success metrics such as improved real-world performance, low error rates, robust scalability, optimal memory usage and ensure continuous monitoring and iterative refinements for sustained improvements.

Requirements

  • A degree in Computer Science or related field. Ideally PhD in NLP, Machine Learning, or a related field, complemented by a solid track record in AI R&D (with good publications in A* conferences).

  • Must have knowledge of Metal Shading Language (MSL). You should be comfortable writing custom compute shaders from scratch.

  • Proven experience in low-level kernel optimizations and inference optimization on mobile devices is essential. Your contributions should have led to measurable improvements in inference latency, throughput, and memory footprint for domain-specific applications, particularly on resource-constrained devices and edge platforms.

  • A deep understanding of modern model serving architectures and inference optimization techniques is required. This includes state-of-the-art methods for achieving low-latency, high-throughput performance, and efficient memory management in diverse, resource-constrained deployment scenarios.

  • Must have strong expertise in writing GPU kernels for mobile devices (i.e., smartphones) as well as a deep understanding of model serving frameworks and engines. Practical experience in developing and deploying end-to-end inference pipelines, from optimizing models for efficient serving to integrating these solutions on resource-constrained devices is required.

  • Demonstrated ability to apply empirical research to overcome challenges in model serving, such as latency optimization, computational bottlenecks, and memory constraints. You should be proficient in designing robust evaluation frameworks and iterating on optimization strategies to continuously push the boundaries of inference performance and system efficiency.

  • Distributed Inference Systems: Designing and optimizing high-performance inference engines using techniques like Tensor Parallelism, Pipeline Parallelism, and Expert Parallelism to handle massive models on GPU clusters.

  • Deep understanding of the math and structure behind Diffusion Models and Vision Transformers

  • Understanding of Pruning, Quantization, Flash attention, KV Cache, Speculative Decoding (Eagle) etc.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work:

  • Interpret complex data science and statistical visualizations—such as Sankey diagrams, heatmaps, calibration curves, residual plots, correlation matrices, and distribution plots—applying advanced professional judgement and terminology.

  • Design clear, objective, multi-step analytical tasks and questions based on challenging visualizations, emphasizing quantitative reasoning beyond surface-level chart reading.

  • Create tasks that require graphical reasoning, trend analysis, comparison, interpolation, and statistical inference, always avoiding ambiguous or subjective prompts.

  • Participate in remote collaboration, contributing via written and verbal channels, incorporating feedback, and maintaining consistent communication with project stakeholders.

  • Consistently produce objectively verifiable tasks and solutions to support the rigorous training and evaluation of advanced AI models.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience in Data Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.

  • Minimum of two years’ professional, academic, or research background engaging with statistical models, data visualizations, or analytical reporting.

  • Advanced proficiency in interpreting axes, legends, units, scales, confidence intervals, and statistical annotations across diverse chart types.

  • Demonstrated ability to clearly articulate analytical processes and quantitative reasoning in high-quality written and verbal English.

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and, ideally, a second language relevant to your domain.

  • Experience with technical documentation, publication, assessment design, or structured analytical task development.

  • Background in producing data-annotation tasks, benchmark questions, technical reports, or related materials for data science, statistics, or AI-driven projects.

raw.description:
Product People is the premier destination for Product Management services in Europe. We cover parental leaves, discover/deliver great products, and accelerate transformation by acting as bar-raising pacesetters. Our in-house recruitment process has a 0.3% acceptance rate.

We empower our Product community of 60,000 members to share knowledge generously whilst managing the unglamorous hands-on work of a Product/Program Manager or Product Ops, on an interim/fractional basis (3-12 months). We onboard fast, align teams, and deliver outcomes. Selected clients include Amazon, eBay, Miro, FreeNow by Lyft, DeepL, and the World Health Organization.

🚀 About the Role

When people think of streaming, they think of Netflix. For music, it’s Spotify. When they think about Product Management, they should think of us.

You’ll jump into high-impact client projects, helping post-product market fit digital-first companies tackle strategic and executional challenges. Our clients include category leaders and companies navigating growth, innovation, or transformation.

  1. Solve problems for clients and for Product People.You’ll prioritise, zoom in and out, and make a real impact. You bring clarity to chaos and orchestrate seamless execution. You’ll manage discovery and delivery for three streams at once, internally and externally. You're comfortable with both strategy and hands-on, unglamorous work, and you know when to go deep or stay broad.
  2. Work with strong personalities and diverse teams.You adapt to communication styles and integrate quickly, feeling like part of the team within days, not weeks. People enjoy working with you, even when you push back. You're approachable, constructive, and always professional, even when challenging unrealistic demands.
  3. Serve as an Interim Product Manager. We serve post-product market-fit digital-first companies ranging from series B to publicly listed. Some are category leaders and/or leverage the latest tech trends. You’ll be driving complex cross-functional initiatives in B2C or B2B products. It can be anything from setting and reaching quarterly OKRs at a scale-up to Continuous Discovery/Jobs To Be Done (JTBD) or A/B tests elsewhere. Or unblocking stuck initiatives.
  4. Craft and communicate compelling product narratives.For every feature or capability, you can answer:
    • What job/problem does this solve?
    • For whom?
    • How big is the market/problem?
    • What does success look like?
    • Why does solving this matter?
    • You’ll share and help shape strategic context with clients’ CPOs, VPs, Directors, or Heads of Product.
  5. Coach the next generation of PMs. Train, mentor, and delegate relentlessly to help our Associate Product Managers strengthen their skills. Manage 1-6 people depending on tenure, performance reviews, and career ambitions. Collaborate with 2-3 colleagues daily. Break down complex initiatives into manageable, quantifiable work for the team. We use the teaching hospital method (watch, do it yourself under supervision, teach others to do it).
  6. Rinse and repeat. Go on a new mission with a new client or in a new team, new domain, new product, or initiative every 3-6 months. Continue sharpening your edge and actively helping Product People's internal initiatives.

🧠 About You

  • You Fix the Mess (and kind of love it).You arrive when things are messy, and leave behind clarity, structure, and surprisingly joyful spreadsheets. Most clients don’t bring us in during the calm; they call when it’s “uh-oh” o’clock. You don’t just handle chaos, you thrive in it and somehow make it fun (for you and them).
  • Optimism as an Operating System.Your emotional operating system is set to “can-do.” You stay calm during meltdowns, and you deliver difficult truths with a smile and a plan. You’re relentlessly polite, cheerfully persistent, and immune to drama. Basically, if Product were a weather system, you’re the high-pressure zone that clears the storm.
  • You’re Driven, Collaborative, and Charmingly Direct.You’re the teammate clients want back, and your ex-colleagues leave cushy roles to work with you again. You speak human, not jargon. Feedback? You give it kindly, take it well, and treat it like a cheat code for levelling up. You’re here to do excellent work, lift others up, and make the team better.
  • You Context Switch like it’s a superpower.You can drop into an engineer’s Slack thread, jump to an exec pitch, and then sketch out a roadmap, all before your second coffee. Clients don’t always come to us at their most organised times (read: M&A, staff turnover, existential crisis). You roll with it, find the signal in the noise, and make magic across shifting priorities. At the same time, you know how to create boundaries that support effective collaboration.
  • You think commercially.You get how businesses grow, where money comes from, and which bets matter. You speak in impact, not just input. Whether it’s retention, expansion, or efficiency, you know how to chase the outcome, measure it, and ship value without gold-plating the roadmap.

💸 Compensation & Perks

  • Based on the location, tax of residence, and level. The exact level is defined based on the skills and knowledge demonstrated within the hiring process, which includes an unbiased blind review (more about our hiring process). However, this vacancy is focused on finding the best PMCs at an L4 level. To ensure fairness, the salaries are the same for everyone within the same Level and Location Tier.
    1. Product Management Consultant (L4)
      1. Location Cluster 1 (High cost of living countries) €80,000/year
      2. Location Cluster 2 (EU countries, medium cost of living) €50,400/year
      3. Location Cluster 3 (Non-EU, lower cost of living) €40,000/year
  • Check our transparent salaries.
  • Tenure-Based Compensation Increase.
    A 5% increase after 12 months and a 10% increase after 24 months of tenure. Resets and restarts when promoted to the next level.
  • Uncapped bonuses (quarterly).We usually pay ~€25,000/quarter in bonuses to team members. These are transparently shared across our organisation. (e.g., €3,000 employee referral, €1,000 client expansion, €1,000 when a client returns, etc.). To be eligible, the team member must be at Product People at the end of the quarter, and not pending an exit (resignation, termination, or counsel to leave).
  • Profit participation (yearly).
    In March, we split a % of last year’s profit between all eligible employees with 12+ months of tenure at the time of the payout and not pending an exit (resignation, termination, or counsel to leave).
  • Get ready for this: We don't just offer a job, we invest in you. Enjoy a Wellness Budget, Home Office/Coworking perks, and a 3-year anniversary gift. We also fuel your growth with learning and networking budgets, and support you with generous leave policies. Benefit from annual workations, unlimited unpaid time off, and a paid sabbatical every 3 years. Plus, we rock a 4-day workweek! We're serious about a workplace that supports your life, not just your work.
  • Paid sabbatical accrued every 3 years.* You get a paid month off every 3 years, on top of your regular holiday allowance. Take unpaid leave anytime; we’ll cover your health insurance.
  • [Optional] 4-day work week.* Free up space and time to pursue an MBA, travel for a longer time, or just do nothing. Our default is a 5-day workweek; you can opt in and out of a 4-day workweek with at least one month's notice to minimise the impact on the team’s workload. The compensation impact is 80% of the salary in years 1-2, 85% of the salary in years 3, and 90% of the salary in years 4+.
  • [Optional] Germany Relocation after 24+ months*. We sponsor a relocation to Berlin, Germany for team members at L4+ levels who've been with our firm for at least 24 months. Should you decide to relocate on your own before being eligible for our support, we can only change your work contract to the German one after you have your visa and paperwork in order.

📚 Growth Opportunities

  1. Measurement of success. We prioritise continuous growth and feedback. Regular performance appraisals are led by Line Managers and the VP/Director of Product and involve monthly reviews of a 3-month development plan focusing on skill growth. Evaluations encompass 360-degree feedback, client feedback in conjunction with internal reviews, direct observations by managers, and adherence to Product People Levelling Expectations.
  2. Promotions. To be promoted, meet the role's tenure criteria, demonstrate performance at the next level for 6 months, and submit an approved promotion case. We have a strong track record of promoting people from within and taking team members from Associate to Product Manager or from Senior to Director of Product during their successful tenures at Product People.
  3. Continuous learning. Continuous learning is at our core. Embracing "Spread knowledge generously," we foster growth through weekly Sharing and Rubber Ducky sessions, a dedicated #help channel, and promoting peer mentorship. These opportunities complement the structured mentoring from line managers and mission supervisors in the Product People Trio framework. We also offer a Learning Budget to expand your Product Management knowledge.

What Makes Us Special

  • Accelerate your personal and career growth. 10x your learning and networking opportunities by being exposed to multiple companies and teams each year. We give timely, candid, and direct feedback and expect you to do the same. We run 4-month performance reviews for each person. This helps us improve the team, maintain the quality of service, and proactively promote people who show sustained performance at the next level.
  • Amazing culture. We have a supportive, high-performance, and open culture. It starts with onboarding you well. We hire and retain the best people living our values while counseling to leave those happier elsewhere. We share knowledge generously while being excellent and candid with each other.
  • Structured onboarding and support network. Who says small companies need to be chaotic? Our onboarding guide contains everything you need, and if you need more, there’s our #help channel! We proactively share our learning with each other through sharing sessions and help each other resolve complex situations through peer mentoring.
  • Levels tied to compensation. Your compensation changes when your title and level change. This is not the case with other companies (e.g., someone promotes, but they don’t earn more money afterwards). Moreover, we offer tenure raises that are independent of levels and promotions.
  • Remote working. We work distributed first. We recommend setting up a dedicated workspace for which you can choose to expense a MacBook, external monitor, ring light, room divider, and plants. As it can sometimes get lonely, consider that you’ll need to proactively schedule in-person meetings, sports, or other activities that provide a good cutoff and help you recharge after work.
    • We operate in Central European Time, and our team values effective collaboration. To ensure seamless communication and teamwork, and support a sustainable lifestyle, we accommodate a maximum time difference of +4.5 hours / -1 to -2 hours. Please consider this when applying for the position.

For more detailed information about our culture, ways of working, transparent salaries, and career track, please visit our Prospective Candidate FAQs.

Want to keep up with Product People? Subscribe to our Newsletter through our SubStack and follow us on social media (LinkedIn, YouTube, Telegram).

*Only applies to PMs and/or full-time employees.

Note that we assign a higher ranking to the questionnaire below than to CVs.

As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs. We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.


Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.


The Problem

Platform Architecture is our most overloaded cross-cutting team. Priorities are pushed down onto them from every direction. They're also the final gate in the PR approval chain (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture) — not the only reviewers, but the ones who carry the heaviest review load and have the most influence over how that process is designed — which makes them a bottleneck with limited ability to control their own inbound work.


Infrastructure has a related but distinct problem. They just stood up a formal SDLC and are early in adopting ADO, and teams with dependencies on them often reach out at the last minute rather than planning ahead — disrupting their flow of work the same way competing top-down asks disrupt Platform Architecture's. They also need to get better at communicating outward: proactively flagging when scrum and product teams need to test architectural changes or enhancements, rather than that falling through the cracks after the fact.


Both teams need their capacity protected from poorly-timed, uncoordinated demands, and both need a partner who can build the two-way communication habits — inbound planning lead time and outbound impact visibility — that neither currently has.


We also want dedicated Agile coaching capacity across the broader team eventually — someone who can dig into how each team runs planning, standups, and retros, and help our strategic Agile plan translate into practice, not just theory. That's not this role's starting focus: given the depth of what's already being asked for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, we don't want to set this person up to juggle too much on day one. We see broader coaching as a natural growth path for this role once the Platform Architecture and Infrastructure work is stable, and only if/when they have the capacity for it.


The Role

Reports to the Head of Agile or Head of AI Enabled Delivery with a dotted line to the other. Serves as the embedded Scrum Master for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure, and acts as mentor/lead to the other Scrum Masters across the organization to drive consistent execution of our Agile strategy. No direct reports.


Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities (Day One)

  • Prioritization gatekeeping: Push back on stakeholders, convene cross-team prioritization sessions, and protect Platform Architecture and Infrastructure capacity from competing top-down asks, maintaining clear cross-portfolio dependency maps so trade-offs are visible to stakeholders.
  • Cross-team visibility & coaching: Coach Platform Architecture and Infrastructure to proactively communicate their work, roadmap, and potential downstream impact to dependent scrum and product teams; facilitate a recurring cross-team forum until this becomes routine practice, and use it to support prioritization decisions.
  • Capacity protection for bottleneck relief: Influence and partner with Platform Architecture leadership to reduce the volume of competing top-down asks landing directly on their team, freeing their capacity to redesign the release-approval process they anchor (Platform Review → Staff Engineering → Platform Architecture). This role does not own that approval process itself — it protects the time Platform Architecture needs to fix it.
  • Ceremony-level coaching: Run and coach ceremonies for both teams, tailoring facilitation and training to each team's specific needs and maturity rather than a one-size-fits-all approach.
  • Strategic accountability: Report directly to the Heads of Agile on team health, blockers, and adherence to the strategic plan.
  • Compliance & documentation: Ensure delivery routines for Platform Architecture and Infrastructure align with applicable security, risk, and governance requirements across Baldwin partner organizations; support accurate delivery documentation and audit/accreditation readiness where required.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • SM mentorship: Provide informal lead guidance to the Scrum Masters on other teams, ensuring our strategic Agile plan is executed consistently across the org.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as an embedded Scrum Master or Agile Coach supporting highly technical, cross-cutting engineering or infrastructure teams.
  • Strong negotiation and stakeholder-alignment skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across business units and portfolios.
  • Working knowledge of Azure DevOps (ADO); familiarity with DevSecOps, multi-cloud, or CI/CD delivery environments a plus.
  • Experience with cross-portfolio dependency mapping, OKRs, and delivery/quality metrics reporting.
  • Agile certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe SSM/Advanced SM, or equivalent) preferred.

Success Metrics (6–12 Months)

  • Platform Architecture reports measurably more protected capacity (e.g., reduced ad hoc/competing asks), enabling them to own redesign of their release-approval process.
  • Recurring cross-stakeholder prioritization cadence established and adopted.
  • Recurring roadmap/impact forum between Platform Architecture, Infrastructure, and dependent teams established and running independently of this role.
  • Visible execution of the Heads of Agile's strategic plan across team ceremonies.

Growth Opportunity (As Capacity Allows)

  • Tailored coaching plans rolled out for Scrum Masters.
  • Informal coaching practices shared with Scrum Masters on other teams, if bandwidth allows once core scope is stable.

About OSW Group

OSW Group is a fast growing global ecosystem of businesses united by a shared vision to accelerate the world's transition to smarter, more sustainable energy and technology solutions. Our portfolio includes One Stop Warehouse (OSW), GreenSketch, GreenDeal, Manta and Sunmine, combining expertise across renewable energy, AI-powered software, energy finance and digital infrastructure to drive innovation on a global scale.

With operations across Australia, Singapore, China, Europe, the United States and Mexico—and continuing to expand into new markets—we're creating opportunities for ambitious people to build meaningful, international careers. While each of our businesses has its own unique focus, we're connected by a collaborative culture, entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for challenging what's possible.

When you join OSW Group, you're joining more than a company—you're becoming part of a global team that's shaping the future of clean energy and technology. We invest in our people, encourage fresh ideas, celebrate success and provide the opportunity to grow alongside a business that's only just getting started.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field; REE license
  • At least 5 years of experience in the Solar PV industry, preferably with experience in pre-sales and technical sales.
  • Strong knowledge and experience in PV system design, sizing, analysis, and technical evaluation.
  • Proficient in preparing technical proposals, system designs, BOMs, energy yield analysis, and project costing.
  • Good understanding of On-Grid, Hybrid, and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).
  • Strong leadership, communication, presentation, and team management skills. -Ability to lead technical teams and provide technical guidance to sales and project teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate customer requirements into practical and technically sound solar solutions.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

Technical Leadership: Lead the technical team in the Philippines and guide the sales and project teams on technical matters.

  • Assign and review the work of the technical team, and set priorities for design and support tasks.
  • Act as the final technical reviewer of designs and proposals before they are sent to customers.

Pre-Sales and Solution Design: Assess customer needs and design On-Grid, Hybrid and BESS solutions for residential and C&I projects.

  • Conduct site surveys, load analysis and electricity bill reviews to determine the right system size.
  • Join sales meetings and customer presentations to explain the proposed solution.

Technical Proposals and Costing: Prepare technical proposals, BOMs, energy yield analysis and project costing using the OSW product range.

  • Prepare single-line diagrams, panel layouts and equipment specifications.
  • Work with the sales and accounting team to align pricing, margins and payment terms.

Standards and Compliance: Ensure designs and products meet local codes and regulations, and support permit and net-metering applications.

  • Keep up to date with changes to the PEC, DOE and ERC rules and distribution utility requirements.
  • Prepare the technical documents needed for permits and net-metering applications.

After-Sales and Technical Escalations: Handle technical escalations, troubleshooting and warranty claims.

  • Diagnose system faults remotely or on site, and coordinate repairs with partners and installers.
  • Liaise with manufacturers on warranty claims and follow them through to closure.

Product Evaluation and Market Development: Evaluate new products and support OSW’s growth in the Philippines.

  • Test and assess new products, and share feedback with the OSW product team.
  • Monitor competitor products, pricing and market trends in the Philippines.

Training and Capability Building: Train the sales team, partners and customers, and build the local team’s technical skills.

  • Conduct product and installation training for partners, installers and the sales team.
  • Prepare training materials, installation guides and FAQs.

Processes, Records and Systems: Maintain technical processes and records, including the CRM, in line with OSW standards.

  • Keep design files, datasheets and project documents organised and easy to access.
  • Update the CRM with technical inputs on leads, opportunities and support cases.

Collaboration and Reporting: Work with the Country Manager and OSW teams, and report on technical matters and project status.

  • Submit regular reports on technical activities, project status and open issues to the Country Manager.
  • Coordinate with OSW regional and head office teams on product and technical matters.

Other Duties: Perform other related duties as may be assigned by the Country Manager.

  • Build, test, and scale acquisition funnels for a high-ticket B2C product, from the first ad impression through qualification, consultations, and enrollment.
  • Optimize for qualified prospects and customer acquisition cost, using CRM data, sales call transcripts, and conversion rates across the funnel to guide decisions.
  • Develop and rapidly test hypotheses around audiences, messaging, offers, creative formats, and landing pages. Scale what works and stop what doesn’t.
  • Turn audience research and competitor insights into actionable creative briefs. Work with the team and external partners to produce and iterate on ads and landing pages.
  • Set up advertising accounts, pixels, conversion events, and campaign tracking, with support from analytics and engineering teams where needed.
  • Work closely with Sales to improve lead quality and build a qualified waitlist ahead of the opening of paid enrollment.

Requirements

  • 4+ years in performance marketing or user acquisition, with recent hands-on experience managing both Meta Ads and Google Ads, including audience acquisition through YouTube.
  • Experience in acquisition-first or paid-marketing-first companies, where paid acquisition is a core driver of revenue.
  • Proven success acquiring customers for high-ticket B2C products through multi-step funnels involving qualification, consultations, and sales conversations. Experience with products priced at $10,000+ is strongly preferred.
  • Experience personally managing monthly advertising budgets of $50,000–$100,000 or more, with measurable business results.
  • A track record of launching acquisition from scratch: setting up accounts and tracking, testing initial hypotheses, finding effective combinations of audiences, offers, and creatives, and scaling them.
  • Strong hands-on Meta Ads expertise, including campaign structure, audience testing, pixel and conversion setup, creative experimentation, and budget optimization.
  • Hands-on Google Ads expertise beyond Search, particularly YouTube and video-led acquisition for products that require consideration and demand generation.
  • Full-funnel analytical skills: you work with CAC, ROMI, lead-to-call and call-to-sale conversion rates, and use CRM and BI data to assess performance beyond cost per lead.
  • Practical experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, advertising pixels, and conversion tracking. You can define conversion events and validate tracking, collaborating with analysts and engineers when needed.
  • Experience testing offers, ad copy, creatives, and landing pages, and writing clear briefs for designers, content producers, and external partners.
  • Confidence working independently in a new product environment, with limited historical data and no established acquisition playbook.
  • AI tools are already part of your day-to-day workflow.
  • Full professional English.
  • Based within CET ±3 hours, with at least 2 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time.

What we can offer you

  • Competitive compensation: 4500-5000 USD Gross per month.
  • Full-time remote contract with a flexible schedule.
  • A close-knit, international team of thoughtful and driven professionals.
  • All software licenses and remote work tools you need to be successful in a remote working environment (Slack, Miro, Notion, Zoom, etc).

JOB PURPOSE

The Solutions Engineer is responsible for assessing, developing and supporting the implementation of logistics solutions that improve current and prospective clients’ business models. The individual will possess strong evaluation skills as you review current state, using appropriate tools/diagrams. Detailed data analysis will complement the process to ensure an ideal future state is designed. As an integral part of the Transportation Insight sales process, the Solutions Engineer will be a hands-on leader.


This role is responsible for supporting the deal cycle with an emphasis on strategic thought, business acumen, creative problem-solving, flexibility, and sound judgment. The Solutions Engineer will collaborate with key cross-functional stakeholders, senior-level team members and prospective clients to design a solution that meets client-stated needs/requirements, can be operated by the organization, and that is profitable.

The individual in this role brings demonstrated skills in consultative selling, supply chain management, TMS system implementation, project management and is able to apply these skills effectively across functional departments.  They are able to price complex multi-mode service solutions and provide key inputs for the production, demonstration and presentation of documents to prospective clients. 

 

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ability to effectively communicate the value and differentiators of Transportation Insight as a logistics partner, as well as our core competencies of services across all modes
  • Gather client requirements and understand the key drivers for delivering value-based supply chain improvements.
  • Assess a validated prospects’ current supply chain program by documenting current state.
  • Coordinate the assessment process for assigned validated prospects.  Hold the internal organization accountable for meeting assigned timelines.
  • Understand the client's systems/applications used in current state, overall objectives and requirements to propose the best solution for their needs.
  • Work with a cross-functional delivery team to develop a solutions strategy and operational framework.
  • Participate in the solution design process by facilitating prospect strategy meetings and coordinating internal resources.
  • Document the future solution to help with the production of presentations and other documentation as needed
  • Help create pricing strategies for Transportation Insight service offerings that are both competitive and attractive to prospective clients.
  • Assist sales personnel, as needed, in demonstrating technology platforms that lead to closure of new business.
  • Effectively communicate with prospects and clients at the necessary pace, utilizing phone, web and on site as appropriate.
  • Collect information on client's unfulfilled needs and potential service improvements and report with recommendations to Solutions leadership
  • Assess from continuous improvement standpoint the standard approach for the transitioning of clients from the sales organization to implementation/account management teams.
  • Support ongoing improvement efforts by documenting best practices.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • BS degree in business or related field.  MBA is preferred and required if Bachelor’s degree is not in business or related field.
  • Experienced logistics professional with 5+ (five) years of experience in Supply Chain management related fields.
  • Minimum 4 (four) years of complex, consultative, solutions experience is required.
  • Direct consulting experience of transportation, logistics, and/ or TMS at the C-Suite decision-making level

SUPPORTING SKILLS/ABILITIES

  • Proven success in consistently driving revenue-generating solutions with tangible results.
  • Advanced experience working with Microsoft Office Applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Visio).
  • LEAN / Six Sigma Certification or Experience a plus.
  • Detailed oriented, self-starter with a strong work ethic.
  • Displaying leadership at the contributor level
  • Continuous learner & diligence in development of individual growth goals
  • Ability to manage multiple projects at any given time and be able to prioritize and meet deadlines.
  • Strong collaborator in working with internal operations teams in solution development stages
  • Possess excellent organizational skills with the flexibility to adapt to change under stress and within tight deadlines.
  • Effective problem solver, able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner, gather and analyze information skillfully, & develop alternative solutions when necessary.
  • Strong technical skills, including project planning, presentation, and general business applications.
  • Exceptional communication skills (both written and oral)
  • Ability to operate under minimal supervision and time constraints.

**MAY PERFORM OTHER DUTIES AS ASSIGNED**


Location Eligibility

This role is open to candidates based in the following U.S. states:
Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New York, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin.


Candidates must reside in one of the states listed above to be considered. Unfortunately, we are unable to move forward with applicants outside of these locations at this time.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Standard office environment, usually indoors away from the elements with moderate noise. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

PHYSICALEFFORT

Maintain a stationary position for extended periods; move about the office, operate computers and files, as needed; and frequently communicate with others. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit and talk or hear. The employee is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. Occasionally, the employee is required to lift boxes up to 20 pounds. 

SCHEDULING

This is a full-time benefits-eligible position, working Monday through Friday; 8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time. An employee in this position must be available to work occasionally on weekends and evenings, during peak periods

TRAVEL

Local travel and out of state travel is required and can be up to 15% of the time.

DISCLAIMER

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required.

In an effort to recruit, develop and retain top talent, we are committed to a policy of nondiscrimination in all personnel practices to ensure equal opportunity for employment, promotion, and training for a more inclusive workforce.

Description

About Us

﻿

Appdome is a fast-growing SaaS company specializing in innovative security, defense, anti-fraud and anti-bot solutions for mobile applications. We provide enterprise customers with cutting-edge AI-driven technology with a no-code solution and platform for building, releasing, monitoring, and managing Appdome-protected mobile applications. We are seeking an Enablement Engineer to support our customers in APAC.

In this role, you will focus on customer retention and growth by building trusted relationships, understanding customers’ security objectives, and driving successful outcomes.

The Enablement Engineer (EE) is a technical advocate for Appdome in pre-sales, trials, onboarding, and upsell engagements. This role partners with Sales and Service Delivery to demonstrate Appdome’s value, remove technical barriers, and enable prospects, partners, and customers to succeed with Appdome across their lifecycle.

In this role you will introduce Appdome to prospects and partners through compelling presentations and product demonstrations. Scope and qualify technical requirements for trials, proof of value (POVs), and customer onboarding. Lead POVs and technical evaluations, define success criteria, and guide customers toward successful outcomes. Drive adoption and expansion through onboarding workshops, training, and introductions to new offerings. Advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with Product, Sales, and Service Delivery teams.

Enablement includes all pre-sales and upsell enablement, POV leadership, onboarding, training, and partner enablement, as well as active engagement with customers on new offerings.

Responsibilities:

﻿

As a Domain Expert:

﻿

  • Deliver Appdome platform demos and technical presentations.
  • Train partners and sales teams on positioning and technical usage.
  • Maintain updated CDA templates, RFP materials, and enablement assets.
  • Represent Appdome at partner events, webinars, and industry sessions.
  • Use Appdome product and new features with a critical eye, raise bugs, provide feedback, and suggest improvements to ensure product quality.

﻿Scoping & Pre-Sales Engagement:

﻿

  • Document prospect requirements in Hubspot with full technical context.
  • Draft scopes, validate with leadership, and ensure completeness for POVs.
  • Manage enablement engineering data entries, ensuring fields are updated in CRM.

Proof-of-Value (POV) Leadership:

﻿

  • Conduct POV preparation meetings, aligning on requirements and expectations.
  • Register POVs in Totango, manage trial teams, and coordinate with SDEs for technical setup.
  • Run POV workshops and trial wrap sessions.
  • Maintain close contact with prospects during trials, escalating technical issues to SDE as needed.

Sales & Upsell Support:

﻿

  • Support Sales Rep in verifying quote sheet scope when required.
  • Participate in pricing and commercial discussions where scope influences strategy.
  • Defend Appdome’s value during customer proposal meetings.
  • Lead enablement for new product offerings and upsell trials.

Onboarding & Go-Lives:

﻿

  • Lead kickoff calls, onboarding workshops, and training sessions.
  • Manage Totango entries for onboarding progress.
  • Collaborate with SDEs during go-lives, leading high-stakes or complex implementations and supporting standard ones.

Promote Enablement Function:

﻿

  • Develop training decks, onboarding content, and enablement sessions.
  • Provide ongoing partner and reseller enablement.
  • Serve as trusted technical point of contact for prospects and customers adopting new Appdome features.

Handoff Model with Service Delivery:

﻿

  • Trials: EE leads trial definition, scope, workshops, and prospect engagement. SDE manages technical team setup and ticket handling.
  • Onboarding: EE leads kickoff and workshops. SDE assumes long-term technical account management from that point.
  • Go-Lives: EE plays an active role in selective named accounts, SDE leads streamlined go-lives. SDETL provides escalation support.

Requirements

Core Technical & Domain Requirements

﻿

  • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, including client-server communication, APIs, and SDK integration.
  • Hands-on experience with application security concepts such as encryption, authentication, certificate pinning, runtime protection, and threat models.
  • Ability to analyze mobile app behavior using logs, debuggers, proxies (e.g., network traffic inspection), and monitoring tools.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native SaaS platforms, including deployment models, subscription licensing, and feature-based packaging.
  • Experience supporting technical evaluations, proofs-of-concept, or trials in customer-facing environments.

Pre-Sales & Enablement Skills

﻿

  • Proven ability to translate customer business objectives into technical requirements and solution designs.
  • Experience leading technical workshops, demos, and enablement sessions for diverse audiences (developers, security teams, executives).
  • Strong capability to own technical success during trials, POVs, and onboarding engagements.
  • Comfortable acting as a technical authority in sales cycles without being
  • Ability to support upsell and expansion motions by identifying technical value and aligning it with customer needs.

Customer & Partner Engagement

﻿

  • Experience working with partners, resellers, or system integrators, including technical onboarding and ongoing enablement.
  • Skilled at managing multiple stakeholders across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success.
  • Ability to advocate for customer needs internally and influence product roadmap and feature prioritization.
  • Comfortable handling high-stakes customer interactions, including escalations and executive-facing meetings.

Required Qualifications

﻿

  • Strong technical knowledge of mobile applications, Android and iOS platforms, and application security fundamentals highly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as solutions engineering, technical enablement, implementation, or technical consulting.
  • Proven ability to scope technical requirements, define success criteria, and lead proofs of value and technical evaluations.
  • Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to deliver product demonstrations and explain technical concepts to diverse audiences.
  • Experience delivering customer onboarding, hands-on workshops, and technical training.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with ownership of technical issues through resolution.
  • Ability to collaborate across Product, Sales, and Service Delivery teams while managing multiple customer engagements.
  • Ability to connect product capabilities to customer goals and support ongoing adoption and expansion.
  • Successful experience in start-up and large company environments
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • This role is based in either Manila, Philippines, or Singapore.
  • Applicants must currently reside in one of these locations and be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required.

Appdome is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

Actual compensation as well as title, are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, and certifications, among others.

The total compensation package for this position may also include performance bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit and business needs.

We take great strides to ensure our employees have the resources to live well, be healthy, continue learning, develop skills, grow professionally and serve our local communities. We invite you to apply for a career with us.


Residency in or relocation to Louisiana is preferred for all positions.


Applicants must be authorized to work for Louisiana Blue in the United States without employer-sponsored immigration support. Louisiana Blue will not provide current or future employment-based immigration sponsorship or other immigration support for this opportunity, including H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, E-3, TN, or J-1 sponsorship or F-1 OPT/STEM OPT/CPT support. Applicants who would require such sponsorship or employer support during their employment should not pursue this opportunity.

Position Summary


The Healthcare Price and Transparency Analyst develops and supports reliable analytical solutions that improve price transparency and provider reimbursement operations. The role uses SQL, analytical and reporting tools, healthcare data, and business knowledge to analyze and validate data, research complex issues, develop reporting and analytics solutions, support regulatory and industry submissions, and translate operational requirements into actionable insights. The role is an individual contributor and reports to the Manager, Healthcare Price and Transparency.


What You Will Do

  • Support price transparency research, analytics, reporting, and regulatory and industry submissions for programs and processes such as Blue Axis/NCCT, machine-readable files, shopper and price comparison tool programs, and qualified payment amount calculations.
  • Develop and maintain analytical and reporting solutions for Provider Reimbursement, Payment Integrity, Medical Coding, and other provider areas, including data analysis and validation, issue investigation and resolution, and process improvement.
  • Translate business requirements into analytical solutions and create and maintain documentation for data sources, business rules, calculations, controls, testing, and reporting processes.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to complete projects and resolve issues while following applicable privacy, security, data-governance, and compliance requirements.

Core Competencies

  • Critical thinking and analytical problem-solving to evaluate results, identify inconsistencies, investigate issues, understand business processes and operational workflows, and contribute to sustainable analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Attention to detail and ownership of accurate, complete, timely, and well-documented work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain financial, healthcare, and technical topics to technical and nontechnical audiences and work effectively with end users, business stakeholders, technical teams, leaders, and external partners.
  • Ability to manage priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing regulatory, reporting, and business needs.

Level Expectations and Minimum Qualifications:

Associate Healthcare Price and Transparency Analyst | Beginner | Learn and Support

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, technology, or healthcare field; four years of related experience may substitute for the degree.
  • At least six months of relevant work experience or LA Blue internship experience involving data, analytics, healthcare, IT, finance, reporting, or business operations.
  • Foundational technical skills, including SQL query writing, data joins and tables, and basic Microsoft Excel; Power BI and/or Tableau experience is preferred but not required.
  • Foundational analytical skills, including data validation, testing, reporting, data visualization, and process documentation, with healthcare claims, provider data, provider reimbursement, and medical coding knowledge preferred but not required.

Healthcare Price and Transparency Analyst | Developing Professional | Develop and Deliver

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, technology, or healthcare field; four years of related experience may substitute for the degree.
  • At least two years of analytical experience in healthcare, IT, finance, business operations, or another related industry; healthcare analytical experience and knowledge of claims, provider data, reimbursement methodologies, and/or medical coding concepts are preferred but not required.
  • Strong SQL development experience, including writing and maintaining complex queries, stored procedures, tables, views, and reporting datasets in a structured and maintainable manner.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, complex formulas, and Power Query; VBA experience is preferred. Experience with Power BI and/or Tableau for analytical, reporting, and visualization solutions is required.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, including independently testing and validating solutions, investigating and resolving discrepancies, and developing practical, well-documented solutions. raw.description:
At Verda, we're building a full-stack AI cloud, covering everything from data centers and hardware to our own cloud platform that the world's leading AI teams use to do serious AI work.

We strive to make a positive mark on the world through the infrastructure we build and give leading teams a service they can truly depend on. Headquartered in Helsinki, we operate globally with offices in London and San Francisco.

Join Verda while it’s still being built - not once it’s finished.

Why Verda

  • Cash and equity compensation along with various fringe benefits.

  • Profitable operations with rapid, sustained growth.

  • 30+ nationalities, with 6 different ones on the management team.

  • A real chance to make an impact and work alongside world class engineers, researchers, and partners across the global AI ecosystem.

Practicalities

  • Work mode: Remote (EU)

  • Level: Mid / Senior

  • Employment type: Full time and permanent

About the role

GPUs only deliver value once they're wired into a cluster that researchers can actually train on. As our HPC Engineer, you'll own the baremetal and virtualized clusters behind our AI cloud - from the InfiniBand fabric and shared filesystems up through the workload orchestration layer. You'll be the person who keeps large-scale GPU clusters healthy, performant, and ready for the next workload.

Your responsibilities

  • Administer baremetal GPU/HPC clusters end to end, from provisioning through day-two operations

  • Administer virtualized clusters, including the hypervisor and GPU virtualization stack underneath them

  • Design, deploy, and tune InfiniBand fabrics, including topology planning, subnet management, and performance validation

  • Deploy and operate shared/parallel filesystems supporting training and inference workloads, balancing performance, capacity, and reliability

  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues across the full fabric stack: fibers, transceivers, NICs, switches, drivers, and firmware

  • Partner with remote-hands and data center teams to diagnose hardware faults and execute physical-layer fixes and cluster expansions

  • Operate and tune Slurm (or equivalent) workload scheduling deployments used by customers and internal teams

  • Keep issue tracking, IPAM, and DCIM records accurate as clusters are built, changed, and decommissioned

  • Participate in on-call rotations and incident response for cluster-level issues

  • Collaborate with platform, network, and storage teams to integrate new clusters into the broader AI cloud

Your key competencies

  • Solid Linux skills, with specialization in memory management, PCIE topologies and virtualization being a bonus

  • Deep Infiniband knowledge, including fabric design, subnet management, and performance tuning

  • Solid experience with IB clustering, troubleshooting/debugging, understanding the ecosystem of fibers+transceivers+NICs+switches and all the things that could possibly fail in them

  • Experience about shared filesystems (e.g. Lustre, GPFS/Spectrum Scale, WekaFS, or similar)

  • Ability to work with remote hands teams to diagnose and resolve hardware issues remotely

  • Knowledge about NCCL, CUDA, DOCA and the Nvidia stack

  • Knowledge about Slurm and/or other workload scheduling solutions, bonus points for Slinky/slurm-bridge

  • Understanding the importance of keeping issue tracking/IPAM/DCIM up to date

  • Comfort operating production clusters where uptime and performance directly affect customer workloads

  • Scripting/automation ability (e.g. Python, Bash, Ansible) for repeatable cluster operations

Nice to have

  • RoCEv2 knowledge (and/or Spectrum-X)

  • Understanding of agentic guardrails, especially when applied to administration of complex systems

  • Ability to think beyond what is needed right now vs. some given trajectory or roadmap

  • Experience with GPU health-checking and diagnostics tooling (e.g. DCGM, field diagnostics)

  • Experience with baremetal provisioning/orchestration tooling (e.g. MAAS, Foreman, custom PXE/iPXE pipelines)

  • Familiarity with GPU-aware virtualization or containerization (Kubernetes device plugins, KVM/QEMU with GPU passthrough, SR-IOV)

  • Exposure to observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki) for cluster-level monitoring

What's next

We're building fast and this role needs the right person behind it. There's no artificial deadline, but when we find who we're looking for, we move. If this sounds like your next move, apply now.

Please submit your application through our Careers page. We don't accept applications sent by email.
