raw.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
raw.excerpt: About Imagine WorldwideAll children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need.
raw.description:
About Imagine Worldwide

All children have immense potential, but hundreds of millions don’t have access to the learning they need. Imagine Worldwide believes that every child should be empowered with the basic right to literacy and numeracy. We provide an innovative education technology solution and implementation model to the global literacy/numeracy learning crisis using the onebillion application and various toolkits and systems to support implementation. Our model is massively scalable, evidence-based, and can deliver foundational learning to millions of the most marginalized children.

Imagine Worldwide partners with governments, organizations, and communities to provide child-directed, tablet-based learning that is accessible, effective, and affordable. We are incorporated in California (United States) as a nonprofit organization, but operate in Sub-Saharan Africa through locally-registered entities in Malawi, Sierra Leone, and Tanzania. Learn more on our website.

Role Overview

The Senior Analytics Engineer builds, runs and improves Imagine’s analytics platform: the infrastructure, pipelines and core data models that the organisation’s reporting and analysis depend on. The central task is to scale the platform as data volumes grow, keeping costs under control without giving up performance. In a small team, that means covering the infrastructure underneath the data as well as the data engineering itself.

Imagine’s data comes from many sources. The largest is tablets in more than 1,500 schools across Malawi, Tanzania and Sierra Leone, which record learning activity as individual events, adding up to billions of records. These only become meaningful when joined with programme context, such as active schools per term, device allocations and enrolment, and with operational data from inventory and field data collection. Turning all of this into reliable data on a non-profit budget calls for careful decisions about where processing happens and what each workload costs.

The role reports to the Director of Analytics, who sets the platform’s architecture and technical standards, and works alongside the rest of the Analytics Team. We are looking for someone senior who takes initiative, turns architectural direction into working systems, and brings forward evidence-based proposals for improving them. As the engineer builds context, they take on increasing ownership of the platform’s day-to-day running and technical decisions.

Key Responsibilities

The Senior Analytics Engineer’s responsibilities fall into four pillars. The first two cover the platform itself: the infrastructure it runs on, and the pipelines that bring data in from many sources and process it at scale. The third covers orchestration and the core data models that the rest of the Analytics Team builds on. The fourth covers the practices that keep the platform reliable, secure and affordable to run.

Data Platform and Infrastructure

Imagine’s analytics platform runs on AWS and ClickHouse Cloud, with infrastructure managed as code. In a small team, this role carries the infrastructure work that a larger organisation would split across dedicated platform or DevOps staff, limited to the scope of the analytics platform.

  • Build and maintain the platform’s AWS infrastructure, including storage, compute, networking, the data catalogue, secrets and access management (S3, EC2, Glue Data Catalog, Lake Formation, IAM, Secrets Manager).
  • Manage infrastructure as code in Terraform, keeping environments reproducible, version-controlled and reviewable.
  • Administer the ClickHouse Cloud warehouse, including service configuration, user and role management, and monitoring of performance and capacity.
  • Host and maintain the team’s self-hosted tools, including Apache Superset for BI and Apache Airflow for orchestration. This covers deployment, upgrades, authentication and availability. The Senior BI & Data Analyst manages the dashboards and content within Superset.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions on how the platform evolves, setting out options and trade-offs for review with the Director of Analytics.

Large-Scale Data Processing and Pipelines

Data reaches the platform from application databases, operational systems and field data tools, and lands in an Apache Iceberg data lake on S3. Spark-based processing on AWS Glue does the heavy work before the data moves into ClickHouse for analysis. The aim is to do expensive processing once, as far upstream as practical, so that downstream models and queries stay fast and affordable.

  • Build and maintain ingestion pipelines from the platform’s sources, including application databases, APIs and operational systems, using tools such as AWS Glue, Airbyte and AWS Lambda.
  • Implement incremental loading patterns that stay efficient and recoverable as volumes grow, landing raw data in the lake in a form that preserves its full history.
  • Develop and optimise Spark jobs that process billions of device events into learning sessions and higher-level aggregates, paying close attention to partitioning, skew and compute cost.
  • Bring in and model the programme context that gives event data its meaning, such as schools, terms, device allocations and enrolment, and handle how that context changes over time.
  • Design and maintain Iceberg tables for performance and cost, including partitioning strategy, file sizing, compaction and snapshot management.
  • Validate data at ingestion and surface quality issues early, working with the Analytics Team to trace them back to their source.
  • Contribute to evaluating new processing approaches as volumes grow, including moving more work upstream and assessing where streaming would add value.

Orchestration and Transformation

Apache Airflow orchestrates the platform’s pipelines, and dbt transforms data in ClickHouse into the models that reporting and analysis rely on. This role builds and maintains the foundational layers of those models.

  • Build and maintain Airflow workflows that coordinate ingestion, processing and transformation, with clear dependencies, retries and alerting.
  • Develop and maintain dbt staging and core models in ClickHouse, following consistent conventions for naming, structure and materialisation.
  • Implement incremental models for high-volume tables, choosing materialisation strategies and table designs that balance freshness, correctness and cost.
  • Write and maintain dbt tests and model contracts for core datasets, so that changes that would break downstream reporting are caught before they reach production.
  • Document core models such as learning sessions as agreed definitions, including their lineage, and make clear where a model applies an approximation rather than a direct transformation.
  • Work with the Senior BI & Data Analyst on the boundary between core and reporting models, and with the Data Scientist on datasets for research and evaluation.

Reliability, Cost and Engineering Practice

A small team needs a platform that runs predictably and that more than one person understands. This pillar covers the engineering practices that make that possible.

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for infrastructure, pipeline and dbt code, including automated checks that stop unsafe changes from reaching production.
  • Implement monitoring and alerting across pipelines, the warehouse and hosted tools, so that failures and delays are visible quickly and reach the right people.
  • Respond to platform incidents and data issues, carry out root cause analysis, and contribute to the team’s data quality incident process.
  • Apply and maintain access controls and security practices across the data lake, warehouse and BI layer, in line with Imagine’s data governance policies.
  • Monitor platform costs across AWS and ClickHouse, track the cost and performance of individual workloads over time, and use that evidence to identify savings and prioritise optimisation work.
  • Maintain and periodically test backup and recovery procedures for the platform’s core components.
  • Take part in code review and write clear runbooks and technical documentation, following the team’s documentation standards, so that knowledge of the platform is shared across the team.

Requirements

The qualifications below are grouped by importance. Core requirements are needed to do the role from the start. Strongly preferred skills shorten the time it takes to become effective on Imagine’s platform. Advantageous experience adds value but is not expected. We do not expect any one candidate to bring everything listed here.

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated experience is weighted equally to formal credentials.

Experience

  • At least 7 years in data engineering, software engineering or platform engineering roles, including at least 3 years building and running distributed data processing (Spark or equivalent) in production.
  • A track record of taking responsibility for a production data platform, or major parts of one, including its reliability, performance and day-to-day operation.
  • Experience working with datasets in the hundreds of millions to billions of records, and designing processing that stays efficient as volumes grow.
  • Experience running data workloads within real budget constraints: making deliberate trade-offs between compute, storage and performance, and being able to show the effect of those decisions.
  • Experience managing the cloud infrastructure that data workloads run on, not only using managed services.
  • Experience in small teams where engineers cover a broad scope and work with limited supervision.
  • Experience working with remote teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Experience in the non-profit, international development or social sector is an advantage but not a requirement.

Technical Skills: Core

  • Strong Python, written to production standards, with testing and modular design.
  • Advanced SQL, including writing and optimising queries against analytical databases.
  • Spark (PySpark), including performance tuning for partitioning, shuffles and data skew.
  • A solid understanding of data lake design, including columnar formats such as Parquet, partitioning strategy, and when to process in the lake rather than the warehouse.
  • Hands-on AWS experience with data services and the infrastructure around them, such as S3, Glue or EMR, IAM and EC2.
  • Infrastructure as code, using Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK or similar.
  • Linux administration and Docker, to the level needed to deploy and maintain self-hosted services.
  • dbt in production, including incremental models and testing.
  • Workflow orchestration with Airflow, Dagster, Prefect or similar.
  • Git, CI/CD and code review practice.

Technical Skills: Strongly Preferred

  • Apache Iceberg, or another open table format such as Delta Lake or Hudi.
  • ClickHouse, or a comparable columnar warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or Redshift.
  • Terraform specifically.
  • Apache Airflow specifically.
  • AWS Glue and Lake Formation.
  • Data modelling for analytics, including handling reference data that changes over time.

Technical Skills: Advantageous

  • Managed Spark platforms such as Databricks.
  • Streaming technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Kinesis or Spark Structured Streaming.
  • Event, telemetry or IoT data, particularly from devices that sync intermittently.
  • Ingestion tools such as Airbyte.
  • Administering BI tools such as Apache Superset.
  • Software development beyond data pipelines, such as building APIs or system integrations.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary is competitive and commensurate with experience.

Location

The Senior Analytics Engineer must be based in Africa. The role will frequently collaborate and coordinate with operations teams across Africa, the US, and the UK.

This is a full-time remote position; the role can be based anywhere in Africa with reliable internet access and alignment with core working hours across time zones. The role may involve occasional international travel for in-person team meetings, field support or training, as needed. Candidates should be comfortable working independently in a virtual environment and coordinating with colleagues across global teams.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis

* * *

Imagine Worldwide is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Art Director

Heptic Arena — Full-Time — Remote (Europe)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based game development studio building unforgettable, player-first experiences with bold ideas and cutting-edge design. We're a small, cross-disciplined team, self-managing from wherever in the world we happen to be, united by a shared goal: making games we'd want to play ourselves. Heptic Arena, is a PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter that is heading to Steam Early Access and the Epic Games Store, and it's built entirely in Unreal Engine.

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Art Director with a strong background in art content production to lead the artistic vision and visual communication of Heptic Arena. You'll own every aspect of art content development, from first concepts to release ready assets (characters, species design, arena environments, weapons, UI/UX, concept art, and all player facing visuals) Working closely with creative leadership and cross-functional teams to keep the game cohesive, visually striking, and true to Heptic Arena's world.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the artistic vision, direct a talented art team, and stay closely involved in production, from early concepts through to live content updates after release.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the art direction of Heptic Arena across environment art, character/species art, animation, modelling, rigging, texturing, shader development, concept art, 2D, and UI/UX, setting clear direction so every asset is consistent, high-quality, and true to the game's identity.
  • Keep the species roster and world cohesive: maintain a consistent visual language across playable species (and future roster additions, skins, and cosmetics) as the game grows through Early Access and beyond.
  • Partner with creative and Technical Leadership: collaborate closely with the Creative Director, Game Designers, Technical Leaders, and PO to keep gameplay, design, and art seamlessly integrated across a live PvPvE arena shooter.
  • Build and maintain 3D art pipelines in Unreal Engine, solving technical challenges with cross-functional teams and optimizing workflows to support both quality and the pace of live-service content, new arenas, seasonal content, and post-launch drops.
  • Track progress and keep the team aligned using tools such as Jira and Confluence, monitoring milestones and giving regular feedback so the Art team stays on schedule without compromising quality.Initiate, plan, execute and control art content development.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Art, Design, or a closely related discipline. This academic foundation is expected to be complemented by substantial professional experience in a production environment.
  • A minimum of seven years of professional experience within the gaming industry is required. Exposed to the full lifecycle of game development, from pre-production through to live operations.
  • Must have hands-on experience delivering stylized games that rely on hand-painted textures. Skilled in maintaining a distinctive and cohesive visual identity across a roster of characters and environments.
  • At least one AA or AAA title must have been shipped under the candidate's direction or direct contribution. Must have knowledge and ability to see a large-scale production through to release.
  • Have a strong portfolio spanning traditional art skills, 3D art, animation, UI, and concept art. The portfolio should reflect versatility across disciplines as well as a consistently high standard of craftsmanship.
  • Excellent managerial and communication skills are required to lead and manage all of the art disciplines (2D, 3D, animation,...) within an agile production framework. The successful candidate will use tools such as Jira and Confluence to monitor milestones and provide regular feedback. Experience in Jira Advanced Roadmaps or Jira Plans will be considered a big plus.
  • Demonstrated experience resolving technical challenges in collaboration with cross-functional teams is essential. Must be able to optimize production workflows and improve both efficiency and creative output,
  • Proficiency in Maya and Substance Painter is required for this role.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and management skills are essential to this role. These qualities should be evidenced through hands-on production experience, ideally within a distributed or globally remote team.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplined team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

Lead UX/UI Designer

Heptic Arena — Full-Time — Remote (Europe)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based game development studio making bold, player-first games. We're a small, cross-disciplinary team working remotely across Europe, with a culture built on ownership, trust and self-management. Our first title, Heptic Arena, is a third-person PvPvE arena shooter set in an intergalactic game show. We're now building it with our community through closed playtests on the road to Early Access.

About the Role

We're looking for a Lead UX/UI Designer to own the user interface and player experience of Heptic Arena across PC and console. You'll report to the Creative Director and set the UI vision, standards and direction for the game. You'll also stay hands-on: designing screens, building assets and working in engine day to day.

This is a player/coach role. There's no line management, but you'll mentor junior designers and freelancers, review their work and raise the quality bar across the team. You'll be the go-to person for UI and UX decisions, working closely with art, design, engineering and production.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, Manage, Define and maintain Heptic Arena's Players UX,UI visual language and design system (components, typography, iconography, colour, motion,accessibility guidelines.

Lead UI/UX across the full player journey: front end, HUD, menus, progression, store, social features and onboarding.

Propose, Concept, Design, prototype and deliver: wireframes, user flows, screen maps, mockups and final UI assets, from early concept through to polish.

Work closely with Game Design and Engineering on implementation in Unreal Engine, and resolve UX trade-offs and technical constraints early.

Use playtest feedback, analytics and A/B testing to find UX problems and iterate on solutions.

Mentor junior designers and freelancers through design reviews, feedback and clear briefs.

Estimate, plan and prioritise UX/UI work with Production, Execute and control development, create and distribute UX/UI tasks in Jira.

Own UX/UI documentation in Confluence and keep it the single source of truth for the team.

Set up review and QA processes so that the implemented UI meets our quality, consistency and accessibility standards.

Represent UI/UX in leadership and cross-discipline discussions, and advocate for the player's experience.

About You

  • 5+ years of experience in game UI/UX design, including at least one shipped PC or console title.
  • A strong portfolio of PC/console game UI work (not mobile), showing both systems-level thinking and polished visual execution.
  • Deep knowledge of UI design principles, information hierarchy and usability, especially for real-time, action-heavy games.
  • Hands-on experience implementing UI in Unreal Engine (UMG/Common UI preferred)
  • Expert use of design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Miro, Axure, Adobe XD or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining a UI design system or style guide.
  • Proven ability to guide and mentor other designers and give clear, constructive feedback.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills, and confidence presenting and defending design decisions to stakeholders.
  • Comfortable with Jira,, Confluence and Google Workspace
  • Self-driven and organized, able to thrive in a remote, self-managing team.
  • Based in or near the Central European time zone (CET ± 2 hours).

Nice to have

  • Experience with UI animation and motion design, such as After Effects, Rive or in-engine animation.
  • Experience with multiplayer, live-service or competitive shooter UI, including HUDs, scoreboards, matchmaking, stores and battle passes.
  • Knowledge of console platform UI guidelines.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards for games.
  • Experience running or analysing usability tests.

Life at Prism Studio

We work as one unit with one common goal. Our purpose is to build a cross-disciplined team where everyone is self-managing, wherever they are in the world. We collaborate in an open, friendly way, as a global team built on talent and communication.

raw.description:
Company Overview:

Intel 471 empowers enterprises, government agencies, and other organizations to win the cybersecurity war using near-real-time insights into the latest malicious actors, relationships, threat patterns, and imminent attacks relevant to their businesses. Founded in 2014, Intel 471 provides comprehensive intelligence and monitoring on threat actors. The company’s centralized TITAN platform enables intelligence and security professionals to access structured information, dashboards, timely alerts and intelligence reporting via web portal or API integration.

Our pedigree is unmatched and we count upon a team with experience operating in the intelligence services, military, law enforcement and private threat intelligence companies in nearly every continent on earth.

The Role:

You own the technical depth of our vulnerability intelligence practice. When a new CVE drops, you're the person who determines what's actually true and decides what our customers should do about it.

This is a team lead role where you'll set the technical standard for how we validate, assess, and communicate vulnerability risk. You'll also build and maintain the tooling that lets a small team cover the ever-growing world of vulnerability research.

What You'll Do:

Design, build, and deploy honeypot systems to monitor for exploitation activity. Acquire, test, and validate proof-of-concept exploits in virtual environments to confirm or refute claims about exploitability. Develop practical mitigations for cases where patching is delayed, impossible, or insufficient. These mitigations could include configuration hardening, network segmentation, ACLs, disabling features, or other controls. You'll devise techniques for detecting both attempted and successful exploitation by illuminating the artifacts defenders should hunt for. You'll write vulnerability reports that dive into the details about an exploit such as how it works, who is using it and who is being targeted. Automation is a key component of the role; you will build and maintain the systems we use to streamline vulnerability assessment and automate triage of vulnerability alerts.

Required Qualifications:

Every candidate must be able to:

- Validate and test PoCs to verify the validity of exploitation claims.

- Devise mitigation techniques beyond patching.

- Devise techniques for detecting exploit activity, attempted or successful.

- Write vulnerability reports such as Vulnerability Spotlights.

- Identify new sources of vulnerability intelligence.

- Train and mentor junior team members.

Technical foundation:

- Proficiency with at least one programming language (Python, Go, C/C++, or similar) sufficient to read exploit code, modify PoCs, and build tooling.

- Hands-on fluency with virtual machines, containers, and re-usable lab environments for safe detonation and analysis.

- Solid computer science fundamentals.

- Thorough understanding of computing and internet fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP, DNS, TLS, authentication and authorization models, and how real systems are actually deployed.

- Demonstrated subject-matter-expert-level depth.

- A working bias toward automation.

Strong candidates additionally bring:

- Experience building honeypot or sensor systems to monitor real-world exploitation activity.

- Experience building systems that streamline or automate PoC testing and validation.

- Demonstrated ability to integrate a new intelligence source end-to-end, from evaluation and ingestion to normalization, enrichment and delivery.

Also valuable: original vulnerability research or CVE credits; reverse engineering skills; detection engineering (Sigma, Snort/Suricata, YARA); SOC experience; familiarity with CVSS, CWE, EPSS, and the KEV catalog; public speaking or published writing.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Remote-friendly culture
  • Wellness programs
  • A variety of professional development opportunities
  • Inclusive culture focused on people, customers and innovation

Our Culture:

The Intel 471 team is constantly growing and is always on the lookout for talented professionals who seek to operate on the forefront of the fight against threat actors impacting our customers and partners. Our culture of humility and quiet professionalism is a core attribute of Intel 471 and everyone within it. Our culture is collaborative, supportive and fast-paced. We're a mission-driven company. We're looking for talented, 'can-do' minded people with a passion for always doing the right thing.

We believe in supporting a progressive culture that allows all our people to be themselves, enjoy exciting opportunities and grow with us. That's why our culture is founded on our core values of openness, inclusion, integrity and client focus, which set the tone for how we work together and treat each other in order to empower us all – and foster a unique team spirit.

Salary: Market competitive

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful! Our K-8 platforms include Miacademy, Always Icecream, and Clever Dragons, and our 9-12 options include MiaPrep, MiaPrep Online High School (MOHS), and MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio, (MOAO). Our student base is rapidly growing, and we’re hiring for multiple positions across several departments! Our expansion stems from our commitment to providing exceptional educational content and our pursuit of new opportunities. 🚀

You can hear our CEO, Johannes Ziegler, discuss our company’s values and future!

How you’ll make an impact (position summary):

Curriculum Developers work closely with other subject-matter experts, our production team, and an instructional coach to produce immersive, engaging, and academically rigorous learning materials that constitute the core of our curriculum. These materials include videos, assessments, and written learning activities. Curriculum Developers are experts in their fields who thrive on independent writing and design tasks with a feedback-oriented mindset. Our team relies on highly motivated, collaborative, and student-driven individuals.

What you’ll do (responsibilities):

  • Spend a majority of your time designing and developing music educational content (video scripts, assessments, and written materials) for grades 6-12 students

  • Ensure content is pedagogically sound, engaging, age-appropriate, and accessible for students

  • Write clear and measurable lesson objectives, and align teaching materials to meet objectives

  • Use technology, such as Google Slides, Sheets, and Docs

  • Differentiate instruction to accommodate diverse student populations and needs

  • Continuously evaluate and refine content based on feedback and educational outcomes

  • Collaborate with peers on curriculum development

  • Give and receive feedback on lessons, course development, and processes

Check out a day in the life of a Miaplaza Curriculum Developer!

Requirements

You may be a good fit if you have (requirements):

  • A minimum of 2 years of full-time music classroom teaching experience at the 6-12 grade level

  • A Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Education or in a music-related field

  • Familiarity with writing lesson objectives and creating objective-aligned lesson materials

  • Experience creating well-structured and effective lessons

  • Ability to differentiate instruction to make learning accessible, engaging, and age-appropriate

  • Strong understanding of what makes a lesson engaging

  • Experience using technology to support instruction, including Google Slides, Sheets, and Docs

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, especially written

  • Growth mindset and motivated by constructive feedback

  • Proven ability to work independently, manage schedules, and meet deadlines

  • High motivation, a proactive attitude, and a tendency to seek opportunities for continuous improvement

  • High standards of integrity and transparency

  • Access to a computer/laptop (with a camera) and a reliable high-speed internet connection

What makes you stand out (nice-to-haves):

  • You have an active teaching certification, and/or you have completed professional development or training in curriculum design and pedagogy

  • You have hands-on experience designing and writing curriculum, including writing scripts for completely asynchronous video lessons

  • You have experience teaching and designing lessons for AP Music Theory or Ear Training/Aural Skills

  • You are comfortable with basic music technology, such as DAWs and music notation software

  • You have experience analyzing and transforming data into actionable goals that have positively impacted your students

  • You have experience with online instruction

  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and a set of skills that may not be listed here but are still transferable to this role.

  • If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply.

Compensation & benefits:

  • This is an hourly position that requires a minimum of 30 hours a week for full-time status. The expected starting pay range is $25.12 - $34.50 per hour. When working 40 hours per week year-round, this equates to an approximate annual pay range of $52,249–$71,760.

  • Miaplaza’s compensation philosophy ensures equity and competitiveness while considering the regional differences in living and labor costs. Specific rates will be provided during the hiring process and are aligned with market data and internal equity.

  • Compensation is evaluated twice per year. Employee compensation is determined by lesson quality, efficiency, and performance.

  • Full-time employees are eligible for health, dental, and vision insurance, including specialty care options such as fertility benefits, mental health services, and chiropractic care, as well as FSA, HSA, and more.

  • All employees are eligible for a 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match.

  • PTO is all-purpose time off, and combines traditional vacation and paid sick leave plans into one flexible, inclusive policy. Eligible employees can use PTO for all kinds of absences including: vacation, holidays, illness, injury, family leave, and other personal business. Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour for every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 139 hours per year, or about 17 eight-hour days on average.

  • Parental leave, and other perks and benefits are also available.

  • We invite your family and friends to join our journey! All employees receive free site memberships and discounted MOHS tuition for the children in their household, plus two additional memberships for other children in their lives.

What you’ll love about working at Miaplaza:

  • You’ll be part of a mission-driven team dedicated to innovative education solutions for children who learn in diverse ways.

  • We promote flexibility and encourage employees to shape their work environments and schedules around their lives!

Schedule:

  • Curriculum Developers are expected to have 30-40 hours of availability each week on a year-round basis. This range of hours is designed to offer flexibility in your schedule, and there is ample work available! We consider anything over 30 hours a week to be full-time, so you would be eligible for all of our benefits!

You will also have required team meetings, like professional developments and department meetings. Beyond that, what your schedule looks like is up to you! Morning person? Night owl? Somewhere in between? As long as you are meeting your deadlines, actively communicating, and are available for weekly meetings, we support the hours that work best for you.

raw.description:
Proudly voted a Great Place to Work®, we are a dynamic startup in the CPaaS (Communication Platform as a Service) space that is revolutionizing the way businesses communicate. Our team is made up of 500 energetic and passionate Unifones who are dedicated to delivering the best possible experience to 5000+ customer-centric companies.

We pride ourselves on our fun and collaborative work environment, where creativity and new ideas are constantly encouraged. As shareholders in the business, we’re so much more than a group of passionate communicators. We are Unifones. Join our team and be a part of something big!

Meet the team!
Our Engineering team is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the systems and technologies that drive Unifonic’s solutions. We work closely with other departments to ensure our products and services meet the needs of our customers. If you are passionate about technology and are excited about working on cutting-edge communication and engagement solutions, we want you on our team.
As a Senior DevOps Engineer in the Developer Experience (DevX) team, you will be working to cross and merge the barriers that exist between software development, testing, and operations teams, and keep existing networks in mind as they design, plan, and test.


Help us shape the future of communications by:

  • Setting up and enhancing CI (Continuous Integration) and CD (Continuous Deployment).

  • Configuring the company's products to meet the functional requirements, including the configuration of functional areas and technical areas (e.g. integration interfaces, integration maps, web services, transport protocols,etc).

  • Troubleshooting and remediating issues impacting the integration and operations of theinfrastructure and systems.

  • Ensuring high availability of the company’s products and platforms [24x7x365], including but not limited to messaging, voice, and e-mail gateways, in addition to assessing emergencies, providing analysis, and recommending solutions.

  • Writing and deploying scripts in different environments to automate day-to-day operations.

  • Maintaining servers’ configuration, monitoring jobs, and infrastructure documentation across the cloud environment (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, etc).

  • Working extensively with the offshore teams and network of partners on a daily basis.

Requirements

What you will bring:

  • Hands-on 5+ years of recent technical experience in a Professional Services/Enterprise DevOps role.

  • Strong technical skills and proficiency in multiple functional areas are required, such as infrastructure as Code (Terraform), containerize orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), configuration management (Ansible), programming language (Python), logging system (Elastic Stack), CI/CD (DroneCI, Argo CD) and network protocols and standards.

  • Bitbucket pipelines after DroneCI, ArgoCD

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants like Claude Code

  • Bachelor's degree in computer engineering, Software Engineering, or other IT-related fields.

  • The ability to spend substantial time interfacing with the offshore teams on a daily basis.

  • Fluent in English with excellent writing/editing and verbal communication skills.

Craft and ToolKit:

  • Infrastructure as Code: CloudFormation, Terraform.

  • Containerization and orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes.

  • Configuration management: Ansible.

  • Programming/scripting: Python.

  • Logging and monitoring: Elastic Stack.

  • CI/CD pipelines: DroneCI, Argo CD.

  • Networking protocols and enterprise standard.

Character Traits:

  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving – approach problems clearly, use data, and find solutions.

  • Ownership and accountability – take responsibility and follow projects through to completion.

  • Communication – explain ideas clearly and listen to others across teams.

  • Collaboration – work well with others and support team goals.

  • Adaptability and learning – adjust to change and keep learning new skills or tools.

  • Mentorship and knowledge sharing – help others grow and share what you know.

  • Resilience – stay calm under pressure and handle setbacks constructively.

  • Quality and attention to detail – do work carefully and strive for improvement.

  • Advocacy and innovation – encourage best practices, efficiency, and new ideas.

  • AI mindset and utilization – Leverage AI tools to enhance productivity and drive efficient, data-informed outcomes.

As a Unifone you will receive a range of benefits:

  • Competitive salary and bonus.

  • Unifonic share scheme (we are all owners!).

  • 30 holiday days after your first anniversary.

  • Flexible working arrangements.

  • Spend up to 25 days per year working from anywhere in the world!

  • Paid leave for new parents.

Highlights

Great Place to Work® certified, with a dynamic, people-first culture. Join a team shaping the future of business communication.

raw.title: Sales Enablement Professional
raw.excerpt: Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets.
raw.description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Enablement leader to architect the growth journey for our global sales organization. At Canonical, sales enablement isn't just about onboarding; it’s about ensuring our teams can articulate the complex value of Ubuntu, OpenStack, and AI infrastructure to the world’s most sophisticated tech leaders. You will act as a trusted partner to identify, scope, and implement tooling and workflow improvements that drive efficiency and reduce friction in the sales process. You will sit at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Sales, transforming high-level strategy into actionable field excellence.

If you are an experienced leader ready to lead global strategy, you will find a high-performance environment that challenges you. You will work with Sales Leadership to identify performance gaps, reduce ramp time, improve productivity and increase win rates. This is a high-visibility role where you will ensure our "distributed-first" workforce remains the sharpest in the industry.

Location: These are EMEA-based remote roles.

The role entails

  • Lead enablement programs to drive continuous improvement in sales productivity and ramp time
  • Lead the design and execution of global sales enablement strategies to drive revenue growth
  • Provide coaching and mentoring that incorporates sales strategy, process and proven sales methodology
  • Drive the creation of advanced sales plays and competitive intelligence resources for enterprise markets
  • Collaborate and align cross-functionally with Sales, Revenue Operations, Product, Marketing, and all GTM teams to ensure enablement strategy supports broader organizational objectives
  • Own the end-to-end sales onboarding experience, ensuring new hires reach peak productivity rapidly
  • Identify and deliver training needs for Sales teams for continuous improvements
  • Collaborate with Product Management and Marketing to translate technical roadmaps into value-based sales narratives
  • Manage the sales enablement tech stack (CRM, LMS, etc.) to ensure tools are optimizing, not hindering, the sales process through right-time right-place delivery
  • Provide a framework to relevant teams to develop and maintain high-quality sales assets, including discovery guides, pitch decks, and battlecards
  • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions on advanced product features and sales techniques
  • Coordinate the logistics for global sales training events and twice-yearly "sprint" weeks
  • Monitor, report and act on the adoption and effectiveness of enablement initiatives using data-driven insights
  • Support the senior team in preparing reports for leadership and auditing sales documentation for accuracy

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Demonstrated experience coaching sales leaders and diagnosing business challenges to drive organizational improvement
  • Proficiency in a modern sales methodology such as MEDDPICC – able to coach leaders and sellers using this methodology
  • Ability to align and influence others, establish direction, achieve consensus, and execute
  • Experience building enablement programs from the ground up in emerging or high-growth markets
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • Experience in sales enablement, technical training, or sales operations (level-dependent)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce, modern LMS platforms and project management tools (e.g. Jira)
  • Basic knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
